articles.title: Truthful and Expected-Payment-Optimal Model Routing in Graph-Based Agentic Workflows
articles.abstract: Assigning routine tasks to cheaper large language model (LLM) providers can reduce generation cost, but switching providers may require processing accumulated context again. Keeping dependent tasks with the same provider can instead reuse eligible context. Graph-based workflows therefore couple routing decisions across tasks. Independent providers may also privately know their real-time unit costs and strategically misreport them. We formulate this routing problem as a single-parameter procurement auction and propose STAR (Strategy-proof Topology-aware Agent Routing), which minimizes virtual-cost-weighted graph workloads. Its allocation rule and payments, computed by integrating workload over possible cost reports, make truthful reporting utility-maximizing regardless of other providers' reports and cover each truthful provider's execution cost. With independent cost distributions and non-decreasing virtual costs, STAR additionally minimizes the user's expected total payment to providers. Controlled synthetic experiments separate the execution-cost benefit of topology awareness from the payment benefit of virtual-cost optimization: the former grows with fan-out and transferred payload, while the latter increases gradually along the tested prior-shape heterogeneity path. A paired sensitivity study quantifies how payment savings vary with prior misspecification while strategy-proofness is preserved.
articles.titleCn: 基于图的代理工作流中的诚实且预期付款最优模型路由
articles.abstractCn: 将常规任务分配给成本更低的大型语言模型（LLM）供应商可以降低生成成本，但更换供应商可能需要重新处理累积的上下文。相反，将依赖任务与同一供应商保留可以重用符合条件的上下文。因此，基于图的作业流程将跨任务的调度决策耦合起来。独立的供应商也可能私下了解其实时单位成本，并策略性地虚报它们。我们将此调度问题建模为单参数采购拍卖，并提出STAR（策略免疫拓扑感知代理调度），该算法最小化虚拟成本加权的图工作量。其分配规则和支付方式通过整合可能成本报告的工作量计算得出，使得真实报告在任何其他供应商报告的情况下都能实现效用最大化，并覆盖每个真实供应商的执行成本。在独立的成本分布和非递减虚拟成本的情况下，STAR额外最小化用户对供应商的预期总支付。在受控的合成实验中，将拓扑感知的执行成本优势与虚拟成本优化的支付优势分离开：前者随着扇出和传输有效载荷的增加而增长，而后者逐渐增加，沿着测试的先验形状异质性路径。配对敏感性研究量化了在保持策略免疫的情况下，支付节省如何随先验错配而变化。

articles.title: PersEvalBench: Can LLM Evaluators Judge Contextually Appropriate Use of Persona Information?
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) evaluators are increasingly used to assess personalized assistants, yet whether they can reliably judge personalization has rarely been tested. We introduce PersEvalBench, a benchmark testing whether an evaluator can recognize appropriate and inappropriate uses of user history. It contains 403 multi-episode scenarios where user information should persist, transfer, or cease to apply. The benchmark covers nine controlled error subtypes across three families: under-personalization, over-personalization, and misapplied-state errors. Human audits confirm that generated errors match their intended types and that the prescribed uses of user information are reasonable. Across five LLM evaluators, recognition of controlled personalization errors remains limited even with the full dialogue history. On the human-evaluated subset, under-personalization shows the largest gap: humans recognize 94.4% of these errors, compared with 63.9% for the strongest reported evaluator. Evaluators often recognize that a response is problematic but reverse the error direction, mistaking failure to follow an applicable preference (UNDER) for use of an inapplicable preference (OVER). Easier evidence access offers little help: highlighting the relevant history turns raises error recognition only slightly, suggesting that the remaining difficulty lies in judging what role that information should play in the response.
articles.titleCn: PersEvalBench：大型语言模型评估器能否判断角色信息的情境适宜性使用？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）评估器越来越多地用于评估个性化助手，但它们能否可靠地判断个性化却很少得到检验。我们介绍了PersEvalBench，这是一个基准测试，用于检验评估器是否能够识别用户历史的适当和不适当使用。它包含403个多场景情景，其中用户信息应该持续、转移或停止适用。该基准涵盖了三个家族中的九种受控错误子类型：欠个性化、过度个性化和错误应用状态错误。人工审核证实生成的错误与其预期类型匹配，并且用户信息的指定使用是合理的。在五个LLM评估器中，即使提供完整的对话历史，对受控个性化错误的识别仍然有限。在人工评估的子集中，欠个性化显示出最大的差距：人类识别了94.4%的这些错误，而最强报告的评估器仅为63.9%。评估器通常能识别出有问题的回复，但会反转错误方向，将未能遵循适用偏好的错误（UNDER）误判为使用了不适用的偏好（OVER）。更容易获取证据提供不了太多帮助：突出显示相关历史记录仅略微提高了错误识别率，这表明剩余的困难在于判断这些信息在回复中应扮演的角色。

articles.title: Qwenfant: Train Big Character-level BabyLMs on Concise Parallel Text
articles.abstract: This work concerns our submission for the Multilingual track of the 2026 BabyLM Challenge. We improve on our baseline using data that has been summarized and translated by an LLM, showing that higher-quality data can come from synthetic sources. We further improve with 2 simple changes: using a larger model, and using a character-level vocabulary. Both of these changes require LoRA-style fine-tuning for realizing their full potential. We dub our final Qwen3-based model Qwenfant, which, at the time of submission, ranks 1st in the Multilingual track.
articles.titleCn: Qwenfant：在简洁平行文本上训练大型字符级BabyLM模型
articles.abstractCn: 这项工作涉及我们为2026年BabyLM挑战的多语言赛道提交的成果。我们利用由大型语言模型（LLM）总结和翻译的数据改进了我们的基线模型，证明了高质量数据可以来自合成来源。我们进一步通过两个简单的改进措施提升了性能：使用更大的模型，以及采用字符级词汇表。这两个改进都需要通过LoRA风格的微调来实现其全部潜力。我们将基于Qwen3的最终模型命名为Qwenfant，在提交时，该模型在多语言赛道中排名第一。

articles.title: Can LLM Agents Efficiently Identify Appliance Faults? Insights From Diagnosing a Simulated Appliance
articles.abstract: In so-called "Industry 4.0," integrated sensors, analytics tools, and other digital technologies supplement industrial workflows, potentiating enhanced visibility and automation. Prognostics and health management (PHM) and natural language processing (NLP) practitioners alike have explored the application of large language models (LLMs) to industrial asset management, but many prior works' focus on exam-like benchmarks has limited their assessment of LLMs' ability to automate practical operations. Herein, we introduce CoffeeBench, a fault diagnostics task for LLM agents, using a simulated appliance. The LLMs we evaluate struggle to consistently identify faults from the sensor information alone, but the best-performing ones can iteratively refine the fault-option space to eventually obtain a successful diagnosis. Our subsequent analyses, therefore, focus on: differentiating models by diagnostic efficiency (RQ1); examining the lagging performance of the three worst models (RQ2); and identifying viable heuristics for selective prediction (RQ3), including that initial diagnostic uncertainty and LLM-judged soundness of reasoning are high-signal predictors of diagnostic success. In addition to our benchmark results (Section 3.1), we provide practical insights for improving the performance of the open-weight models on CoffeeBench, such as by explicitly tracking episode state on their behalf to reduce timeouts (Section 3.2) or applying a deliberation loop to refine diagnostic hypotheses (Section 3.3).
articles.titleCn: LLM代理能否高效识别电器故障？——从诊断模拟电器中获得的见解
articles.abstractCn: 在所谓的“工业4.0”中，集成传感器、分析工具和其他数字技术补充了工业工作流程，增强了可见性和自动化能力。预测与健康管理（PHM）和自然语言处理（NLP）从业者都探索了将大型语言模型（LLM）应用于工业资产管理，但许多先前工作的重点在于考试式的基准测试，这限制了他们对LLM自动化实际操作能力的评估。在此，我们介绍了CoffeeBench，这是一个用于LLM代理的故障诊断任务，使用模拟设备。我们评估的LLM难以仅凭传感器信息一致地识别故障，但表现最好的LLM可以通过迭代优化故障选项空间，最终获得成功的诊断。因此，我们的后续分析重点在于：通过诊断效率区分模型（RQ1）；考察三个表现最差的模型的滞后性能（RQ2）；以及识别选择性预测的有效启发式方法（RQ3），包括初始诊断不确定性和LLM判断的推理合理性是诊断成功的强信号预测因素。除了我们的基准测试结果（第3.1节），我们还提供了提高开放权重模型在CoffeeBench上性能的实用见解，例如通过显式追踪其场景状态以减少超时（第3.2节）或应用推理循环以优化诊断假设（第3.3节）。

articles.title: From Efficiency to Sufficiency: The Cost-Aware Measurement Design Framework for Automated Essay Scoring
articles.abstract: Compute cost in automated essay scoring (AES) is usually treated as a technical efficiency issue rather than a measurement design concern. Yet deployment decisions require more than reporting latency, model size, or inference expense. In high-stakes settings, total burden includes validation, monitoring, adjudication, compliance, and governance; in instructional settings, pricing, licensing, and integration may dominate cost. This paper reframes AES as a cost-constrained measurement system and introduces the Cost-Aware Measurement Design (CAMD) Framework, a four-layer structure consisting of metering, allocation, unit economics, and decision, for translating computational and workflow resource records into decision-relevant cost constructs. Direct cost is specified as monetary outlay plus attributable labor and time, and two criteria, design attribution and auditability, determine what the cost boundary excludes. Burdens that satisfy neither criterion, such as institutional capability and governance posture, are represented as constraints on which designs are admissible rather than priced. The paper defines cost per defensible score (CPDS) and argues that AES systems should be compared by quality-cost sufficiency: minimizing cost among defensible scoring designs that satisfy measurement requirements. Scoring volume conditions all four layers, so cost per defensible score is treated as a function of scale rather than as a single transferable number. CAMD provides a portable basis for representing, comparing, and evaluating cost across AES studies and deployment contexts.
articles.titleCn: 从效率到适度：自动作文评分的成本感知测量设计框架
articles.abstractCn: 在自动化作文评分（AES）中，成本计算通常被视为技术效率问题，而非测量设计问题。然而，部署决策需要超越报告延迟、模型大小或推理成本。在高风险环境中，总负担包括验证、监控、裁决、合规和治理；在教学环境中，定价、许可和集成可能主导成本。本文将AES重新定义为受成本约束的测量系统，并引入成本感知测量设计（CAMD）框架，该框架是一个四层结构，包括计量、分配、单位经济和决策，用于将计算和流程资源记录转化为决策相关的成本结构。直接成本被定义为货币支出加上可归因的劳动力和时间，而设计归因和可审计性两个标准决定了成本边界排除的内容。那些不满足任何标准的负担，如机构能力和治理立场，被表示为对可接受设计的约束，而非定价。本文定义了每项可辩护评分的成本（CPDS），并论证AES系统应通过质量成本充分性进行比较：在满足测量要求的可辩护评分设计中，最小化成本。评分量影响所有四层，因此每项可辩护评分的成本被视为规模函数，而非单一的转移数字。CAMD为跨AES研究和部署环境表示、比较和评估成本提供了便携式基础。

articles.title: Whose Data, Whose Benchmark? A User-Centric Framework for Auditing Evaluation Resources
articles.abstract: Benchmarks shape how model capabilities are measured and interpreted, yet their scores can obscure whose conventions, contexts, and judgments define successful performance. We introduce a user-centric audit framework that distinguishes users who contribute benchmark content from those whose needs evaluation results are intended to represent. The framework operationalizes seven dimensions across benchmark content, metadata, documentation, and scoring procedures. Across 16 resources, we find that American-centered conventions account for 62.4-94.4% of matched signals in 11 text benchmarks, while geographic visibility in five image-text resources is concentrated and strongly associated with national GDP share (mean Pearson r = 0.780; Spearman p = 0.778). Documentation reveals a systematic source-target gap: all 16 resources operationalize source-user context, but none operationalize target-user context. Paired scoring experiments further show that meaning-preserving answer variants reduce DROP exact-match accuracy from 100.0% to 33.3%, while TruthfulQA exhibits metric-dependent reductions in reference similarity. Our framework and documentation checklist make user assumptions auditable, clarifying what benchmark scores represent and where evaluation claims are supported.
articles.titleCn: 谁的数据，谁的基准？一个以用户为中心的评估资源审计框架
articles.abstractCn: 基准测试塑造了模型能力的衡量和解读方式，但其分数可能掩盖了由谁的惯例、背景和判断定义了成功表现。我们引入了一个以用户为中心的审计框架，区分了贡献基准内容的用户和其需求评估结果所代表的用户。该框架在基准内容、元数据、文档和评分程序中操作化了七个维度。在16个资源中，我们发现以美国为中心的惯例在11个文本基准中占匹配信号的62.4-94.4%，而五个图像-文本资源中的地理可见性高度集中且与国家GDP份额强相关（平均Pearson r = 0.780；Spearman p = 0.778）。文档揭示了系统性的源-目标差距：所有16个资源都操作化了源用户背景，但没有操作化目标用户背景。配对评分实验进一步表明，保持意义的答案变体将DROP精确匹配准确率从100.0%降至33.3%，而TruthfulQA在参考相似度上表现出与指标相关的减少。我们的框架和文档清单使用户假设可审计，阐明了基准分数所代表的内容以及评估主张的依据。

articles.title: MemeTrace: A Multimodal LLM-Based Agent for Safety-Aware Meme Provenance Analysis
articles.abstract: Online memes are often carriers of unsafe content such as disinformation and propaganda. Their rapid evolution in response to news events and strong dependence on contextual information make it difficult for platforms and moderators to detect and moderate them effectively. Moreover, existing moderation studies typically classify memes as safe or unsafe based on individual images, lacking the ability to perform broader provenance analysis, i.e., where a meme originates, how it spreads, what cultural symbolism it represents, whether it poses potential risks to society, etc. To bridge this gap, we introduce MemeTrace, a multimodal LLM-based agent that automatically traces the provenance and potential risks of emerging memes. We evaluate MemeTrace on Meme100, a dataset of 100 real-world memes, using both human annotation and automatic metrics. The results demonstrate that MemeTrace substantially outperforms the VLM baseline. More importantly, MemeTrace achieves higher accuracy in detecting unsafe memes, especially those involving disinformation and sensitive content, and remains robust under visual perturbations.
articles.titleCn: MemeTrace：一种基于多模态LLM的安全意识 мем 起源分析智能体
articles.abstractCn: 网络迷因常常是虚假信息和宣传等不安全内容的载体。它们针对新闻事件的快速演变以及强依赖于上下文信息，使得平台和版主难以有效检测和审核。此外，现有的审核研究通常基于单个图像将迷因分类为安全或不安全，缺乏进行更广泛的溯源分析的能力，即迷因的来源、传播方式、所代表的文化符号、是否对社会构成潜在风险等。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了MemeTrace，一个基于多模态大语言模型的智能体，能够自动追踪新兴迷因的溯源和潜在风险。我们在Meme100数据集上评估了MemeTrace，该数据集包含100个真实世界的迷因，并使用了人工标注和自动指标进行评估。结果表明，MemeTrace显著优于VLM基线模型。更重要的是，MemeTrace在检测不安全迷因方面表现出更高的准确率，尤其是涉及虚假信息和敏感内容的迷因，并且在视觉扰动下依然保持稳健。

articles.title: Copy-Paste Language Models
articles.abstract: Transformers are intuitively considered to be efficient at copying from their inputs. We actually show that the ability of LLMs to copy in context can be improved through explicit modeling. We propose Copy-Paste Language Models (CPLMs), which add a lightweight Copy-Paste head to the conventional language modeling (LM) head. CPLMs improve training efficiency, downstream performance, and offer new operating points in long-context and retrieval setups. We validate our approach by pretraining models from 135M to 1.7B parameters, showing improvements across all scales and backbones with negligible training and inference overheads. We explain the success of CPLMs by showing that they partially mitigate the LM head gradient bottleneck through an alternative gradient path.
articles.titleCn: 复制粘贴语言模型
articles.abstractCn: Transformer模型通常被认为在从输入中复制信息方面非常高效。我们实际上证明了，通过显式建模，可以提升大型语言模型在上下文中复制信息的能力。我们提出了复制粘贴语言模型（CPLMs），该模型在传统的语言模型（LM）头上添加了一个轻量级的复制粘贴头。CPLMs提升了训练效率、下游性能，并在长上下文和检索设置中提供了新的操作点。我们通过预训练从1.35亿到17亿参数的模型来验证我们的方法，展示了在所有规模和主干网络上的改进，且训练和推理开销可以忽略不计。我们通过展示CPLMs通过替代梯度路径部分缓解了LM头梯度瓶颈，解释了其成功的原因。

articles.title: Do Syntax Heads Influence Model Behavior?
articles.abstract: Transformer language models develop attention heads that specialize in syntactic relations, for example, attending from verbs to their subjects. Do these heads play a causal role in the model's syntactic predictions? Evidence for such a role is mixed to negative: even when we force these heads to attend to a distractor noun other than the subject, the model's syntactic predictions are still more consistent with the subject than with the distractor. Interventions on specialized syntax heads had a significantly stronger effect on syntactic predictions than interventions on random heads, but only in one of the two measures we propose.
articles.titleCn: 句法头部是否影响模型行为？
articles.abstractCn: Transformer语言模型发展出专门处理句法关系的注意力头，例如从动词关注到其主语。这些头在模型的句法预测中是否起因果作用？支持这种作用的证据并不明确甚至为负：即使我们强制这些头关注除主语之外的其他干扰名词，模型的句法预测仍然更倾向于主语而非干扰名词。对专门句法头的干预对句法预测的影响显著强于对随机头的干预，但这只在我们的两种测量方法中的一种情况下成立。

articles.title: Titan-Llama: Retrofitting Pre-trained LLMs with External Neural Memory Modules
articles.abstract: Transformers are efficient to pre-train at scale because attention permits parallel computation across sequence positions, but long-context inference requires increasingly large KV caches. Efficient recurrent alternatives reduce the asymptotic complexity of inference, but their sequential dependence limits token-wise parallelism during training, making them harder to scale. Further, the current paradigm of extending long context tasks creates competing notions of retaining information precisely and keeping long-context inference efficient. To address this gap, we introduce Titan-Llama, a post-training method for retrofitting attention-based language models with a hierarchical memory architecture that updates parameters at test-time. Titan-Llama applies a blockwise attention mask and preserves full-fidelity attention over recent tokens while compressing historical context into recurrent, fixed-size neural memory modules (NMMs). Our formulation allows pre-trained attention layers to be replaced without training a new language model from scratch. On Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Titan-Llama raises accuracy over segmented attention windows from 23.87\% to 40.51\% on QuALITY and from 14.50\% to 40.75\% on LongHealth. Inference benchmarks show more than 20\% faster prefill, 37\% faster decode at medium context lengths, and 24\% lower steady-state decode memory usage in the evaluated configurations. Together, these results demonstrate that incorporating memory architecture mechanisms that utilize test-time training effectively modulates long-context behavior of pre-trained models, offering a practical route to adapting pre-trained transformers for efficient long-context inference. Our code is released on Github \href{https://github.com/sarahpannn/titans-pytorch/tree/main}{GitHub}
articles.titleCn: Titan-Llama：使用外部神经记忆模块改造预训练大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: Transformer模型在规模化预训练时效率很高，因为注意力机制允许跨序列位置进行并行计算，但长上下文推理需要越来越大的KV缓存。高效的循环替代方案降低了推理的渐近复杂度，但它们的顺序依赖性限制了训练过程中的分词级并行性，使得它们更难规模化。此外，当前扩展长上下文任务的范式创造了保留信息精确性和保持长上下文推理效率之间的竞争概念。为解决这一差距，我们引入了Titan-Llama，这是一种在测试时更新参数的后训练方法，用于为基于注意力的语言模型添加分层内存架构。Titan-Llama应用了分块注意力掩码，在保留最近分词的全保真度注意力同时将历史上下文压缩到循环的固定大小神经记忆模块（NMMs）中。我们的公式允许在不从头训练新语言模型的情况下替换预训练的注意力层。在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct上，Titan-Llama将分割注意力窗口的准确率在QuALITY上从23.87%提高到40.51%，在LongHealth上从14.50%提高到40.75%。推理基准测试显示，在评估配置中，prefill速度提高了20%以上，中等上下文长度的decode速度提高了37%，稳态decode内存使用降低了24%。这些结果共同表明，结合利用测试时训练的内存架构机制，可以有效地调节预训练模型的长上下文行为，为适应预训练Transformer进行高效长上下文推理提供了一条实用途径。我们的代码已发布在Github \href{https://github.com/sarahpannn/titans-pytorch/tree/main}{GitHub}。

articles.title: DUALVIEW: Leveraging Broad and Output-Specific Evidence for LLM-based Multi-Output Text Regression
articles.abstract: While work on LLM-based regression has largely focused on scalar prediction, multi-output text regression remains less explored. We present DualView, a parameter-efficient approach to leverage LLMs for multi-output text regression. \method{} first extracts broad and output-specific representations from a frozen LLM, then uses a dual-branch architecture to produce the full score vector. Across five heterogeneous regression tasks and eight LLMs (up to 122B), DualView outperforms seven supervised regression baselines while requiring 82--1842 times fewer fitted parameters than the three strongest baselines. These improvements extend across individual output dimensions and persist even with limited training data. Notably, DualView using a smaller open-weight LLM can outperform unsupervised prediction with Gemini 3.1 Pro. Controlled ablations show that broad and output-specific evidence provide complementary predictive benefits, while lightweight shared predictors achieve strong performance with fewer trainable parameters.
articles.titleCn: DUALVIEW：利用广泛和输出特定证据进行基于LLM的多输出文本回归
articles.abstractCn: 尽管基于LLM的回归研究主要集中在标量预测上，但多输出文本回归仍较少被探索。我们提出了DualView，这是一种参数高效的利用LLM进行多输出文本回归的方法。该方法首先从冻结的LLM中提取广义和输出特定的表示，然后使用双分支架构生成完整的得分向量。在五个异构回归任务和八个LLM（最高122B）上，DualView优于七个监督回归基线，同时比三个最强的基线所需的拟合参数少82--1842倍。这些改进扩展到各个输出维度，并且在训练数据有限的情况下仍然保持。值得注意的是，使用较小的开放权重LLM的DualView可以优于Gemini 3.1 Pro的无监督预测。受控消融实验表明，广义和输出特定的证据提供了互补的预测益处，而轻量级共享预测器在更少的可训练参数下实现了优异的性能。

articles.title: Weighted Ensemble Sampling for Rare-Event Estimation in Language Models
articles.abstract: Rare but severe failures of large language models can become practically significant at deployment scale. Estimating their probabilities with direct Monte Carlo sampling is highly inefficient, while proposal-based methods typically require auxiliary learning of an additional proposal distribution. We introduce \textbf{Weighted Ensemble (WE)}, a training-free framework for rare-event estimation in language models. WE samples exclusively from the original language model and improves upon direct Monte Carlo by periodically reallocating the sampling budget toward prefixes that appear more likely to reach the target rare event. To guide this reallocation without learning a separate proposal distribution, we exploit internal LLM representations as prefix-level signals and empirically validate their effectiveness. We provide a theoretical analysis of the proposed algorithm. Experiments on safety-related tasks spanning both small-scale and modern large-scale LLMs demonstrate that WE improves the efficiency and reliability of rare-event probability estimation.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中罕见事件估计的加权集成采样
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的罕见但严重的失败在部署规模下可能变得具有实际意义。使用直接蒙特卡洛采样来估计它们的概率效率极低，而基于建议的方法通常需要辅助学习额外的建议分布。我们引入了\textbf{加权集成（WE）}，这是一种用于语言模型罕见事件估计的无训练框架。WE仅从原始语言模型中采样，并通过定期将采样预算重新分配给更有可能达到目标罕见事件的词缀来改进直接蒙特卡洛方法。为了在不学习单独的建议分布的情况下指导这种重新分配，我们利用内部LLM表示作为词缀级信号，并经验验证了它们的有效性。我们对所提出的算法进行了理论分析。在涵盖小规模和现代大规模LLM的安全相关任务上的实验表明，WE提高了罕见事件概率估计的效率和可靠性。

articles.title: NEPSEE: A Double-Annotated Benchmark for Nepali Sentiment Analysis
articles.abstract: Many sentiment datasets use one annotator for each item, so the test labels show the conventions of that person. We build a Nepali benchmark from two annotators who labelled the same sentences blind. They labelled 5,614 sentences from tweets of Nepali public figures on a five-point scale. We keep only the 3,189 sentences where both give the same polarity. On the three-class benchmark, NepBERTa with a fixed tokenizer gets a macro-F1 of 0.877 and IndicBERTv2 0.867. Three commercial large language models (LLMs) get 0.882 to 0.896 zero-shot, and these differences are not significant. On the five-point scale, 766 sentences have two adjacent labels, for example Pos and SPos. We accept both labels and train on both. On this task, Claude Opus 5.5 beats the best encoders by 0.10 to 0.12 macro-F1. A tokenizer audit adds a second result. The default tokenizers of three Nepali BERT models delete the non-spacing Devanagari vowel signs and the virama. When we restore the marks, macro-F1 increases by 0.084 for NepBERTa but decreases by 0.095 for a model pretrained on stripped text.
articles.titleCn: NEPSEE：一个双标注的尼泊尔情感分析基准数据集
articles.abstractCn: 许多情感数据集对每个项目使用一个标注者，因此测试标签显示了该人的规范。我们从两个对相同句子进行盲法标注的标注者那里构建了一个尼泊尔基准。他们从尼泊尔公众人物的推文中标注了5,614个句子，使用五点量表。我们只保留了3,189个句子，其中两个标注者给出了相同的极性。在三类基准上，尼泊尔BERTa（使用固定分词器）的宏F1为0.877，IndicBERTv2为0.867。三个商业大型语言模型（LLMs）在零样本情况下得到0.882到0.896的宏F1，这些差异不显著。在五点量表上，766个句子有两个相邻标签，例如Pos和SPos。我们接受这两个标签并在这两个标签上进行训练。在这个任务上，Claude Opus 5.5比最佳编码器在宏F1上领先0.10到0.12。一个分词器审计增加了第二个结果。三个尼泊尔BERT模型的默认分词器会删除非间距的印度语元音符号和virama。当我们恢复这些标记时，尼泊尔BERTa的宏F1增加了0.084，但在剥离文本上预训练的模型的宏F1则减少了0.095。

articles.title: How to Evaluate When You Don't Know How to Evaluate? Choosing Reliable Setups for Base Language Model Benchmarking
articles.abstract: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) remains largely pre-scientific: it involves many design decisions, with little guidance on how to make them. These choices can substantially affect measured performance and, consequently, decisions about subsequent pretraining. To identify effective evaluation setups, we investigate 8 aspects, such as task formulation or the number of in-context examples. We compare the setups using three widely-used signal criteria, repurposed as normative meta-measures: monotonicity, non-randomness, and ranking consistency of the evaluation scores across intermediate checkpoints. In an early pretraining scenario, we evaluate these setups on 26 monolingual 2B-parameter models trained on different types of data, using 80 tasks in four languages. We also examine the setups on three larger LLMs ($\geq$7B) in the same four languages and explore how the preferred setups change with model scale. Our results yield concrete recommendations: some choices, such as the use of multiple prompts, are consistently useful, whereas others, such as task formulation, depend on model scale. More generally, our framework serves as a recipe for the choice of evaluation setups in new scenarios.
articles.titleCn: 当你不知道如何评估时如何评估？为基座语言模型基准测试选择可靠的设置
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型（LLMs）的评估在很大程度上仍处于前科学阶段：它涉及许多设计决策，而关于如何做出这些决策的指导却很少。这些选择会显著影响测量性能，并进而影响后续预训练的决策。为了识别有效的评估设置，我们研究了8个方面，例如任务表述或情境示例的数量。我们使用三种广泛使用的信号标准来比较这些设置，并将它们重新定义为规范元度量：评估分数在中间检查点上的单调性、非随机性和排名一致性。在早期预训练场景中，我们使用四种语言中的80项任务，在26个不同类型数据训练的2B参数单语模型上评估这些设置。我们还使用同四种语言中的三个更大的LLMs（$\geq$7B）来检验这些设置，并探索随着模型规模的扩大，首选设置如何变化。我们的结果给出了具体的建议：某些选择，如使用多个提示，始终很有用，而另一些选择，如任务表述，则取决于模型规模。更普遍地说，我们的框架为在新场景中选择评估设置提供了一种方案。

articles.title: HERO: Harnessing Evidence for Test-time Refinement and Prompt Optimization in Program Generation
articles.abstract: Harness optimization improves LLMs by refining reusable prompts and scaffolding, yet requires further adaptation for program generation tasks such as text-to-SQL and text-to-Python. Existing methods often rely on LLM reflectors to propose harness updates, which can fix observed failures but also disrupt previously correct behavior. Text-to-code tasks offer a natural way to mitigate this issue: we can execute generated outputs, allowing us to evaluate and verify the effects of proposed updates directly. Building on this signal, we introduce \textsc{HERO} (\textbf{H}arnessing \textbf{E}vidence for \textbf{R}efinement and \textbf{O}ptimization), which combines offline and test-time harness optimization. At the first stage, \method{} learns reusable prompt updates from execution-verified successes and failures and validates candidate revisions before adoption. At test time, we treat the generated code as an instance-specific harness and refine it using execution feedback. Across four SQL, Cypher, and Python benchmarks, \method{} achieves the best offline performance, improving pass@1 by \(7.6\) points over the initial prompt, while test-time refinement adds another \(2.0\) points and improves execution efficiency.
articles.titleCn: HERO：在程序生成中利用证据进行测试时优化和提示优化
articles.abstractCn: 利用优化通过改进可重用提示和框架来提升大语言模型，但对于程序生成任务（如文本到SQL和文本到Python）需要进一步适配。现有方法通常依赖大语言模型反射器来提出优化更新，这可以修正观察到的错误，但也可能破坏之前正确的行为。文本到代码任务提供了一种自然的方式来缓解这个问题：我们可以执行生成的输出，从而直接评估和验证所提出的更新的效果。基于这一信号，我们引入了HERO（利用证据进行优化和改进的框架），它结合了离线和测试时的优化。在第一阶段，该方法从经过执行验证的成功和失败案例中学习可重用提示更新，并在采用前验证候选修订。在测试时，我们将生成的代码视为特定实例的优化框架，并使用执行反馈对其进行改进。在四个SQL、Cypher和Python基准测试中，该方法实现了最佳的离线性能，相较于初始提示，提升了7.6个百分点的pass@1指标，而测试时的改进又额外增加了2.0个百分点，并提高了执行效率。

articles.title: Fantastic Metrics and How to Find Them: Meta-Evaluating Metrics for Multi-lingual Style-Personalized Generation
articles.abstract: Meta-evaluation of text generation metrics and LLM-judges is primarily conducted using metric-human correlations. However, prior work has shown that correlation is not an appropriate estimate of a metric's evaluation capability and can be unstable across evaluation settings, such as different datasets or languages. Therefore, we propose a regression-based meta-evaluation of metrics that learns on calibrated metric outputs to predict human ratings. We ground this measurement relative to a trivial constant-mean baseline and human agreements to provide a comparable measure of metric capability across evaluation settings. To test our meta-evaluation framework, we developed a large-scale multi-lingual style-personalized text generation (SPTG) benchmark, collecting multiple annotations across 10 topologically diverse languages and four evaluation dimensions, each with varying degrees of subjectivity. We meta-evaluated 32 metrics from three style evaluation paradigms (string-based, embedding-based, and LLM-judges) and their ensembles over these 40 evaluation settings. Our analysis revealed that even simple string- and embedding-based measurements can match strong LLM-judges when calibrated to human ratings. We also identified characteristics of human annotations that determine metric performance, as well as conditions under which a metric ensemble outperforms its individual constituents.
articles.titleCn: 卓越的指标及其寻找方法：对多语言风格个性化生成的元评估指标
articles.abstractCn: 对文本生成指标和LLM-评委的元评估主要采用指标-人类相关性进行。然而，已有研究表明，相关性并非评估指标能力的适当估计，且在不同评估场景下（如不同数据集或语言）可能不稳定。因此，我们提出基于回归的指标元评估方法，该方法通过学习校准后的指标输出来预测人类评分。我们将此评估方法与一个简单的常数均值基线以及人类共识进行对比，以提供跨评估场景下指标能力的可比衡量标准。为了测试我们的元评估框架，我们开发了一个大规模多语言风格个性化文本生成（SPTG）基准，收集了10种拓扑结构多样性不同的语言和4个评估维度（每个维度具有不同程度的主观性）下的多重标注。我们在这些40个评估场景中对来自三种风格评估范式（基于字符串、基于嵌入和LLM-评委）的32个指标及其集成进行了元评估。我们的分析表明，即使简单的基于字符串和嵌入的测量方法，在校准到人类评分后，也能与强大的LLM-评委相媲美。我们还识别了决定指标性能的人类标注特征，以及指标集成优于其单个组成部分的条件。

articles.title: ListQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating List-Formatted Factual Knowledge Retrieval in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Many real-world questions demand not a single fact but an organized collection of them, yet existing factual knowledge benchmarks almost exclusively target single answer retrieval. We introduce ListQA, a benchmark of 9,045 human-curated, cross-validated questions (audited error rate of 1.7%) that require LLMs to recall multiple facts and compose them into structured lists of 3-10 elements. Questions range from flat lists ("Which NCAA teams went undefeated between 2000 and 2024?") to hierarchical lists with sub-attributes ("...and what was their record and result?"), spanning eight categories across 60+ countries. An evergreen design (explicit temporal constraints or historically immutable facts) keeps ground truth valid without periodic updates. For evaluation, we frame element matching as a linear sum assignment problem: optimal bipartite matching paired with LLM-based semantic grading jointly captures factual accuracy, hallucination, and format compliance. We benchmark 34 models (8 families, 42 configurations across standard and thinking enabled inference) and find: the best standard-inference model scores below 37% LLM-Judge-F1, multi-faceted questions are harder across the board, and providing the source Wikipedia page lifts scores dramatically, confirming that models can organize facts but struggle to retrieve them from parameters alone. Extended analyses cover base vs. instruction-tuned checkpoints and token efficiency. We release the dataset and evaluation code.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project Page: https://listqa.github.io
articles.titleCn: ListQA：用于评估大型语言模型中列表格式事实性知识检索的基准
articles.abstractCn: 许多现实世界的问题需要的不是单一事实，而是一个有组织的知识集合，然而现有的知识基准几乎都专注于单一答案检索。我们介绍了ListQA，这是一个包含9,045个经过人工审核、交叉验证的问题（审核错误率为1.7%）的基准，这些问题要求大型语言模型回忆多个事实，并将它们组织成包含3-10个元素的有序列表。问题范围从扁平列表（“2000年至2024年间哪些NCAA球队保持不败？”）到具有子属性的层级列表（“……以及他们的战绩和结果是什么？”），涵盖60多个国家的八个类别。采用常青设计（明确的时间限制或历史不可变事实），确保真实答案无需定期更新。在评估方面，我们将元素匹配问题建模为线性总和分配问题：最优二分图匹配与基于大型语言模型的语义评分相结合，共同捕捉事实准确性、幻觉和格式合规性。我们对34个模型（8个系列、42种标准推理和思维启用推理配置）进行了基准测试，发现：最佳标准推理模型的得分低于37%的LLM-Judge-F1，多方面问题普遍更难，提供维基百科页面来源能显著提升得分，证实模型可以组织事实，但仅凭参数无法有效检索。扩展分析涵盖了基础模型与指令微调检查点以及token效率。我们发布了数据集和评估代码。

articles.title: From Qualitative Text to Integrated Evidence: The Parallel-Then-Integrated (PTI) Procedure
articles.abstract: Mixed methods research offers established strategies for integrating qualitative and quantitative evidence, but less guidance for integrating two computational representations of the same qualitative corpus. This methodological study introduces Parallel-Then-Integrated (PTI), a four-step procedure for explicit and traceable integration. We present PTI using 1,203 interview paragraphs from 29 mothers in Nepal. The two representations were ontology-guided Patient Voice (PV) coding with PVminer and data-driven themes generated through non-negative matrix factorization (NMF). A theme-complete crosswalk documented convergence, divergence, and preprocessing-sensitive differences. Depression status, based on Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) scores, served as a secondary external anchor for exploratory association checks. PTI provides a structured approach for integrating computational representations of qualitative text within mixed methods research.
articles.comment: 23 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Elyasirankhah/PTI
articles.titleCn: 从定性文本到整合证据：平行-整合（PTI）程序
articles.abstractCn: 混合方法研究为整合定性与定量证据提供了成熟的策略，但在整合同一定性语料库的两个计算表示方面却缺乏指导。这项方法论研究引入了平行-整合（PTI）方法，这是一种包含四个步骤的明确且可追溯的整合程序。我们使用来自尼泊尔29位母亲的1203段访谈内容，展示了PTI方法的应用。这两种表示方法分别是本体指导的患者声音（PV）编码（使用PVminer）和数据驱动的主题（通过非负矩阵分解NMF生成）。一个主题完整的交叉映射记录了它们的趋同、分歧以及预处理敏感的差异。基于患者健康问卷-9（PHQ-9）评分的抑郁状态作为次要的外部锚点，用于探索性关联检查。PTI为混合方法研究中整合定性文本的计算表示提供了一种结构化的方法。

articles.title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
articles.abstract: Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. None of the 135 submissions satisfies all the conditions, and 114 fail our integrity check, most often because the paper claims work that was never done or reports numbers that contradict the recorded evidence. Overall, agents readily produce papers that look like follow-ups, but none meets the standard of the domain scientist, leaving substantial headroom. Our code and data are publicly available.
articles.titleCn: 《探索未知：在开放科学研究中评估AI智能体》
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能代理能否开展对开放科学问题的研究？我们介绍了“探索未知”基准，该基准向代理提供一篇科学论文以及一个研究方向，并要求其撰写一篇后续论文。我们与美国能源部（DOE）国家实验室的科学家合作，每位科学家贡献了一个自己工作中的未发表后续研究方向，并提供了提交论文必须满足的条件。虽然评估后续论文的质量通常具有挑战性，但使用这些条件形成评估标准，使得对没有参考答案的研究问题的评估变得更加可行。我们让九个前沿代理各撰写15篇后续论文，涵盖量子计算、等离子体物理、计算化学、材料科学和科学机器学习领域。在135篇提交的论文中，没有一篇满足所有条件，其中114篇未能通过诚信检查，大多数情况下是因为论文声称了从未完成的工作，或报告的数字与记录的证据相矛盾。总体而言，代理能够轻易地生成看似是后续研究的论文，但没有一篇达到领域科学家的标准，仍有巨大的提升空间。我们的代码和数据公开可用。

articles.title: DivAlgo: A systematic evaluation of algorithmic diversity for code generation models
articles.abstract: Code generation models are actively being used in professional and educational settings. However, the competence of large language models (LLMs) to generate algorithmically diverse code remains largely unknown. We propose the DivAlgo benchmark, a large-scale dataset constituting algorithmically diverse solutions to programming problems. We also introduce a lightweight similarity metric to enable large-scale evaluation. Our experiments across 24 modern code generation models found that uncontrolled model-generated code is significantly less diverse than human solutions (capturing ~31% of human diversity), and even the best diverse code generation strategy could achieve only ~70% of human diversity. Moreover, while it was possible to steer the models to generate solutions based on human strategies, they were unable to reproduce the diversity of the human solutions. These findings indicate the limitations of code generation models in capturing the algorithmic diversity humans exhibit, and that overexposure to model-generated code can narrow programmers' algorithmic vocabulary.
articles.titleCn: DivAlgo：代码生成模型算法多样性的系统评估
articles.abstractCn: 代码生成模型正被广泛应用于专业和教育领域。然而，大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成算法多样性代码方面的能力仍 largely未知。我们提出了 DivAlgo 基准，这是一个大规模数据集，包含了编程问题的算法多样性解决方案。我们还引入了一种轻量级的相似度度量方法，以支持大规模评估。我们的实验涵盖了 24 个现代代码生成模型，发现未经控制的模型生成代码的多样性显著低于人类解决方案（仅捕捉到人类多样性的 ~31%），即使是最优的多样性代码生成策略也只能达到人类多样性的 ~70%。此外，尽管可以引导模型基于人类策略生成解决方案，但它们无法复制人类解决方案的多样性。这些发现表明代码生成模型在捕捉人类展现的算法多样性方面的局限性，并且过度接触模型生成的代码可能会缩小程序员的算法词汇量。

articles.title: MA-Bench: Measuring Operational Planning in Language Models
articles.abstract: How well can a language model turn a large, incomplete and partly contradictory body of documents into a plan when no single correct answer exists? We introduce Mission Analysis (MA)-Bench, built on mission analysis, the first step of military operational planning, in which a staff reads the full situation and states the problem before anyone proposes a solution. Its 10 expert-built scenarios pair synthetic packets of ten to twelve documents with 1,257 expert-written pass/fail requirements, each containing information on their source, question type, and importance level. A reasoning-model judge grades each brief against the requirements without seeing the documents; it grades like a fifth credentialed planner, leaving a four-planner panel's agreement unchanged (Fleiss $κ$ 0.42 to 0.41), and a judge from a second provider reproduces the model ranking (Spearman 0.94). Across twenty frontier and open-weights models the best gets 62% of the rubric items right. Models are strongest on facts stated in the documents (58%) and weakest on judgments that must be inferred (33%), and six failures in ten are omissions rather than errors. MA-Bench grades the determinations, not the prose. We release the packets, rubrics, prompts, scorer and every graded brief with item-level verdicts.
articles.titleCn: MA-Bench：衡量语言模型中的操作规划
articles.abstractCn: 当不存在唯一正确答案时，语言模型将大量、不完整且部分相互矛盾文档转化为计划的能力如何？我们介绍了基于任务分析（MA-Bench），任务分析是军事作战规划的第一步，其中工作人员在任何人提出解决方案之前阅读完整情况并陈述问题。其包含10个由专家构建的场景，将10到12份文档的合成包与1,257份由专家编写的通过/失败要求配对，每份要求都包含其来源、问题类型和重要性级别信息。推理模型裁判在不查看文档的情况下，根据要求对每份简报进行评分；其评分方式如同一位持有资质的第五位规划师，使四位规划师小组的协议保持不变（Fleiss κ 0.42至0.41），第二提供方的裁判也复现了模型排名（Spearman 0.94）。在二十个前沿和开放权重模型中，表现最好的模型正确率仅为62%。模型在文档中陈述的事实上表现最强（58%），在必须推断的判断上表现最弱（33%），并且十次中有六次失败是由于遗漏而非错误。MA-Bench评分的是判定结果，而非文本本身。我们发布了文档包、评分标准、提示、评分器和所有已评分简报及其项目级裁决。

articles.title: CAFE: Confining Feature Distillation to Language-Routed Adapters for Compact Multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: Feature distillation is usually expected to add to logit distillation. We find that this expectation does not hold for two common feature losses in compact multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), and analyze why through their gradients. The gradient of a projection-based loss is orthogonal to the task gradient, while that of Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), a similarity-based loss, is weakly aligned with it. CKA lowers the word error rate (WER) on non-English languages, but at the expense of data-rich English. Three loss-level remedies (one trained, two probed) all fall short, and the CKA gradient overlaps with the subspace English uses in the shared encoder by 97.5% to 99.5% (about 81% by chance). Guided by this diagnosis, we propose CAFE (Confined-Adapter Feature distillation), which confines the CKA gradient to adapters that English bypasses, addressing the trade-off in the parameters rather than in the loss. On the Open ASR Leaderboard, CAFE lowers the average WER from 8.55% to 8.02%, beats an adapter-only capacity control at 8.51%, and makes English more stable across checkpoints. At 254M parameters, it trails the 0.6B teacher by 2 WER points and is competitive with much larger models across 48 test sets in 24 languages. We use 564k hours of training data and state-of-the-art models to keep the findings relevant to practice.
articles.titleCn: CAFE：将特征蒸馏约束于语言路由适配器，以实现紧凑型多语言自动语音识别
articles.abstractCn: 特征蒸馏通常被认为是对 logits 蒸馏的补充。我们发现这一预期在紧凑型多语言自动语音识别 (ASR) 中的两种常见特征损失上并不成立，并通过梯度分析了原因。基于投影的损失的梯度与任务梯度正交，而基于相似性的损失 Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) 的梯度则与其弱对齐。CKA 降低了非英语语言的字错误率 (WER)，但代价是英语数据丰富的损失。三种损失级别的补救措施（一种训练，两种探测）均未成功，CKA 梯度与英语在共享编码器中使用的子空间重叠度为 97.5% 至 99.5%（约 81% 为偶然）。基于这一诊断，我们提出了 CAFE（Confined-Adapter Feature distillation），将 CKA 梯度限制在英语绕过的适配器中，解决参数层面的权衡而非损失层面的权衡。在 Open ASR 排行榜上，CAFE 将平均 WER 从 8.55% 降低到 8.02%，超越了 8.51% 的纯适配器能力控制，并使英语在多个检查点中更加稳定。在 254M 参数下，它比 0.6B 的教师模型落后 2 个 WER 点，但在 24 种语言的 48 个测试集上与更大的模型具有竞争力。我们使用 564k 小时的训练数据和最先进的模型，以确保研究结果与实践相关。

articles.title: Plant Memory: Technical Language Processing and a Verified Maintenance Ontology for Agent-Accessible Failure Knowledge from SAP PM Work Orders
articles.abstract: Maintenance work orders are the largest written record of how industrial equipment fails, yet in most plants they are close to unusable for analysis. Short texts are abbreviated and misspelt, asset identity is buried in free text, work-type labels contradict the work described, and the fields that matter most for reliability (symptom, root cause, action taken) are usually empty. As a result, diagnostic knowledge stays with senior technicians and leaves when they do. We present Plant Memory, a system that applies technical language processing (TLP) to SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) exports and builds an ISO 14224-aligned maintenance ontology in which every extracted statement is a reified fact carrying a confidence score, the evidence it was read from, and a verification state. Extraction is rule-first, with an optional large language model (LLM) acting as a second reader whose disagreements raise a fact's review priority rather than overwrite it. Technicians verify facts through a review queue, answer targeted knowledge-gap questions where failures repeat without a recorded cause, and approve or reject ontology drift proposals when new terms appear. The resulting graph is served to people through a web application and to AI agents through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so both query the same verified knowledge and every answer cites the work orders behind it. On a synthetic 12-month export of 400 work orders from a parboiled-rice plant, rule-based extraction reaches 96.2% component accuracy, 88.9% failure-mode accuracy and 100% root-cause precision at 62% coverage; on 28 diagnostic questions, ranked root causes from the ontology are correct at top-1 in 82.1% of cases against 53.6% for the raw SAP root-cause column.
articles.titleCn: 植物记忆：技术语言处理与验证性维护本体，用于从SAP PM工单中获取代理可访问的故障知识
articles.abstractCn: 维护工单是工业设备故障记录中最大的书面资料，但在大多数工厂中，它们接近于无法用于分析。简短的文本被缩写且拼写错误，资产标识被淹没在自由文本中，工作类型标签与描述的工作相矛盾，而最关键的可靠性字段（症状、根本原因、采取的措施）通常为空。因此，诊断知识停留在资深技师手中，并在他们离职时流失。我们提出了Plant Memory系统，该系统将技术语言处理（TLP）应用于SAP Plant Maintenance（PM）导出数据，并构建了一个与ISO 14224标准一致的维护本体，其中每个提取的陈述都是一个承载置信度分数、来源证据和验证状态的实体化事实。提取以规则优先，可选用大型语言模型（LLM）作为第二读者，其分歧会提高事实的审核优先级，而不是覆盖它。技师通过审核队列验证事实，回答重复出现但未记录原因的知识缺口问题，并在新术语出现时批准或拒绝本体漂移提案。生成的图谱通过Web应用程序供人使用，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器供AI代理使用，使两者查询相同的已验证知识，并且每个答案都引用了背后的工单。在一个合成12个月的导出数据中，包含400份来自蒸煮米厂的工单，基于规则的提取在62%的覆盖率下达到96.2%的组件准确率、88.9%的故障模式准确率和100%的根本原因精确度；在28个诊断问题中，本体排名的根本原因在82.1%的情况下是正确的，而原始SAP根本原因列的正确率仅为53.6%。

articles.title: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
articles.abstract: Structured pruning reduces LLM inference costs by removing model components to produce smaller dense models. However, existing methods can cause reasoning performance to collapse on long-form reasoning tasks such as AIME. We propose \textit{LayerTrim}, a training-free structured pruning method that identifies redundant decoder layers and selectively trims their MLP features while preserving attention and decoder depth. LayerTrim is the first training-free structured pruning method designed to preserve long-form reasoning without gradients or recovery training. Across three reasoning language models and five benchmarks, LayerTrim outperforms existing structured pruning methods in most evaluated settings, improving average accuracy by up to 21.4 percentage points over RESP. On \texttt{Qwen3-14B}, LayerTrim achieves 1.24$\times$ faster prefill and 19.7\% lower peak GPU memory than the dense model, while better preserving reasoning ability. It also achieves the shortest average generation length among evaluated pruned models, while retaining the highest average accuracy. These results demonstrate that LayerTrim improves reasoning efficiency through both structural compression and reduced token generation.
articles.titleCn: 通过注意力保留的多层感知器修剪解锁推理语言模型的结构化剪枝
articles.abstractCn: 结构化剪枝通过移除模型组件来生成更小的密集模型，从而降低大语言模型推理成本。然而，现有方法可能导致推理性能在长文本推理任务（如AIME）上崩溃。我们提出了\textit{LayerTrim}，这是一种无需训练的结构化剪枝方法，它识别冗余的解码器层，并选择性地修剪其MLP特征，同时保留注意力机制和解码器深度。LayerTrim是首个无需训练且旨在保留长文本推理能力、无需梯度或恢复训练的结构化剪枝方法。在三个推理语言模型和五个基准测试中，LayerTrim在大多数评估场景下优于现有的结构化剪枝方法，相较于RESP平均准确率提升了高达21.4个百分点。在\texttt{Qwen3-14B}上，LayerTrim实现了1.24倍的预填充速度提升，峰值GPU内存使用降低了19.7%，同时更好地保留了推理能力。此外，它还实现了所有评估剪枝模型中最短的平均生成长度，同时保持了最高的平均准确率。这些结果表明，LayerTrim通过结构压缩和减少token生成，双重提升了推理效率。

articles.title: DecisionRobust: Benchmarking Robustness for JEV Style Decision Models Across Text and Vision
articles.abstract: Emerging decision models such as JEV provide typed interfaces that map task instructions and observations directly to choices, judgments, and scores. As these models are increasingly used for automated decision-making, understanding their reliability under adversarial manipulation becomes critical. We introduce DecisionRobust, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the robustness of decision models across textual and visual inputs. Our benchmark covers practical decision-making scenarios and a diverse suite of attacks, including semantics-preserving text perturbations, image perturbations, and prompt injection in both modalities. We curate evaluation sets through external validity checks and cross-model candidate selection. We evaluate 30 model configurations on text tasks and 17 on vision tasks, including 24 and 12 held-out models, respectively, that are excluded from candidate selection. Our experiments reveal several key findings. First, attacks expose vulnerabilities beyond the models used for construction and selection, although optimized image perturbations transfer weakly to many targets even with multiple surrogates. Second, relative model robustness varies across tasks and attack types, and resistance to input perturbations does not necessarily imply resistance to prompt injection. Third, label-consistency checks substantially reduce measured attack success across text and image settings, highlighting the importance of validating apparent failures. The benchmark is available at https://yifan-lan.github.io/DecisionRobust/.
articles.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, including references and appendices. Benchmark website: https://yifan-lan.github.io/DecisionRobust/
articles.titleCn: 决策鲁棒性：跨文本和视觉领域对JEV风格决策模型鲁棒性的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 新兴决策模型如JEV提供类型化的接口，将任务指令和观察直接映射到选择、判断和评分。随着这些模型越来越多地用于自动化决策，理解它们在对抗性操纵下的可靠性变得至关重要。我们介绍了DecisionRobust，这是一个用于系统评估决策模型在文本和视觉输入下鲁棒性的基准。我们的基准涵盖了实际决策场景和一系列多样化的攻击，包括保持语义的文本扰动、图像扰动以及在两种模态中的提示注入。我们通过外部有效性检查和跨模型候选选择来策划评估集。我们在文本任务上评估了30种模型配置，在视觉任务上评估了17种，其中分别有24种和12种被排除在候选选择之外的保留模型。我们的实验揭示了几项关键发现。首先，攻击暴露了用于构建和选择的模型之外的漏洞，尽管经过优化的图像扰动即使使用多个替代品也难以转移到许多目标。其次，相对模型鲁棒性在不同任务和攻击类型之间存在差异，并且对输入扰动的抵抗并不一定意味着对提示注入的抵抗。第三，标签一致性检查显著降低了在文本和图像设置中测量的攻击成功率，突出了验证明显失败的重要性。该基准可在https://yifan-lan.github.io/DecisionRobust/获取。

articles.title: From Copying to Composition: How Language Models Develop In-Context Learning
articles.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows language models to adapt their behavior from instructions and demonstrations in a prompt, but accuracy alone does not reveal how contextual information controls their predictions. We study the acquisition and trainability of ICL with a controlled diagnostic that separates copying a nearby demonstration from integrating information across the prompt. Across 17 models, about a third prefer the copied answer, a few are undecided, and the rest prefer the rule-consistent answer, which goes with higher accuracy and with control by the requested value rather than the closest conflicting example. Checkpoint analyses show that models begin prioritizing task-relevant prompt tokens over conflicting examples long before their accuracy improves beyond chance level. In matched training experiments, synthetic documents that define endings and then query them shift models toward compositional responses on the controlled diagnostic, whereas fine-tuning on definition exercises built from rewritten real documents improves accuracy when prompts reassign label meanings. The results suggest that ICL is not acquired as a single, uniform capability. Instead, prompt control, answer preference, construction without candidates, and transfer can develop along distinct trajectories.
articles.titleCn: 从复制到创作：语言模型如何发展情境内学习
articles.abstractCn: 情境学习（ICL）使语言模型能够根据提示中的指令和示例调整其行为，但准确性本身并不能揭示情境信息如何控制其预测。我们通过一项受控诊断研究ICL的习得性和可训练性，该诊断将复制邻近示例与整合提示中的信息区分开来。在17个模型中，大约三分之一倾向于复制答案，少数模棱两可，其余倾向于与规则一致的答案，这既与更高的准确性相关，也与根据请求的值而非最近的冲突示例进行控制相关。检查点分析表明，模型在准确性超过随机水平之前很久就开始优先考虑与任务相关的提示标记，而非冲突示例。在匹配训练实验中，定义结尾然后查询它们的合成文档使模型在受控诊断上转向组合式响应，而基于重写真实文档构建的定义练习微调则当提示重新分配标签含义时提高了准确性。结果表明，ICL并非作为一个单一、统一的能力被习得。相反，提示控制、答案偏好、无候选者的构建和迁移可以沿着不同的轨迹发展。

articles.title: Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.
articles.comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, Under review at Artificial Intelligence Review
articles.titleCn: 迈向对多模态大型语言模型中空间推理的数据中心理解
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）已广泛应用于具身智能体和机器人中的视觉任务。然而，MLLMs在空间推理和感知方面存在局限性。后训练技术显示出提升这些能力的潜力；但目前缺乏针对此类方法的数据驱动调查。在本调查中，我们考虑了用于空间推理任务的预训练MLLMs微调方法，范围从监督学习到强化学习，并重点强调所使用的数据集。我们研究了数据集构建、数据模态和标注，以及模型评估等主题。基于这些主题，我们将研究分为三类：数据集设计、数据集构建与评估。我们发现构建固定空间标注的四种主要方法：规则和模板、LLM提示、程序生成和人工参与。我们还观察到评估方法存在显著差异，包括不同的评分方法、容差指标和基准类型。最后，我们确定了未来研究的机遇，包括统一动态标注、高效空间推理、评估标准化、扩展空间范围以及以人为中心的空间交互。

articles.title: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.
articles.titleCn: GroundGUI：基于高质量数据和蒸馏强化学习的GUI grounding
articles.abstractCn: 构建稳健的图形用户界面（GUI）智能体依赖于多模态视觉基础：将自然语言意图精确映射到屏幕上的可操作组件的能力。尽管存在大量桌面、网络和移动基准测试，但针对不同环境的高保真资源却出奇地稀缺。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了屏幕指代基础数据集（ScreenRef），这是一个全面的GUI基础数据集，包含GUI截图与自然语言指代表达式以及框或点标注。跨越桌面、网络和移动领域，ScreenRef包含586K张截图和超过633K个指代表达式实例，涵盖文本识别、视觉匹配、空间理解以及拒绝场景等任务。为提升模型的指代性能，我们提出了蒸馏到强化学习（D2RL）方法，以解决监督微调泛化能力有限和强化学习中奖励稀疏的问题。利用ScreenRef，我们通过顺序SFT和D2RL训练训练Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，生成了GroundGUI-8B。GroundGUI-8B在ScreenSpot-V2上达到95.2%，在ScreenSpot-Pro上达到63.9%，在OSWorld-G上达到65.4%，在MMBench-GUI L2上达到86.8%，在UI-Vision上达到38.3%。在8B规模的模型中，其性能显著优于在开源数据集上训练的模型，性能可与甚至优于在闭源数据集上训练的模型相当。代码、模型和数据集可在https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI获取。

articles.title: Similar Models, Broken Odds: Where Luce's Axiom Fails in Chatbot Arena
articles.abstract: Chatbot Arena ranks language models with the Bradley-Terry model, which gives each model one score and so assumes Luce's choice axiom. Choice theory predicts where this fails: near-copies are told apart more decisively than their scores imply. On 1.8 million Arena votes, votes between versions of one model are 1.37 times as decisive as Bradley-Terry predicts, between sizes of one generation 1.26 times and between models of one lab 1.12 times; a release a year later gives consistent multipliers, and the effect survives alternative tie treatments, prompt subsets and topics, and timing checks. How alike two models' answers are worded and formatted tracks the effect. A correction with four to six parameters predicts held-out votes better than Bradley-Terry and than models with hundreds of parameters, mostly by modelling ties; frozen and carried to new releases in a test fixed in advance, its gains are concentrated in ties, and better head-to-head odds are not established. The leaderboard order barely moves. With language-model judges and three-answer menus, a near-copy takes votes mostly from its twin when choices are pooled over prompts (log-odds shift +0.10, 95% interval 0.05 to 0.16); within a prompt the shift is smaller and clear for two of four judges.
articles.titleCn: 相似模型，失衡概率：卢斯公理在Chatbot Arena中的失效
articles.abstractCn: Chatbot Arena 使用Bradley-Terry模型对语言模型进行排名，该模型为每个模型分配一个分数，因此假设了Luce的选择公理。选择理论预测了这种方法的失效之处：近乎复制的模型之间的区分比其分数所暗示的要明确得多。在180万次Arena投票中，同一模型不同版本之间的投票比Bradley-Terry模型预测的决断性高出1.37倍，同一代模型规模之间的决断性高出1.26倍，同一实验室模型之间的决断性高出1.12倍；一年后的发布给出了一致的多倍数，且该效应在替代的平局处理、提示子集和主题、以及时间检查中依然存在。两个模型回答措辞和格式的相似程度追踪了这种效应。一个包含四到六个参数的修正模型比Bradley-Terry模型和包含数百个参数的模型更能预测未包含的投票，主要通过模拟平局；在预先设定的测试中冻结并带到新的发布中，其收益集中在平局上，且并未建立更好的头对头概率。排行榜顺序几乎未动。使用语言模型裁判和三选项菜单时，当在提示上合并选择时（对数优势变化+0.10，95%区间0.05至0.16），近乎复制的模型主要从其双胞胎模型那里获得投票；在单个提示内，变化较小，且对于四个裁判中的两个裁判是清晰的。

articles.title: Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization
articles.abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) uses feedback from model responses to improve prompts automatically. However, its effectiveness is usually measured through overall scores, which do not reveal which questions become correct, which previously correct answers become wrong, or whether improvements extend to unseen questions. We introduce Reflective Feedback-Driven Prompt Optimization (RFDPO), a tool that tracks recoveries (incorrect to correct), regressions (correct to incorrect), and churn (all changed outcomes). RFDPO uses this feedback to guide subsequent revisions and records prompt changes throughout optimization. We evaluate RFDPO across five benchmarks covering law, knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, and privacy, using GPT-5 as the optimizer and GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1 Mini as solvers. Our results show that overall accuracy can hide substantial changes: in five of nine configurations, churn was at least five times the absolute net change, and a single-item net change concealed up to 17 changed outcomes. Average validation gains were 7.9 percentage points, compared with 5.2 points on held-out tests. In a controlled ablation on LegalBench-Hearsay, item-level feedback reduced churn by 40% ($p=0.024$) while maintaining similar net gains. These findings motivate reporting recovery, regression, churn, and performance on unseen data alongside overall accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 超越总体准确率：提示优化中的项目级转换
articles.abstractCn: 自动提示优化（APO）利用模型响应的反馈来自动改进提示。然而，其有效性通常通过整体分数来衡量，这些分数并不能揭示哪些问题变得正确，哪些先前正确的答案变得错误，或者改进是否扩展到未见过的问题。我们引入了反思反馈驱动提示优化（RFDPO），这是一种跟踪恢复（错误到正确）、退化（正确到错误）和流失（所有结果变化）的工具。RFDPO利用这些反馈来指导后续的修订，并在优化过程中记录提示的变化。我们在涵盖法律、知识、指令遵循、数学和隐私的五个基准上评估了RFDPO，使用GPT-5作为优化器，GPT-4o-mini和GPT-4.1 Mini作为求解器。我们的结果表明，整体准确率可能掩盖了显著的变化：在九个配置中的五个，流失至少是绝对净变化的五倍，而单个项目的净变化掩盖了高达17个变化的结果。平均验证收益为7.9个百分点，而在保留测试上的收益为5.2个百分点。在LegalBench-Hearsay上的受控消融实验中，项目级反馈将流失减少了40%（$p=0.024$），同时保持了相似的净收益。这些发现表明，在报告整体准确率的同时，还应报告恢复、退化、流失和未见数据的性能。

articles.title: Smart Alone, Blind Together: Why Accuracy Fails to CertifyTheory of Mind in Multi-Agent Teams
articles.abstract: Coordinators that act on what they infer about teammates are usually certified by the accuracy of those inferences. We argue that accuracy is the wrong certificate, for two reasons. First, the accuracy needed to act depends on what a wrong action costs, so the bar belongs to the deployment, not the module. Second, a module's errors are rarely independent, and dependence has a sign: positively associated errors help where their damage overlaps and hurt where it compounds, so an accuracy threshold fails in a predictable direction, and once wrong beliefs interact and can do harm, no rule based on accuracy is right for every module. We test these predictions in task assignment, Level-Based Foraging and Hanabi, with injected errors, trained and Bayesian modules and five language models, and in human judgments. Accuracy fails in both directions, approving harmful language-model deployments in Hanabi, where shared errors compound, and rejecting beneficial ones in task assignment, where costly errors are rare. In our tasks it also buys far less redundancy than independence predicts: from GPT-5.4-mini to Claude Opus 5.5, error on teammates the models have evidence about falls from 32% to 11%, but the chance that all three observers misread one falls only from 16% to 9% (independence: 3.4% to 0.15%). We propose certifying the deployment, with a Blind-Spot Gate that prices error costs, pairwise interactions and measured dependence without deploying the module. On held-out data from the cells it was developed on, it makes no significant false approval in 20 splits (accuracy: 3.2 per split), and in preregistered tests on modules it was not developed on, it recovers what accuracy rejects (seven classifiers: regret 0.004 against 0.479) and catches what accuracy approves (a Bayesian module: significant false approvals in 17 of 20 splits for accuracy, 1 for the gate).
articles.titleCn: 独自聪明，集体盲目：为何准确性未能认证多智能体团队的心智理论
articles.abstractCn: 基于团队队友推断而行动的协调器通常以其推断的准确性获得认证。我们认为准确性并非正确的认证标准，原因有二。首先，采取行动所需的准确性取决于错误行动的成本，因此标准应属于部署而非模块。其次，模块的错误很少独立存在，而依赖性具有方向性：正相关的错误在损害重叠时有助于减轻，但在叠加时造成伤害，因此准确性阈值会以可预测的方向失效，一旦错误信念相互作用并可能造成伤害，基于准确性的规则就不适用于所有模块。我们在任务分配、基于等级的觅食和汉abi游戏中测试了这些预测，使用了注入错误、训练和贝叶斯模块以及五种语言模型和人类判断。准确性在两个方向上都失效，在汉abi游戏中批准了有害的语言模型部署（共享错误叠加），而在任务分配中拒绝了有益的部署（昂贵错误罕见）。在我们的任务中，它获得的冗余远少于独立性预测：从GPT-5.4-mini到Claude Opus 5.5，模型有证据支持的队友错误率从32%降至11%，但三个观察者都误读同一件事的概率仅从16%降至9%（独立性：从3.4%降至0.15%）。我们提出通过部署盲点门来认证部署，该门在未部署模块的情况下对错误成本、成对交互和测量依赖性进行定价。在它所开发的单元的保留数据上，它在20次分割中未出现显著错误批准（准确性：每次分割3.2），在预先注册的测试中，在它未开发的模块上，它恢复了准确性所拒绝的内容（七个分类器：后悔0.004对0.479）并捕获了准确性所批准的内容（贝叶斯模块：准确性在20次分割中有17次出现显著错误批准，而门只有1次）。

articles.title: Pre-Trained Language Models as Zero-Shot Tools for Social Science Research
articles.abstract: Record linkage and demographic inference from names are routine demands in social science. Most approaches to these problems require labeled training data that are difficult or costly to acquire. I show that pre-trained language models perform both tasks accurately without requiring task-specific training. For record linkage, I introduce EnsembleLink, an algorithm that uses pre-trained embeddings alongside string-based scorers to retrieve a short list of candidates and then identify the likeliest matches. EnsembleLink matches or exceeds the performance of most prior approaches while generalizing across scripts and formats that those methods are unable to handle. For ethnicity inference from names, I show that large language models (LLMs) achieve up to 83.8% accuracy on U.S. voter files, compared to 78.0% for name-supplemented BISG. Open-weight models offer reproducible implementations that approach these models in accuracy. Moreover, LLMs are able to infer group membership for religious, caste-based, and other ethnic group categories outside of the United States, and reduce bias in downstream estimates of geographic racial gaps. Where pre-training encodes the world knowledge required by each task, task-specific labels add less information.
articles.titleCn: 预训练语言模型作为社会科学研究的零样本工具
articles.abstractCn: 记录链接和从姓名中进行人口统计推断是社会科学研究中的常规需求。解决这些问题的大多数方法都需要难以获取或成本高昂的标记训练数据。我证明，预训练语言模型可以在无需特定任务训练的情况下，准确执行这两个任务。对于记录链接，我引入了EnsembleLink算法，该算法结合预训练嵌入和基于字符串的评分器来检索候选名单，然后识别最可能的匹配。EnsembleLink的性能与大多数先前方法相当或更优，并且能够泛化到那些方法无法处理的脚本和格式。对于从姓名中推断民族成分，我表明大型语言模型（LLMs）在美国选民文件上的准确率高达83.8%，而补充了姓名的BISG准确率为78.0%。开放权重模型提供了可重复实现的准确度接近这些模型的实现。此外，LLMs能够推断美国以外的宗教、种姓和其他民族群体的群体成员身份，并减少地理种族差距下游估计中的偏差。由于预训练包含了每个任务所需的世界知识，因此特定任务的标签添加的信息较少。

articles.title: Graph Coarsening Enables Escaping Local Optima in Compute-Constrained Nonconvex MAX-CUT
articles.abstract: Because its binary optimization landscape contains exponentially many local optima, MAX-CUT is highly sensitive to initialization. We study Particle Polynomial Relaxation (PPR), a moment-based nonconvex continuous reformulation possessing an advantageous optimization landscape. We warm-start PPR with Combinatorial Multigrid (CMG), a spectral graph-coarsening method that produces structure-aware initial solutions in near-linear time without training data. On \texttt{t2g20} ($n=400$), benchmark instance with known exact optimum, the combined CMG+PPR pipeline reaches $97.5\%$ of optimum on average and $98.4\%$ on the best run. An extended variant with discrete local-search refinement reaches the published optimum on all sixty Biq Mac instances evaluated by a recent neural branch-and-bound method. Using a sparse CSR representation, the same approach scales to G-set instances with up to $20{,}000$ vertices reducing memory requirements by up to $3333\times$ while maintaining a consistent improvement over the CMG warm start. Gains are largest on sparse weighted graphs; on dense graphs we complement the pipeline with spectral sparsification.
articles.titleCn: 图粗化有助于在计算受限的非凸MAX-CUT中跳出局部最优
articles.abstractCn: 由于其二进制优化景观包含指数级的局部最优解，MAX-CUT问题对初始值设置非常敏感。我们研究了粒子多项式松弛（PPR），这是一种基于矩的非凸连续重述方法，其优化景观具有显著优势。我们使用组合多重网格（CMG）对PPR进行预热启动，CMG是一种谱图细化方法，能够在近线性时间内生成结构感知的初始解，且无需训练数据。在t2g20（n=400）的基准实例（已知精确最优解）上，CMG+PPR的联合流程平均达到最优解的97.5%，最佳运行时达到98.4%。一个扩展变体结合离散局部搜索细化，在最近由神经分支定界方法评估的60个Biq Mac实例上均达到了已发表的精确最优解。通过使用稀疏CSR表示，该方法可扩展到包含最多20,000个顶点的G集实例，同时将内存需求减少高达3333倍，并保持对CMG预热启动的持续改进。在稀疏加权图上，收益最为显著；在密集图上，我们通过谱稀疏化来补充该流程。

articles.title: Tracing Morphology, Semantics, and Divergence in Language Acquisition
articles.abstract: Understanding the dynamics of language acquisition in Large Language Models (LLMs) is crucial for uncovering how statistical representations evolve into structured linguistic capabilities. However, most existing studies focus primarily on fully trained models, leaving the developmental trajectory across intermediate training stages largely underexplored. In this work, we leverage intermediate checkpoints from open-source models (e.g., Pythia and OLMo) under teacher-forcing evaluation to systematically investigate language acquisition across training steps and model scales. We focus on four core characteristics: morphological structure acquisition, embedding drift, repetition dominance, and co-occurrence effects. Our findings reveal that models acquire morphological structures well before semantic embeddings stabilize. Furthermore, we show that training dataset size has a positive impact on divergence recognition, while co-occurrence during pre-training and repetition during inference have a negative impact on divergence recognition and associative link generation.
articles.titleCn: 追踪语言习得中的形态学、语义学和分化
articles.abstractCn: 理解大型语言模型（LLMs）中的语言习得动态对于揭示统计表示如何演变为结构化的语言能力至关重要。然而，大多数现有研究主要关注完全训练好的模型，导致中间训练阶段的发展轨迹在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们利用开源模型（例如Pythia和OLMo）在教师强制评估下的中间检查点，系统地研究了跨训练步骤和模型规模的语言习得情况。我们关注四个核心特征：形态结构习得、嵌入漂移、重复主导性和共现效应。我们的研究发现，模型在语义嵌入稳定之前就能很好地习得形态结构。此外，我们表明，训练数据集规模对分歧识别有积极影响，而预训练期间的共现和推理期间的重复对分歧识别和关联链接生成则有负面影响。

articles.title: Who Should We Listen to More? Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition for Pluralistic Alignment
articles.abstract: Pluralistic alignment needs to accommodate diverse preferences under limited human feedback. Using AI simulators to label preference comparisons reduces annotation costs, but variation in simulation accuracy across individuals can leave some people's preferences poorly represented in training. We study how to allocate human feedback across people to construct training data for pluralistic alignment, and how this allocation affects the trained policy. To make this allocation explicit and controllable, we define a social welfare objective over individual supervision utilities that measure label quality. Each query's marginal welfare gain depends on its expected supervision improvement, the recipient's current utility, and application-designated priority. Welfare-Aware Preference Acquisition (WAPA) uses auxiliary reference models to estimate query gains and individual utilities, then selects queries by estimated marginal welfare gain while updating recipient utilities. We prove exact optimality of the acquisition algorithm for the estimated welfare objective under a fixed query budget and model predictions. Experiments on six Roleplay collections and four OpinionQA regions demonstrate improved supervision and controllable allocation tradeoffs. Policy training on four Roleplay collections improves preference prediction for both seen and unseen individuals. When prioritizing a designated group and poorly represented individuals, acquiring human labels for 20% of comparisons recovers 75-86% of the average predictive utility gap between policies trained entirely on AI-generated labels and entirely on ground-truth labels.
articles.titleCn: 我们应该更听从谁？面向多元一致的福利感知偏好获取
articles.abstractCn: 多元对齐需要在有限的用户反馈下适应多样化的偏好。使用AI模拟器对偏好比较进行标注可以降低标注成本，但个体间模拟精度的差异可能导致某些人的偏好在训练中得不到充分体现。我们研究了如何分配用户反馈以构建多元对齐的训练数据，以及这种分配如何影响训练后的策略。为了使这种分配显式且可控，我们定义了一个基于个体监督效用的社会福利目标，用于衡量标注质量。每个查询的边际福利增益取决于其预期的监督改进、接收者的当前效用以及应用指定的优先级。福利感知偏好获取（WAPA）使用辅助参考模型来估计查询增益和个体效用，然后根据估计的边际福利增益选择查询，同时更新接收者效用。我们在固定查询预算和模型预测下证明了获取算法对于估计福利目标的精确最优性。在六个角色扮演数据集和四个观点问答区域上的实验表明，监督质量得到提升，且可控的分配权衡得到改善。在四个角色扮演数据集上进行的策略训练提高了对已见和未见个体的偏好预测。当优先考虑指定群体和代表性较差的个体时，获取20%比较的人类标注，可以恢复在完全基于AI生成标签和完全基于真实标签训练的策略之间的平均预测效用差距的75-86%。

articles.title: Crossing the Gender Binary: Modelling Gendered Reference in Science Fiction and General Fiction
articles.abstract: Science fiction is widely credited with unsettling gender. This article asks whether that holds at the linguistic level, in how readily gendered reference gives way to its counterpart, a neutral term, or other social category, and whether it separates the genre from general fiction. It does so by masking man/men, woman/women, and person/people across same-period science fiction and general fiction corpora and classifying RoBERTa's five likeliest substitutes by gender. Retention and displacement are permutation-tested over five resampling rounds, and the underlying sentences are read closely. Both corpora cross the gender binary in both directions, but unequally: where woman is masked, the model predicts a masculine term about twice as often as it predicts a feminine term where man is masked. Each mismatch marks a statistical surprise, a word the corpus did not expect there. Against this shared pattern, science fiction shows greater gender permeability than the general fiction corpus, placing man in feminine contexts more often than general fiction while the reverse rate holds steady. Its degendering tendency is stronger too, drawing both gendered terms toward the neutral. Beyond the binary, a masked woman also draws substitutes naming a social category and no gender far more often than a masked man does. In measuring the gender permeability of man, woman, and person in linguistic distribution and testing whether genre changes it, the study gives science fiction studies linguistic evidence for thematic claims and computational literary studies a pipeline applicable to other category vocabularies, such as race and class.
articles.titleCn: 跨越性别二元论：科幻小说与普通小说中的性别指称建模
articles.abstractCn: 科幻小说常被认为具有颠覆性别的特质。本文探讨这种颠覆性是否体现在语言层面，即性别化指称如何轻易地让位于其对应的中性术语或其他社会类别，以及它是否将科幻小说与普通小说区分开来。研究通过遮蔽同一时期科幻小说和普通小说语料库中的“man/men”、“woman/women”和“person/people”，并分类RoBERTa最可能的五个替代词的性别来实现。通过五轮重采样进行置换检验，并仔细阅读底层句子。两个语料库在性别二元论的两个方向上都存在交叉，但并不平等：当遮蔽“woman”时，模型预测男性术语的频率大约是预测女性术语的两倍，而当遮蔽“man”时则相反。每次错配都代表一个统计上的意外，即语料库未预料到的词语。在这一共同模式下，科幻小说比普通小说语料库表现出更高的性别渗透性，在女性语境中更频繁地使用“man”，而反向频率保持稳定。其去性别化趋势也更强，将两个性别术语都拉向中性。在二元论之外，被遮蔽的女性比被遮蔽的男性更频繁地吸引到命名社会类别且无性别的替代词。通过测量“man”、“woman”和“person”在语言分布中的性别渗透性，并检验体裁是否改变这一渗透性，本研究为科幻小说研究提供了语言证据以支持其主题主张，并为计算文学研究提供了一条适用于其他类别词汇（如种族和阶级）的流程。

articles.title: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
articles.abstract: Sparse attention reduces the KV-cache traffic that dominates long-context LLM decoding, but practical methods largely operate at coarse granularity. Token-level selection offers finer control, yet presents two challenges: low-dimensional scoring may lose query--key structure needed for accurate ranking, while gathering scattered selected tokens can offset the resulting latency benefit. We introduce Joint Subspace Sparse Attention (JSSA) to address both challenges. For selection quality, JSSA learns a shared low-dimensional query--key subspace by minimizing token-score preservation error. We upper-bound the resulting non-convex objective with a tractable marginal objective that admits a closed-form spectral solution; direct refinement of the exact objective provides no measurable improvement in the tested settings. For execution efficiency, we develop a gather-free token-level indexed-attention kernel that supports distinct per-KV-head selections under the standard grouped-query attention (GQA) KV-cache layout. Across standard GQA, hybrid sliding-window/global attention, and Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) models, JSSA consistently remains close to full-KV accuracy while avoiding the substantial generation-length inflation and architecture-dependent failures observed with competing methods. On an NVIDIA B200 GPU, JSSA achieves up to $6.43\times$ the decoding throughput of full-KV attention at 128K context. JSSA achieves reasoning accuracy comparable to model-native DSA without model training and reaches 96--99\% of its decoding throughput even at 700B scale large models.
articles.titleCn: 联合子空间稀疏注意力机制用于高效长上下文解码
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏注意力机制减少了主导长上下文大语言模型解码的KV缓存流量，但现有实用方法大多在粗粒度级别操作。基于token级别的选择提供了更精细的控制，但也面临两个挑战：低维评分可能丢失准确排序所需的查询-键结构，而收集分散的选中token可能会抵消由此产生的延迟收益。我们引入联合子空间稀疏注意力（JSSA）以解决这两个挑战。对于选择质量，JSSA通过最小化token评分保留误差来学习一个共享的低维查询-键子空间。我们用可处理的边际目标上界化所得非凸目标，该边际目标允许闭式谱解；在测试设置中，对精确目标的直接优化并未带来可测量的改进。对于执行效率，我们开发了一种无需收集的基于索引的注意力核，该核在标准的分组查询注意力（GQA）KV缓存布局下支持每个KV头的独立选择。在标准GQA、混合滑动窗口/全局注意力和多头潜在注意力（MLA）模型中，JSSA始终接近全KV精度，同时避免了竞争方法中观察到的显著生成长度膨胀和架构依赖性失败。在NVIDIA B200 GPU上，JSSA在128K上下文时实现了高达6.43倍的解码吞吐量。JSSA在不进行模型训练的情况下实现了与模型原生DSA相当的推理精度，并在700B规模大模型上达到其解码吞吐量的96%~99%。

articles.title: Can LLMs Access their World Knowledge for Event Prediction?
articles.abstract: Recent work has questioned whether large language models (LLMs) can be useful for temporal event prediction. Despite vast pretrained world knowledge, LLMs often underperform simpler specialized models. We ask whether this knowledge is truly inaccessible, or whether current methods fail to present event prediction in a form LLMs can use. We argue for the latter and show that LLMs become effective event forecasters when the interface is designed around two choices. The first grounds each event in a natural-language description, and the second separates event semantics from the prediction space to prevent semantic bias from label associations. To test this, we introduce DescribeEvent, a benchmark of ~150K events across seven datasets and six domains with event-level descriptions. We find that capable LLMs substantially benefit from descriptions and symbolic labels, outperforming description-free variants and non-LLM baselines, while weaker models gain little. These results suggest that accessing LLM world knowledge for event prediction is an interface problem, and that event descriptions offer a practical way to elicit the knowledge LLMs already encode.
articles.titleCn: LLMs 能否用于事件预测？
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究质疑了大型语言模型（LLMs）在时间事件预测中的有效性。尽管拥有庞大的预训练世界知识，LLMs往往表现不如更简单的专用模型。我们探究这究竟是知识真正无法被利用，还是现有方法未能以LLMs可理解的形式呈现事件预测。我们认为后者是更可能的情况，并证明当界面围绕两个选择进行设计时，LLMs能有效成为事件预测者。第一个选择是将每个事件基于自然语言描述，第二个选择是将事件语义与预测空间分离，以防止标签关联带来的语义偏差。为验证这一点，我们引入了DescribeEvent，这是一个包含约15万个事件、跨越七个数据集和六个领域的基准，每个事件都有事件级别的描述。我们发现，强大的LLMs能显著受益于描述和符号标签，其表现优于无描述的变体和非LLM基线，而较弱的模型则收益甚微。这些结果表明，利用LLMs的世界知识进行事件预测是一个界面问题，而事件描述提供了一种实用方法，能够激发LLMs已编码的知识。

articles.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Multilingual Abstractive Summarization: A Comprehensive Study of English and Bengali
articles.abstract: Abstractive summarization remains challenging across languages, where linguistic quality and factual consistency may diverge, particularly in low-resource settings. We present a standardized zero-shot benchmark of eight closed-source and open-weight LLMs on size-matched English and Bengali XL-Sum test sets. Our evaluation combines lexical and semantic metrics with reference-free factuality verification and multidimensional LLM-as-a-Judge assessment, providing a comprehensive analysis of both surface-level quality and factual reliability in multilingual summarization. Results reveal substantial cross-lingual variation: GPT-5.6 Luna leads several English lexical metrics but does not maintain the same advantage in Bengali, where LLaMA 3.3 70B achieves the highest ROUGE and BLEU scores. Gemini 2.5 Flash obtains the highest observed Bengali factuality score. Furthermore, evaluation methods produce different model rankings, highlighting the limitations of relying on a single metric for multilingual summarization assessment. These findings demonstrate that strong English summarization performance does not necessarily transfer to Bengali and emphasize the need for comprehensive evaluation frameworks for low-resource languages.
articles.titleCn: 评估多语言抽象摘要的大型语言模型：英印地语全面研究
articles.abstractCn: 抽取式摘要跨语言仍具挑战性，其中语言质量和事实一致性可能存在差异，尤其在低资源环境下。我们提出一个标准化的零样本基准，涵盖八种闭源和开源大型语言模型，在规模匹配的英语和孟加拉语XL-Sum测试集上展开评估。我们的评价结合了词汇和语义指标，参考无关的事实性验证，以及多维度LLM作为评判者的评估，全面分析了多语言摘要中的表层质量与事实可靠性。结果揭示出显著的跨语言差异：GPT-5.6 Luna在多个英语词汇指标上领先，但在孟加拉语中未保持相同优势，其中LLaMA 3.3 70B实现了最高的ROUGE和BLEU得分。Gemini 2.5 Flash获得了观察到的最高孟加拉语事实性得分。此外，不同的评价方法产生了不同的模型排名，突显了依赖单一指标评估多语言摘要的局限性。这些发现表明，强大的英语摘要性能未必能迁移至孟加拉语，并强调了为低资源语言建立综合评价框架的必要性。

articles.title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
articles.abstract: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.
articles.titleCn: ChunkAct：面向自主机器人的动作分块技术
articles.abstractCn: 自主机器人技术将大型语言模型（LLM）智能体置于机器人控制回路中，在记忆的指导下，该智能体组合感知、运动和视觉语言行动（VLA）工具，从而无需重新训练即可泛化到新任务。这种泛化以效率为代价。每个基本操作都需要对完整交互历史进行一轮LLM推理，因此每个场景的成本随着基本操作的数量的增加而增加。我们发现这种推理很大程度上是冗余的：一旦选择了子目标，其基本操作就遵循记忆中已经规定好的常规。我们提出了ChunkAct，它将动作分块引入自主机器人技术。在线上，一次调用就能启动一个由链式基本操作组成的分块，该分块可以自主执行，只有在失败时才会返回控制权。离线时，ChunkAct将记忆编译成这些分块，因此测试时的执行是无记忆的，规划器仅用于需要推理的决策。因此，LLM计算量随着决策数量的增加而增加，而不是基本操作的数量的增加。在LIBERO-Pro上，ChunkAct比自主机器人技术的当前最佳水平提高了5.0个百分点，同时需要2.9倍的LLM调用次数更少、4.4倍的输入标记更少、2.3倍的输出标记更少。

articles.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
articles.abstract: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.
articles.titleCn: Tev：使用密集进度奖励扩展长时程智能体环境
articles.abstractCn: 长时程智能体因其能够在数小时至数天内自主执行经济价值高的任务而备受关注，这一能力对于自动化发现和递归自我改进（RSI）至关重要。然而，开源模型在长时程任务上仍面临挑战，主要原因是缺乏训练数据和可行的训练方案，而扩展两者都十分困难：长而复杂的任务难以管理和验证，且其回报稀疏。我们解决了这些问题。首先，我们引入了Tev-Gym，这是首个具有可验证、密集、渐进式回报的长时程智能体训练数据集——包含7个领域的1,170个经过验证的任务环境。它基于一种以潜在世界优先的方法构建，该方法首先构建一个潜在世界：一个完整且正确的任务领域、工作流程以及每一步后预期状态的隐藏规范。然后，每个任务都从该规范中逐步渲染成面向智能体的环境，从而实现可控的复杂性和自然的进度指标。其次，我们将这一指标转化为训练方案：通过进度潜力回报塑形（PPRS），我们将进度转化为每步的密集回报，从而提高训练效率并使原本难以处理的任务变得可训练。使用该方案训练得到了Tev-27B，它在智能体期末考试计算与数学科学领域（ALE-CM）上取得了显著提升，与GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5在Pass@5指标上持平。尽管仅在ALE相关数据上训练，它泛化到了终端基准（TB）3.0和4.0子集，超越了GLM 5.2和Gemini 3.7 Flash，并在TB 2.1等中时程任务上达到了Claude Opus 4.8级别的性能。

articles.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
articles.abstract: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy.
