We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess.
articles.titleCn: 无懈可击：无需训练的对比解码用于高效推理
articles.abstractCn: 推理模型通过长链思考（CoT）实现优异性能，但往往消耗超出解决问题所需数量的token。现有的缩短CoT方法需要针对每个模型进行额外训练，向模型的隐藏状态添加固定引导向量，或使用解码启发式方法（如提前停止或禁止“等待”等词语），这些方法可能会降低准确率。我们提出了DoubtLess，一种无需训练的解码方法，其中较小的推理模型引导大型模型走向简洁。小型模型两次读取大型模型的CoT：一次被提示简洁（简洁思考者），一次被提示冗长（冗长思考者），并将其两个logit向量之间的差异（乘以一个强度因子）在CoT的每一步添加到大型模型的logits中。在七个竞赛数学、研究生级科学和竞赛编程的基准测试中，DoubtLess在不改变准确率的情况下将Qwen3-32B的CoT缩短了31%，优于五个推理时基线。我们还展示了DoubtLess在一个自我调试的编码代理中，在不改变任务性能的情况下将每轮思考token减少20%。它也泛化到另外两个模型家族，且准确率保持不变。当与基于训练的压缩结合时，它进一步缩短了已为简洁训练过的模型的CoT。消融实验和行为分析表明，DoubtLess减少了重复检查，大部分token节省是在正确答案首次出现在CoT之后实现的。我们的代码可在https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess获取。

articles.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
articles.abstract: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
articles.titleCn: 混合推理代理
articles.abstractCn: 我们如何构建一个能够超越人类语言思考，但在外部环境中仍通过语言行动的智能体？现代大型语言模型智能体仍然通过文本进行推理和交互，而潜在推理提供了一种高效的内部媒介，但缺乏原生工具访问和推理透明性。我们通过混合推理智能体（HybridAgents）将这两个方向结合起来，该智能体在整个统一生成过程中动态地在潜在推理和基于文本的交互之间导航。在架构上，轻量级的混合链接（HybridLink）实现了文本和潜在模式之间的无缝转换，而智能体的持续工作记忆则保留了跨多轮的无损混合上下文。这些设计既保留了集成工具的智能体能力，又使潜在思维可直接被检查。基于此架构，我们进一步开发了专门用于混合推理的术后训练算法：混合SFT通过教导主干与混合链接协调来稳定集成工具的混合生成，然后混合RL通过学习何时在潜在空间中思考、何时通过文本行动来扩展推理。我们在11个涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和智能体推理的基准测试中，在3个模型规模下评估了混合智能体。与前沿的大型语言模型智能体和涵盖基于文本及潜在方法的智能体框架相比，混合智能体始终如一地提高了10.4%的性能，同时实现了35.5%-54.7%的token减少、1.8倍-2.6倍的推理速度提升和2.7倍-3.7倍的成本节约。代码和数据可在https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent获取。

articles.title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.abstract: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On four EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, agent-built models surpass the state of the art and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.
articles.titleCn: 人类建造的最后一个遥感模型？将任何地球观测任务视为递归自我改进
articles.abstractCn: 地球观测（EO）模型目前仍需人工构建。对于每个新任务，专家设计训练方案并在基准上进行调优。我们证明这一流程可以交由智能体完成。任何可验证的任务都可以转化为一个“套具”（harness）和一个“验证器”（verifier），其中套具定义智能体可使用的内容，验证器定义何为成功。通过标记基准、独立传感器、物理模型或重复观测同一地点，每个地球观测任务都可以变得可验证。仅凭这两个组件，通用编程智能体即可构建地球观测模型，并基于其自身输出进行递归改进。以往被视为独立研究问题的设置，从少量标签学习到跨领域适应，都变成了套具和验证器的选择。在涵盖光学、SAR和多光谱时序影像的四项地球观测基准测试中，智能体构建的模型超越了现有最佳水平，并从约1%的训练标签中保持了大部分精度。这为地球观测建立了一个新范式：人类设计套具和验证器，智能体构建模型，使得地球观测模型随智能体的进步而提升。

articles.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
articles.abstract: With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.
articles.titleCn: OmniCompass：全模态视频定位和理解的综合基准
articles.abstractCn: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的快速发展，评估其视频理解能力变得日益重要。现有的视频理解基准仅覆盖了部分评估维度，限制了全模态视频理解的系统诊断。我们引入了OmniCompass，这是一个用于全模态视频定位和理解的整体基准。OmniCompass定义了两个评估轨道：OmniCompass-VL评估在需要视觉证据的任务中表现出的视觉语言模型，而OmniCompass-AV则评估在全模态模型在需要视听联合证据的任务中的表现。每个轨道包含三个互补的任务：时间定位（TG）、空间定位（SG）和问答（QA），分别评估参照目标何时出现、出现在何处以及发生了什么。问答涵盖了OmniCompass-VL中的五种感知类别和三种推理类别，以及OmniCompass-AV中的三种感知类别和两种推理类别。OmniCompass-VL包含820个视频和2,460个跨领域和三种时长类型（短、中、长）的实例。一个叙事丰富且音频丰富的子集形成了OmniCompass-AV，包含240个视频和720个实例。每个实例在两种配对设置下进行评估：纯文本和文本+图像，通过文本和视觉语言指导来指定相同的目标。所有实例均经过人工标注和多轮质量验证。对50个MLLM的评估表明，开源模型仍然落后于专有模型，特别是在视听理解方面。即使对于领先模型，精确的时间和空间定位仍然具有挑战性，并且它们在配对目标规范中的预测仍然存在不一致性。

articles.title: Read the Room Before Your Model Generates
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the Scenario-Actor, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.
articles.titleCn: 在您的模型生成之前先阅读房间
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常依赖采样温度来调节其输出的随机性。主流的温度选择方法通常涉及固定的启发式全局设置和上下文或标记级别的校准，而不是对交际场景的几何可解释表示。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个简单且可解释的温度选择框架——场景演员（Scenario-Actor），该框架根据推断的场景特征来调整解码。场景演员从Transformer隐藏状态中提取与场景相关的结构，并根据场景嵌入（一种对交际场景的结构化几何表示）来确定温度。实证结果表明，在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，场景演员在交互式社交场景中实现了强大的目标完成性能，在开放式指令遵循方面取得了显著提升，并且在多轮对话方面与多个基线相比表现出具有竞争力的性能。

articles.title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
articles.abstract: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.
articles.titleCn: 回译仍然重要：利用单语数据通过大型语言模型进行低资源机器翻译
articles.abstractCn: 预训练的大型语言模型（LLMs）在零样本和少样本场景下对许多任务都非常有效。对于低资源语言的机器翻译，显而易见的选项是少样本提示和在小规模平行语料集上进行微调。我们提出：如果还有中等规模的低资源单语数据可用，会怎样呢？我们认为，与其继续预训练，更有效地利用这些数据的方法是预LLM时代的回译（BT）技术。当前的微调LLMs翻译每种语言中的单语句子，并将生成的句子对反向训练它。平行语料集的更新交替进行，以实现稳定学习。在奥里亚语和斯瓦希里语上拥有1K平行对时，BT在领域指标上以7.7至16.4倍的XCOMET-XXL分数超越了继续预训练到低资源语言。使用束搜索解码的中间翻译，它也超越了拥有10倍平行数据的模型。从平行数据中检索的上下文示例进一步改进了BT。我们还分析了单语文本的来源、质量和数量。在五种低资源语言中，以印地语作为高资源对照，并使用两个3B骨干网络，BT通过平行语料集微调，将翻译到低资源语言的XCOMET-XXL分数提高了16%至173%。对奥里亚语和梵语进行的盲法人工评估与自动指标结果一致。

articles.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
articles.abstract: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
articles.titleCn: 自我进化的智能体系统
articles.abstractCn: 自我进化机制通过更新代理的软件框架，包括提示、记忆、工作流和可执行组件，同时保持模型权重不变。我们形式化了一个反馈驱动的流程，其中接受的修订可以在多次运行中持续存在。该框架将更新目标与提案和准入机制分离，区分了解释状态的变化与工具、代码、仓库级控制逻辑和插件组合的修订。我们通过进化优化中的搜索过程进行特征描述，并通过持续PAC学习检验其可靠性。在明确假设下，分析结果给出了预期泛化界、基于历史回归预算的保留界，以及使用新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。我们研究了持续的自我进化修订如何影响知识共享和组织工作流，对科学可靠性、物理安全和机构问责制具有启示意义。先前工作中的案例说明了模型-机制协同设计、分布式执行和插件重用。可靠的部署要求随着任务分布和评估者的变化进行持续验证，并需要独立的防护措施来保障学习过程、运行时权限和后果性操作。我们提供了关于相关工作、理论、算法、评估、应用以及Harness RSI更广泛影响的全面66页讨论，并附带持续更新的代码和补充材料，可在https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI获取。

articles.title: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
articles.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.
articles.titleCn: 技能脚手架：基于策略自适应技能信用分配和选择性注入的智能体强化学习脚手架
articles.abstractCn: 基于代理的强化学习（RL）使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够从具有可验证结果的多人交互中学习。文本技能可以通过将先前的交互提炼为可重用的指导来改进探索。然而，现有的基于技能的RL方法通常要么假设技能注入是有益的，要么依赖于间接反馈或 rollout 密集型评估来评估其效用。我们的初步研究表明，在有限采样下，用于技能信用分配的基于 rollout 的效用估计既昂贵又不稳定，而技能收益在不同候选者之间有所不同，并且取决于当前策略在每个查询上的能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了 SkillScaffold，这是一个策略自适应的训练框架，它结合了低成本的技能效用估计和选择性技能注入。通过重用具有可验证结果的训练轨迹，SkillScaffold 通过结果感知似然比较生成候选技能并估计其效用，而无需候选者特定的环境 rollout。所得效用指导何时以及注入哪个技能，在没有候选者估计有助于的情况下保留无技能执行。联合训练使生成器能够产生适应执行者演变的技能。框架化的RL鼓励技能内化以进行无技能推理。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 和 $τ^2$-Bench 上的实验表明，在短期和长期任务中，与强大的基于代理的RL和基于技能的RL基线相比，均取得了提升。消融实验和进一步分析支持了基于效用选择和放弃的重要性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold 获取。

articles.title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics
articles.abstract: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.
articles.titleCn: SEAR：自进化智能机器人
articles.abstractCn: 前沿语言模型代理现在可以自行改进机器人：它们编写控制代码、测试代码，并将有效部分作为技能和记忆保留下来以供下一个任务使用。我们介绍了SEAR（自我进化代理机器人），这是一个围绕两个问题的框架和基准。代理是否真的在学习，还是仅仅尝试次数更多？它所学习的内容是否仍然有助于新任务、新模拟器以及真实机器人？该框架以三种模式运行代理：编写成为策略的代码（代码即策略）、在控制循环中实时行动（代理即策略），或作为研究人员微调视觉-语言-行动模型（自动研究）。基准测试增加了控制措施，以区分保留的经验与重复尝试、熟悉任务、特权模拟器状态、更大预算和运气。在七个前沿语言模型、330个模拟任务和五个物理任务，以及超过四年的代理运行时间内，我们强调了三个发现。首先，机器人代理的学习曲线既取决于总时间预算，也取决于任务难度相对于模型能力的比值。较难的任务使得较长的会话变得值得；在较容易的任务上，重新进行短尝试的效果同样好。其次，控制代码和共享例程可以跨任务和模拟器迁移，而特定任务的解决方案则不能。在真实机器人上，我们观察到代理设计的练习与新颖的人类设计的场景之间存在性能差距。第三，不同的模型以不同的方式更有效地进化。有些模型在实时行动时表现最佳，而另一些模型则先编写代码。并且，纯文本模型可以与相当的多模态模型保持同步：感知有助于错误评估，但代理推理和工具使用可能更重要。我们发布了基准测试和代码库以支持未来的研究。

articles.title: Where Do LLM Ensemble Gains Come From? Decomposing Candidate Value, Diversity, and Aggregation
articles.abstract: LLM ensemble gains are often measured against a single baseline, but the value attributed to additional candidates can change with the comparison used. We study an LLM aggregator under four matched conditions: Direct (no candidates), Single-slot (one candidate in a multi-slot interface), Duplicate (one candidate repeated), and Multi-candidate (separately generated candidates). Under either non-diverse control, overall candidate gain (CIV) splits algebraically into an additional-candidate contrast (DSV) and a candidate-context contrast (CCV); the split, but not CIV, depends on the chosen control. On MultiHopRAG model diversity (k=2), the repetition gap Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75] quantifies the difference between gains measured against Duplicate and Single-slot. On a matched FRAMES stronger-panel extension (n=200, k=3, aggregator output limit 4096), paired Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]; within panels, Rep changes sign (original -6.33; stronger +3.33). In FRAMES evidence aggregation, candidate-context contrasts remain strongly negative under both non-diverse controls. Our results show why ensemble evaluations should state the reference control before attributing gains to additional candidates.
articles.titleCn: LLM集成收益的来源是什么？分解候选价值、多样性和聚合
articles.abstractCn: LLM集成模型的收益通常与单一基线进行比较，但附加候选人的价值会随着所使用的比较方式而变化。我们研究了在四种匹配条件下的一种LLM聚合器：直接（无候选者）、单槽（多槽界面中一个候选者）、重复（一个候选者重复）和多候选者（分别生成的候选者）。在非多样性控制下，整体候选者收益（CIV）会代数地分解为附加候选者对比（DSV）和候选者上下文对比（CCV）；这种分解，但不是CIV，取决于所选择的控制。在MultiHopRAG模型多样性（k=2）下，重复差距Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75]量化了与重复和单槽比较的收益差异。在一个匹配的FRAMES强面板扩展（n=200, k=3, 聚合器输出限制4096）中，配对Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]；在面板内，Rep改变符号（原始-6.33；强+3.33）。在FRAMES证据聚合中，候选者上下文对比在两种非多样性控制下均保持强负值。我们的结果表明，在将收益归因于附加候选者之前，集成评估应说明参考控制。

articles.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.abstract: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon
articles.titleCn: 轻装前行，构建面向长时程智能体的面向对象情境
articles.abstractCn: 长时程代理在持久任务状态中累积进展，但会反复处理描述进展如何实现的交互历史。这自然引出一个问题：长时程上下文能否围绕可重用的进展而非产生它的历史来组织？在本文中，我们介绍了 CarryOn，一个面向对象的上下文运行时，它围绕可重用的任务对象组织延续。CarryOn 不将压缩历史或重建的进展记录视为延续的主要基础，而是从延续载体、补充执行上下文和最近的交互活动尾部构建上下文视图。一个核心挑战是在其周围历史被淘汰后保持这个可重用基础的有效性：CarryOn 如何在不每次折叠时都重建完整表示的情况下更新这个基础？CarryOn 跨折叠维护载体记录，根据绑定证据和适用环境检查修订受影响的记录，同时传递未受影响的记录并联合更新执行上下文。在 OSWorld 2.0 和 BrowseComp-Plus 上的实验显示，分别提升了 5.8% 和 7.0% 的收益，同时将总 token 使用量分别降低了 51.9% 和 22.9%。项目页面：https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

articles.title: BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents' capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five Who&When and Who&When Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2-11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.
articles.titleCn: 刀锋：审计信息使用以归因于LLM多智能体系统中的故障
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型多智能体系统通过跨专业角色、工具和工作流程的协作来扩展单个智能体的能力。然而，协作使得故障诊断更加困难：一个智能体可能会误解正确结果，而其他智能体则继续传播错误。因此，故障归因旨在识别负责的智能体和决定性的错误步骤。最近的方法追踪依赖关系，但知道信息来源并不等同于知道信息出错的地方。我们引入了BLADE（通过审计依赖证据进行责任定位），这是一个无需训练的框架，它超越了追踪信息，转而审计其使用情况。使用Jev进行结构化概率判断，BLADE利用依赖概率选择相关的源决策传递点进行审计。在这些传递点，它检查接收到的决策是否忠实使用其来源，并符合任务要求，从而区分错误引入、传播和修复。这些发现为全局诊断提供了依据，考虑了所有执行步骤。在没有参考答案的情况下，BLADE在五个Who&When和Who&When Pro子集的1,228次失败运行中，在共享的Jev决策接口下，在八种策略中实现了最佳或并列最佳的步骤准确率，比All-at-once策略高出2.2-11.1个百分点。使责任证据明确化，为构建更具可解释性和可靠性的智能体系统提供了途径。

articles.title: Rubrics from the Task, Verdicts from Evidence: Pointwise Rubric Rewards with Tool-Augmented Judges
articles.abstract: Rubric-based reward models (RMs) evaluate responses against explicit criteria. However, existing methods often derive criteria from observed response candidates, introducing response-induced bias that may limit rubric generalizability. Their judges also struggle with mechanical constraints when relying on reading alone, and commonly used pairwise judges provide only relative preferences, complicating their direct use for policy optimization. We propose ReVeR, a pointwise rubric RM that derives hard rules and graded principles by reasoning about the instruction alone and evaluates responses independently through tool-augmented judging. Both components are trained through label-blind distillation, in which preference labels only filter a teacher's outputs, yielding ReVeR-Traces, a large-scale dataset of rubric-reasoning and judging trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that ReVeR outperforms pairwise rubric RMs in average preference accuracy, most clearly on instruction following, as well as in test-time scaling and downstream policy optimization. We further find that generator RL improves preference accuracy while reducing rubric fidelity, and that higher preference accuracy does not necessarily translate into better downstream policies. These findings highlight that rubric fidelity, preference accuracy, and downstream utility are distinct properties, shedding light on future RM research.
articles.titleCn: 任务中的评分标准，证据中的裁决：基于工具增强的裁判的点式评分奖励
articles.abstractCn: 基于标准的奖励模型（RMs）通过明确标准来评估响应。然而，现有方法通常从观察到的响应候选中提取标准，这会引入响应诱导的偏差，可能限制标准的泛化能力。他们的裁判者在仅依赖阅读时也难以应对机械约束，而常用的成对裁判者仅提供相对偏好，这增加了它们直接用于策略优化的复杂性。我们提出了ReVeR，一种基于标准的点式奖励模型，它仅通过推理指令本身来推导硬规则和分级原则，并通过工具增强的裁判独立评估响应。这两个组件都通过标签无关的蒸馏进行训练，其中偏好标签仅筛选教师的输出，从而生成ReVeR-Traces，这是一个大规模的基于标准推理和裁判轨迹的数据集。实验表明，ReVeR在平均偏好准确率方面优于成对基于标准的奖励模型，尤其是在指令遵循方面，以及在测试时扩展和下游策略优化方面。我们进一步发现，生成式强化学习可以提高偏好准确率，同时降低标准保真度，并且更高的偏好准确率并不一定转化为更好的下游策略。这些发现强调了标准保真度、偏好准确率和下游效用是不同的属性，为未来的奖励模型研究提供了启示。

articles.title: Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports
articles.abstract: Evaluation for automatic crisis reporting should measure what practitioners need, not what is convenient to compare. Through LLM-assisted, author-approved content analysis, we derive a 15-slot information schema from professional humanitarian situation reports using qualitative content analysis, then evaluate 121 human and 261 LLM-generated reports across five disasters and three hazard types. Under google/gemini-3.7-flash on Cyclone Idai, the best machine arm is nominally above the empirical human ceiling (0.827 vs. 0.821), but the difference is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95\% bootstrap CI $[-.049,.059]$; permutation $p=.852$), and the ordering does not replicate under openai/gpt-5.6-luna. On a blind 100-item Idai sample, the author agrees with the Gemini judge at 0.910 accuracy and unweighted Cohen's $κ=.799$. All four judges clear the plan's raw-agreement criterion of .7; only Gemini reaches .7 on chance-corrected $κ$. Across the three primary events, machine reports reproduce 5.4-11.0% of same-day official figures. Across those same events, raw exact-number matching links 14.3-19.6% of official figures and 85.4-90.1% of machine figures to the social stream; manual audit confirms 45/50 declared absences, 4/25 official matches, and 24/25 machine matches semantically. The issuing-provenance gap is positive in all 12 observed event-judge cells: report date, organisation, series, and authority were not supplied at professional-report coverage in any cell. On the three primary events, ROUGE-L is uninformative, BERTScore is negatively associated with completeness after multiplicity correction, and a generic LLM judge changes sign.
articles.titleCn: 看起来完整并不代表扎根：评估大型语言模型态势报告与人类撰写的情况报告
articles.abstractCn: 对自动危机报告的评估应衡量从业者所需，而非便于比较的内容。通过LLM辅助、作者认可的内容分析，我们采用定性内容分析法从专业人道主义局势报告中推导出15槽位信息架构，然后评估了跨越五种灾害和三种灾害类型的121份人类报告和261份LLM生成的报告。在Cyclone Idai上使用google/gemini-3.7-flash，最佳机器模型的得分名义上高于经验人类上限（0.827 vs. 0.821），但差异在统计上无法区分于零（95% bootstrap CI $[-.049,.059]$；置换$p=.852$），且排序在openai/gpt-5.6-luna上无法重现。在盲测的100项Idai样本中，作者与Gemini裁判的准确度为0.910，未加权Cohen's $κ$为0.799。所有四位裁判均通过0.7的原始协议标准；仅Gemini达到校正后的$κ$为0.7。在三个主要事件中，机器报告复制了5.4-11.0%的同日官方数据。在相同事件中，原始精确数字匹配将14.3-19.6%的官方数据与85.4-90.1%的机器数据链接到社交流；人工审核确认了50个中45个声明的缺失、25个官方匹配中的4个、25个机器匹配中的24个在语义上成立。在所有12个观察到的事件-裁判单元中，发布来源差距均为正值：在任何单元中，专业报告覆盖时均未提供报告日期、组织、系列和权威信息。在三个主要事件中，ROUGE-L无信息量，BERTScore在多重性校正后与完整性呈负相关，而通用LLM裁判的符号发生改变。

articles.title: PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.
articles.titleCn: PreciseCoder：超越单元测试奖励的忠实且可泛化的调试
articles.abstractCn: 从单元测试中进行强化学习是训练后代码模型的标准做法，但单元测试仅询问最终程序是否通过。我们分析了这种仅依赖单元测试的奖励在调试过程中向模型传递了什么信息，发现虽然它提高了通过率，但也教会了模型进行更多编辑，并在原本正确的代码中编造错误。我们引入了PreciseCoder，这是一种训练算法，它将单元测试奖励与语义验证的局部化编辑信号相结合，这种信号与更小的编辑和更高的通过率相关。在4B、9B和27B模型上，PreciseCoder将平均编辑行数从7-15减少到3，同时保持了与仅依赖单元测试训练相同的通过率。仅通过单行错误进行训练的PreciseCoder可以泛化到仓库级别的程序修复，其中它通过更小的补丁解决了更多问题。其精确性也能从较弱的模型迁移到较强的模型：给定一个9B PreciseCoder模型的推理轨迹，前沿模型如GPT-5.6 Sol和Qwen3.8-Max无需额外训练即可在编辑精确性上提升4.6-12.4个百分点。对思考轨迹的语言学分析表明，我们的奖励鼓励模型对单行进行推理，指明有问题的行，并形成一致的错误假设。

articles.title: On the Monitorability of Natural Language Autoencoders: Identification vs Discrimination
articles.abstract: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) are proposed as oversight tools for language models: an Activation Verbaliser (AV) writes an English explanation of an activation vector, and an Activation Reconstructor (AR) maps the explanation back to a vector. Their value for oversight depends on a human monitor being able to tell a true account of an activation from a false one, given the Av's explanation. We formalise NLA training and NLA oversight deployment as two different referential games from Emergent Communication: training is a generative referential game, while oversight is a discriminative, multi-modal, partially-observable referential game played over a many-to-many relation between the monitored language model's activations and the accounts that are true of them. The gap between the two games predicts that AV's explanations will identify which activation they describe without discriminating its true account from closely matched false ones, since training never asks explanations to rule anything out. Using the NLA's own AR as a maximally-sympathetic surrogate monitor model, we experimentally confirm this theoretical insight on one released checkpoint: true accounts beat accounts of other activations in all 320 comparisons, but beat fluent rivals differing in a single claim only 60.2% of the time (std.err. 6.7%, chance at 50%, $n = 35$). A meaning-preserving rewrite by an uninvolved model costs only 2.1% of the distance to another activation's account, so the failure is not due to the NLA pair having developed private conventions in the AV's explanations. Our rival accounts test only transcript-level truths, which the monitored language model's conversation settles, so these results bound the easiest case and leave claims about the monitored model's own processing untested. We state conjectures that would make both results consequences of the framework.
articles.titleCn: 自然语言自动编码器的可监控性：识别与区分
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言自动编码器（NLAs）被提出作为语言模型的监督工具：激活词述器（AV）为激活向量撰写英文解释，激活重构器（AR）将解释映射回向量。它们在监督中的价值取决于人类监控者能否根据AV的解释区分真实的激活描述和虚假的激活描述。我们将NLAs训练和NLAs监督部署形式化为涌现通信中的两种不同指称游戏：训练是一种生成式指称游戏，而监督是一种判别式、多模态、部分可观察的指称游戏，该游戏在监控语言模型的激活与其真实描述之间建立多对多的关系。两种游戏之间的差距预测，AV的解释将识别它们描述的激活，但无法区分其真实描述与密切匹配的虚假描述，因为训练从未要求解释来排除任何内容。我们使用NLAs自身的AR作为最大同情的代理监控模型进行实验，验证了这一理论见解：在一个已发布的检查点中，真实描述在所有320次比较中都优于其他激活的描述，但在与仅在一个声明上不同的流畅竞争者比较时，仅60.2%的时间获胜（标准误差6.7%，机会为50%，$n = 35$）。一个无关模型的含义保留重写仅占与其他激活描述之间距离的2.1%，因此失败并非由于NLAs对在AV解释中发展了私人约定。我们的竞争性账户测试仅限于转录级别的真相，由监控语言模型的对话解决，因此这些结果仅限于最简单的情况，并留下了关于监控模型自身处理过程的声明未经测试。我们提出了猜想，使这两个结果都成为该框架的推论。

articles.title: Code-Switching Detection via Language-Selective Dimensions in Speech Foundation Models
articles.abstract: Code-switching (CS), the alternation between languages within an utterance, is common in multilingual speech but underrepresented in pretraining corpora. Increasing CS coverage requires finding relevant utterances in large speech collections so that they can be included in training data. One way to find such utterances is to transcribe the speech and detect language alternation in the text, but this depends on obtaining accurate multilingual transcriptions. We propose a lightweight method that detects CS directly from speech. It uses frame-level language information in pretrained speech encoders to determine whether both languages are present within an utterance. Specifically, we identify language-selective hidden-state dimensions using monolingual recordings and aggregate their frame-level activations into a CS prediction. With a small CS set used to tune a decision rule, we show that the Whisper-small encoder achieves a mean F1 of $0.798$ across 14 language pairs in CS-FLEURS, compared with $0.776$ for a CNN and $0.751$ for a HuBERT linear baseline trained for monolingual language identification. Our findings suggest that pretrained speech encoders already encode the information needed to identify CS utterances, and they provide a lightweight tool for building more representative multilingual corpora.
articles.titleCn: 基于语音基础模型的语言选择性维度进行代码转换检测
articles.abstractCn: 语码转换（CS），即在一个话语中语言之间的交替，在多语种口语中很常见，但在预训练语料库中代表性不足。增加CS覆盖范围需要在大规模语音语料库中找到相关话语，以便将其包含在训练数据中。寻找此类话语的一种方法是转录语音并在文本中检测语言交替，但这依赖于获得准确的多元语言转录。我们提出了一种轻量级方法，直接从语音中检测CS。它利用预训练语音编码器中的帧级语言信息来确定话语中是否存在两种语言。具体而言，我们使用单语录音识别语言选择性隐藏状态维度，并将它们的帧级激活聚合为CS预测。使用一个小型CS集来调整决策规则，我们在CS-FLEURS中展示了Whisper-small编码器在14种语言对中的平均F1得分为0.798，而CNN为0.776，单语语言识别训练的HuBERT线性基线为0.751。我们的研究表明，预训练语音编码器已经编码了识别CS话语所需的信息，并为构建更具代表性的多语种语料库提供了一种轻量级工具。

articles.title: From Relation-Specific Heads to Shared Interventions: Contextual Entrainment in Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models rely on prompt context to perform in-context learning, follow formats, and adapt to local evidence. This ability, however, also raises a robustness concern: models may reuse irrelevant tokens from earlier context when answering a later query. Prior work identifies this behavior as contextual entrainment and finds attention heads whose ablation reduces it, arguing that these heads are largely task- or relation-specific. But are the mechanisms behind contextual entrainment truly isolated by relation, or do relation-conditioned searches recover reusable components shared across relations? Using factual-distractor relation-completion prompts across 19 lexical-semantic subtypes, we identify attention heads whose ablation reduces entrainment and test how the resulting head sets transfer recovery ability across exact relations, semantic families, and mixed relation distributions. Same-family transfer exceeds different-family transfer, family residuals weaken once globally shared heads are removed, and subtype-specific searches repeatedly rediscover many global heads. Clean-completion and context-use probes further suggest that this shared intervention can reduce harmful copying while preserving ordinary relation completion and simple in-context abilities. Our findings provide a more precise perspective on contextual entrainment and its mitigation: harmful context following is not best addressed by searching for isolated relation-specific circuits, but by using heterogeneous attack prompts to reveal reusable intervention targets whose effects are shaped by semantic relation structure.
articles.titleCn: 从关系特定头部到共享干预：语言模型中的情境协同
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型依赖提示上下文进行情境学习、遵循格式并适应本地证据。然而，这种能力也引发了一个鲁棒性问题：模型在回答后续查询时可能重用早期上下文中无关的标记。先前研究将这种行为识别为情境诱导，并发现可以消除这种行为的注意力头，认为这些头主要是任务或关系特定的。但情境诱导背后的机制是否真的由关系隔离，还是关系条件搜索会恢复跨关系共享的可重用组件？我们使用涵盖19种词汇语义子类型的实据-干扰关系补全提示，识别出消除诱导的注意力头，并测试了这些头在精确关系、语义家族和混合关系分布中的迁移恢复能力。同家族迁移超过不同家族迁移，家族残差在移除全局共享头后减弱，子类型特定搜索反复重新发现许多全局头。清洁补全和上下文使用探测进一步表明，这种共享干预可以减少有害复制，同时保留普通关系补全和简单的情境能力。我们的研究为情境诱导及其缓解提供了更精确的视角：有害上下文跟随并非通过搜索隔离的关系特定电路来最佳解决，而是通过使用异构攻击提示来揭示受语义关系结构影响的效果的共享干预目标。

articles.title: SMI: Ontology-Grounded Semantic IDs for Hierarchy-Aware Medical Concept Representation
articles.abstract: Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. The base SMI uses uniform aggregation across ontology levels, while a level-weighted variant selects global level weights on validation data. Our theoretical analysis shows that SMI yields more informative medical concept representations than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings, particularly for rare and fine-grained clinical concepts. Experiments show that SMI captures meaningful hierarchical structure and improves clinical relation prediction. On MIMIC-IV, SMI improves mortality prediction, readmission prediction, drug recommendation, and rare drug prediction. On eICU, SMI yields more robust patient representations under cross-hospital distribution shift.
articles.titleCn: SMI：基于本体层次感知的医疗概念表示的语义ID
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学语言模型（LMs）为临床任务提供了强大的表征，但它们往往无法捕捉医学概念之间的层次结构。这一局限性在长尾词汇中罕见且细粒度的临床编码上尤为明显，随着概念频率的降低，无层次结构的LM表征信息量减少。我们引入了语义医学标识符（SMI），这是一个无需训练的框架，用于构建基于本体（ontology）的语义ID和层次感知的医学概念表征。对于每个诊断、程序或药物概念，SMI将其语义ID定义为通过专家定义的医学本体（ontology）从粗到细的路径。然后，SMI在相应的本体层级上聚合冻结的生物医学LM嵌入，形成层次感知的医学概念表征，从而保留粗到细的临床语义。基础SMI在本体层级上使用均匀聚合，而一个层级加权变体则在验证数据上选择全局层级权重。我们的理论分析表明，与无层次结构的LM嵌入相比，SMI产生了更具信息量的医学概念表征，尤其对于罕见和细粒度的临床概念。实验表明，SMI捕捉了有意义的层次结构，并提升了临床关系预测。在MIMIC-IV上，SMI提升了死亡率预测、再入院预测、药物推荐和罕见药物预测。在eICU上，SMI在跨医院分布偏移下产生了更鲁棒的患者表征。

articles.title: Known-Voice Cloning and the Limits of Personality Transfer for Character Design
articles.abstract: Recent advances in zero-shot voice cloning systems make it possible to reproduce a recognizable voice from a short recording and attach it to arbitrary virtual characters. Prior work suggests that familiar vocal identity can carry over associated personality impressions to new targets such as robots or virtual characters. However, these works have mainly examined familiarity and personalization effects rather than directly testing whether a cloned familiar voice systematically transfers personality impressions to an embodied virtual character. Such transference raises the concern that cloned voices could be used to manipulate people into engaging with virtual characters as capable social actors. Across two studies, we investigated whether personality impressions transfer when a virtual character speaks with the cloned voice of a familiar person. Study 1 examined this question in a real-world university setting using the cloned voice of a lecturer familiar to the participating students. Study 2 examined the same question online using voices of social media content creators and members of their communities. Drawing on the concepts of identity activation, trait transfer, and person reconstruction, we show that evidence of personality transfer was limited in both studies. Observed effects were selective and did not generalize across traits or study contexts. In the online study in particular, recognizable voice identity cues activated expectations about the speaker but did not reconstruct the broader person impression. Qualitative responses further indicated that judgments were frequently shaped by perceived artificiality and by whether voice and appearance fit together. Our findings moderate common concerns that cloned voices straightforwardly manipulate people into perceiving artificial characters as capable social actors.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. This preprint has been accepted for publication in Connected Futures - Nature, Robots, and Society (Robophilosophy 2026), in the Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS) series, volume 17299 (expected publication: December 2026)
articles.titleCn: 已知声音克隆与角色设计中的个性转移局限性
articles.abstractCn: 零样本语音克隆系统的最新进展使得从简短录音中复制可识别的声音并将其附加到任意虚拟角色成为可能。已有研究表明，熟悉的声音身份可以将其相关的人格印象传递给新的目标，如机器人或虚拟角色。然而，这些研究主要考察了熟悉性和个性化效应，而非直接测试克隆的熟悉声音是否系统地传递人格印象给具身的虚拟角色。这种传递引发了克隆声音可能被用来操纵人们与虚拟角色互动作为有能力的社会行动者的担忧。在两项研究中，我们调查了当虚拟角色使用熟悉人物的克隆声音时，人格印象是否会传递。研究1在一个现实世界大学环境中，使用学生熟悉的讲师的克隆声音来检验这个问题。研究2在线使用社交媒体内容创作者及其社区成员的声音来检验相同的问题。基于身份激活、特质传递和人物重建的概念，我们发现两项研究中的性格传递证据都有限。观察到的效应具有选择性，并未跨特质或研究背景泛化。特别是在在线研究中，可识别的声音身份线索激活了对说话者的预期，但并未重建更广泛的人物印象。定性回答进一步表明，判断经常受到感知的人工性和声音与外观是否协调的影响。我们的研究结果缓和了克隆声音直接操纵人们将人造角色感知为有能力的社会行动者的普遍担忧。

articles.title: Bayesian Test-Time Inference of Task-Aligned Similarity from Weak Interactive Feedback
articles.abstract: Language model systems repeatedly make test-time decisions by comparing similarity: they retrieve exemplars, rank candidates, and revise responses. Yet similarity is not unique: lexical, semantic, structural, and stylistic resemblance can point to different candidates, and the task-aligned notion can change across instances. We introduce BASIS (Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals), a training-free Bayesian method that uses weak test-time feedback to infer which criterion in a supplied, task-specific library governs the current decision. It maintains a joint posterior over candidate targets and criteria, updates it from scalar scores, pairwise preferences, or verifier outputs, and selects probes by expected information gain. In a finite noisy model, we characterize when the target-criterion pair is recoverable and show why fixed-criterion and fixed-mixture rules can fail under criterion shift. Across concept recovery, reasoning exemplar selection, and response refinement, BASIS improves six-probe concept-recovery Success@1 from 56.0% to 68.1%, reasoning accuracy from 72.3% to 73.1%, and refinement win rate from 61.4% to 63.8% over tuned static mixtures. It also exceeds compute-matched best-of-N selection on reasoning (72.1%) and refinement (61.2%). Gains are largest under criterion mismatch and with larger candidate pools, and matched controls indicate that adaptive criterion weighting explains much of the benefit, with joint target-criterion inference adding further value. BASIS selects only among supplied criteria and does not discover new ones.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text, 25 pages total including appendix; 4 figures, 15 tables
articles.titleCn: 基于弱交互反馈的任务对齐相似性贝叶斯测试时推理
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型系统通过比较相似度反复在测试时做出决策：它们检索范例、排序候选、并修改回复。然而相似度并非唯一：词汇、语义、结构和风格上的相似可能指向不同的候选，且任务对齐的概念可以在不同实例间变化。我们引入了BASIS（基于交互信号的贝叶斯轴选择），这是一种无需训练的贝叶斯方法，它利用微弱的测试时反馈来推断在提供的特定任务库中，哪个标准控制着当前的决策。它维护一个候选目标和标准的联合后验，从标量分数、成对偏好或验证器输出中更新它，并通过预期信息增益选择探针。在一个有限噪声模型中，我们描述了何时目标-标准对是可恢复的，并展示了在标准变化下固定标准和固定混合规则为何会失败。在概念恢复、推理范例选择和回复细化方面，BASIS将调优静态混合的六探针概念恢复Success@1从56.0%提高到68.1%，推理准确率从72.3%提高到73.1%，细化胜率从61.4%提高到63.8%。它还超越了计算匹配的最佳-N选择在推理（72.1%）和细化（61.2%）上。在标准不匹配和候选池较大时，收益最大，匹配控制表明自适应标准加权解释了大部分收益，联合目标-标准推断进一步增加了价值。BASIS仅从提供的标准中选择，并不发现新的标准。

articles.title: Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?
articles.abstract: Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.
articles.titleCn: 预训练是否教会了化学语言模型化学？
articles.abstractCn: 化学语言模型（CLMs）在大量分子语料库上进行预训练，旨在学习可迁移到多样化下游任务的表示。在此，我们系统地研究了使用一系列此类CLMs在64个分子性质预测数据集上进行预训练的影响。我们发现，CLMs预训练的下游收益并不随规模增长，并且在梯度提升基线以下性能达到饱和。在评估的所有范围内，仅对传统物理化学描述符进行监督预训练能够持续提升所测试CLMs的下游性能，而其他形式的预训练会导致模型性能劣于随机初始化的编码器。虽然模型能够很好地解析分子结构，但其表现并不优于随机初始化的模型，这表明，在最佳情况下，CLMs在预训练过程中除了学习低级标记统计信息外，还学习了一些类似描述符的性质，但令人惊讶的是，它们所揭示的化学知识远超经典分子特征所能捕捉的范围之外。

articles.title: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
articles.abstract: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.
articles.titleCn: 是否对齐：训练前请检查您的COMPASS
articles.abstractCn: 结合预训练模型是构建人工智能系统的一种常见策略，无论是将视觉编码器与语言模型对齐，还是合并微调后的检查点。然而，找到兼容的对通常需要昂贵的经验性搜索，因为兼容性只有在对齐或合并后才能知晓。我们提出了COMPASS（兼容性评估分数），这是一种基于理论的诊断方法，能够在对齐或合并之前估计模型对是否兼容。基于代表性收敛在局部邻域层面最为稳健的观察，COMPASS将模型兼容性分解为两个易于计算的轴：特定对齐的简易度，定义为两个编码器之间的$k$近邻重叠，以及范式层面的上限，捕捉其训练范式允许的最大重叠。这两个轴共同为候选模型对提供排序，并规定如何处理每一对： (i) 优先考虑已经一致且范式兼容的对； (ii) 对范式兼容但初始一致性低的对投入额外计算资源； (iii) 当范式无法支持足够一致性时，切换预训练范式； (iv) 优先级降低在对两个轴得分均较差的对。我们将COMPASS应用于72个跨模态对齐实验和392个任务算术模型合并，并表明COMPASS的兼容性评估与下游成功密切相关，在跨模态对齐任务上实现了0.91的平均皮尔逊相关系数，在模型合并上实现了0.70。

articles.title: Breakdown of Conversational Involvement: A Joint Multi-Modal Analysis of Conversation Floors and F-formation Detection with Multiple Features
articles.abstract: Interactions happen universally and spontaneously in daily lives. Studying involvement in interactions helps us analyze who can influence who and has a wide potential in applications. Specifically, we consider conversational involvement in free-standing conversations. We study two operationalizations of an FCG: F-formations and conversation floors, and propose that current assumption that F-formations capture single conversations is insufficient. To illustrate how different implementations could impact the detected F-formations, we employ three analyses. First, we propose that speaking status can be used for estimating conversation floors, and leveraged it to analyze floors within F-formations. Second, we analyze spatial characteristics of the detection results by applying different feature sets on chosen baselines, and find that groups resulting from head features are more likely to be subsumed by groups detected using other features. Finally, we do a joint analysis which combines the spatial features and floor patterns in the conversation. We observe that certain pipelines can detect groups with single floors from upper body features, while retaining F-formations with lower body features. We conclude that a more detailed theory and framework is needed to holistically demonstrate conversational involvement within interactions.
articles.titleCn: 对话参与度分解：基于多特征的对话地板与F形结构检测的联合多模态分析
articles.abstractCn: 互动在日常生活中的发生是普遍且自发的。研究互动中的参与度有助于我们分析谁能够影响谁，并在应用方面具有广泛潜力。具体而言，我们考虑独立对话中的对话参与度。我们研究了FCG（自由交谈群体）的两种操作化方式：F型结构和对话楼层，并提出当前假设认为F型结构能够捕捉单次对话是不充分的。为了说明不同的实现方式如何影响检测到的F型结构，我们采用了三种分析方法。首先，我们提出说话状态可用于估计对话楼层，并利用它来分析F型结构内的楼层。其次，我们通过在不同基线上应用不同的特征集来分析检测结果的空间特征，发现基于头部特征形成的群体更有可能被使用其他特征检测到的群体所包含。最后，我们进行了一项联合分析，结合了对话中的空间特征和楼层模式。我们观察到某些流程能够从上半身特征中检测到单层楼层的群体，同时保留使用下半身特征检测到的F型结构。我们得出结论，需要更详细的理论和框架来全面展示互动中的对话参与度。

articles.title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
articles.abstract: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.
articles.titleCn: 知识图谱作为文件：一个工具创建与工具使用协同进化的代理框架
articles.abstractCn: 在富文本知识图谱中搜索需要遵循关系并审查文本证据。预定义的图谱接口会限制代理可以访问的证据，即使代理编写代码来组合工具调用或处理检索到的子图也是如此。我们提出了直接知识图谱交互（DKGI），这是一个语言模型代理直接在完整的节点和边文件上创建图谱访问工具的框架。代理编写Python代码来遵循关系、组合节点集并选择文本证据，将执行与shell搜索和文件检查交错进行。这允许代理批量处理大型节点集，同时返回选定的文本供模型评估。执行反馈指导工具的创建和修订，而不断发展的工具决定了代理下一步收集哪些证据。在涵盖三个领域的基准数据集上，无需训练的DKGI在所有图谱上都比最强的已发表基线至少高出6.7个Hit@1点，即使是最小的框架也是如此。受控的消融实验表明，与仅使用shell访问和预定义图谱工具相比，多轮编程具有优势，而轨迹显示代理正在修订代码以扩展搜索或解决错误。这些发现突出了在图谱搜索过程中允许工具创建和工具使用协同进化的价值。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI获取。

articles.title: Does self-distillation improve reasoning?
articles.abstract: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning
articles.titleCn: 自我蒸馏能提升推理能力吗？
articles.abstractCn: 自蒸馏是一种新兴方法，通过在享有特权信息（如正确答案或环境反馈）的条件下训练模型模仿其自身的预测。近期研究报道了比强化学习（RL）更高的样本效率和泛化能力，但这些收益是否超越了分布内评估，以及它们是否源于特权蒸馏，目前尚不清楚。本文重新审视了两种代表性方法——自蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）和策略内自蒸馏（OPSD），在代码、科学、工具使用和数学推理任务中的应用。我们发现，这些方法报告的收益并未始终泛化到未见过的问题上，且主要是由过拟合或迁移现有推理行为所解释，而非有效利用特权信息。此外，自蒸馏梯度与直接优化预期奖励的策略梯度表现出弱一致性，这引发了它们是否为策略改进提供有效方向的疑问。我们在Qwen3模型（1.7B-14B）和OLMo-3-7B上的实验表明，有效利用特权信息以改进推理仍是一个开放挑战。我们的代码可在https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning获取。

articles.title: Legal-R1: Agentic Retrieval for Evidence-Based Legal Reasoning
articles.abstract: Legal question answering requires answers that are not only plausible, but also grounded in legally valid and citable evidence. Standard retrieval-augmented generation often relies on one-shot semantic matching, which is insufficient when legal evidence must be selected according to authority, applicability, and diversity across heterogeneous sources. We introduce Legal-R1, an agentic retrieval framework for evidence-based legal reasoning. Legal-R1 decomposes legal reasoning into a multi-agent workflow, where a Lawyer agent learns when to retrieve, which legal source to query, what evidence to seek, and when the collected evidence is sufficient. A Legal Assistant agent retrieves from normative legal sources and precedent cases with authority-aware and diversity-aware selection, while a Judge agent generates the final answer from the complete evidence trajectory. We post-train only the Lawyer agent with masked supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-aware reinforcement learning. Experiments on multiple Chinese legal benchmarks show that Legal-R1 improves over general-purpose, legal-specific, and retrieval-augmented baselines.
articles.titleCn: 基于证据的法律推理的代理式检索
articles.abstractCn: 法律问题解答需要答案不仅具有合理性，而且必须基于合法且可引用的证据。标准的检索增强生成通常依赖于单次语义匹配，这在法律证据必须根据权威性、适用性和异构来源的多样性进行选择时是不够的。我们引入了Legal-R1，这是一个基于证据的法律推理的智能检索框架。Legal-R1将法律推理分解为一个多智能体工作流程，其中律师智能体学习何时检索、查询哪个法律来源、寻找什么证据，以及何时收集的证据足够。法律助理智能体根据权威性和多样性感知选择，从规范性法律来源和先例案例中检索，而法官智能体根据完整的证据轨迹生成最终答案。我们仅对律师智能体进行掩码监督微调和轨迹感知强化学习进行后训练。在多个中文法律基准测试中，Legal-R1优于通用型、法律专用型和检索增强型基线模型。

articles.title: Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models
articles.abstract: Dialogue and collaborative assistants repeatedly judge what a partner knows, believes, or intends. Typed decision models offer a potential alternative to generative large language models for bounded Theory of Mind (ToM) selection. We present Jev-ToM, comparing five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English text questions from nine ToM benchmarks across six capability groups. TypeSafe Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy including native controls and ranks first or second across all six capabilities, leading beliefs, goals/desires/intentions, and emotions. Other typed models show distinct strengths across tasks. Separate resource comparisons suggest that Jev could reduce the cost and waiting time of repeated ToM selection. Confidence-based selection remains benchmark-dependent, and supplied reasons can repair errors or overturn correct answers depending on their attachment. Candidate expansion reveals distinct selection and output-validity problems. Related-question cues account for most of Jev's downstream gains, with task-dependent effects from predicted states. The findings motivate testing Jev as a ToM selection component in assistants, with task-specific confidence calibration, candidate design, and output validation as integration priorities.
articles.titleCn: Jev-ToM：评估类型化决策模型中的心智理论
articles.abstractCn: 对话式和协作式助手会反复判断伙伴知道什么、相信什么或意图是什么。基于类型的决策模型为有界心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）选择提供了生成式大型语言模型（LLM）的潜在替代方案。我们提出了Jev-ToM，并在六个能力组别的九个心智理论基准上的11,117个英文文本问题中，比较了五种基于类型的决策模型和七种生成式基线。TypeSafe Jev在包含原生控制的情况下达到73.2%的源平衡准确率，并在所有六项能力中排名第一或第二，领先于信念、目标/愿望/意图和情绪。其他基于类型的模型在各项任务中展现出不同的优势。单独的资源比较表明，Jev可以降低重复心智理论选择成本和等待时间。基于置信度的选择仍然依赖于基准，而提供的理由可以根据其关联方式修复错误或推翻正确答案。候选扩展揭示了不同的选择和输出有效性问题。相关问题提示解释了Jev大部分下游收益，预测状态产生了任务相关的效果。这些发现促使我们测试Jev作为助手中心智理论选择组件的可行性，并将任务特定的置信度校准、候选设计和输出验证作为集成优先事项。

articles.title: Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces
articles.abstract: Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.
articles.titleCn: 超越答案投票：通过采样轨迹的图对齐对大型语言模型推理进行细粒度纠正
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地处理需要多步推理的任务，其中中间断言中的错误会影响最终答案。自洽性（SC）通过抽样最终答案进行投票来改进推理，但其投票未能解决中间的分歧。为解决这个问题，我们引入了DDRG（基于推理图的分歧驱动验证引导），这是一个从冻结的推理轨迹库中进行选择性修正的框架。我们的见解是，图对齐可以揭示断言级别的分歧，并提供修正证据，而无需扩展抽样轨迹库。DDRG构建基于源头的断言图，并将局部冲突发送给答案盲验证器。一个得到多数答案支持路径支持的验证器支持的反驳会触发一次专注的修复；否则，DDRG返回精确的SC投票。在五个基准测试上的实验结果表明，原生的零样本DDRG在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B上，宏观平均准确率比直接回答分别提高了8.65和15.83个百分点。它还超过了CoT、评估的GoT和GoV问答改编版本，以及在这个宏观指标上的SC。DDRG将局部验证与选择性修正联系起来，而不会扩大初始候选库。

articles.title: From Hindsight to Foresight: Dissecting Clinical Evidence Acquisition in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often diagnose full sight, static clinical cases well yet struggle in foresight, dynamic diagnosis. Prior work has improved this limitation by quantifying the information models acquire and by developing stronger follow-up strategies to improve diagnostic accuracy. In contrast, we introduce a distinctive hindsight to systematically dissect why LLMs fail to acquire diagnostically critical evidence, tracing the failure from evidence identification, utilization and downstream diagnostic updating through not only diagnostic accuracy, but also evidence coverage, trajectory dynamics, and elicited probability and information entropy. Starting experiments from the breakdown at the level of capabilities, to the diagnosis of the pre-event state before the evidence arrives, and to the post-event state transition after the evidence arrives, our research has revealed the profound limitations and internal causes existing in the dynamic diagnostic process. At the same time, we have also conducted sufficient verification and generalization experiments to prove that these limitations are widespread. Together, these findings shift the central challenge from whether LLMs possess relevant clinical knowledge to whether they can identify, acquire, and effectively use the right evidence under clinical diagnosis and conduct a more detailed mechanism analysis to identify the exact location of the capability gap.
articles.titleCn: 从后见之明到预见之智：解析大型语言模型中的临床证据获取
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在诊断完整、静态的临床案例方面表现良好，但在前瞻性、动态诊断方面却面临挑战。先前研究通过量化模型获取的信息并开发更强的后续策略来改进这一局限性，从而提高了诊断准确性。相比之下，我们引入了一种独特的后见之明，系统地剖析LLMs为何无法获取诊断关键证据，并追溯这一失败从证据识别、利用到下游诊断更新的全过程，不仅关注诊断准确性，还包括证据覆盖率、轨迹动态性、引出概率和信息熵。我们的研究从能力层面的崩溃、证据到达前的预事件状态诊断，以及证据到达后的后事件状态转换开始实验，揭示了动态诊断过程中存在的深刻局限性和内部原因。同时，我们也进行了充分的验证和泛化实验，证明这些局限性具有普遍性。这些发现共同将核心挑战从LLMs是否具备相关临床知识转变为它们能否在临床诊断中识别、获取并有效利用正确证据，并开展更详细机制分析以确定能力差距的确切位置。

articles.title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
articles.abstract: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only $10$ to $20\%$ of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map between Gaussian approximations of the vision and language feature distributions on a shared principal subspace, so that the projector training stage can be skipped entirely. Without any paired data, PORTAL matches the standard pipeline trained on 558k image-caption pairs across six LLM backbones, two vision encoders, and 16 benchmarks. It outperforms that pipeline in $3$ of $7$ (vision encoder, LLM) settings and reaches an average $98\%$ of its score across the other four.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考多模态LLM中的投影器训练
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型通常首先通过在大规模图像-文本数据集上进行投影器训练来对齐视觉编码器和语言模型，然后对整个多模态模型进行联合训练。尽管这种方法被广泛使用，但投影器训练阶段的作用仍然知之甚少。我们发现：(i) 仅使用10%至20%的数据来训练投影器即可恢复大部分下游性能提升，以及 (ii) 在不同数据集上训练的投影器可以进行线性插值，同时基本保持性能。这些结果表明，投影器训练主要执行粗略对齐，许多不同的投影器都能同样有效地完成这一任务。基于这些发现，我们提出了PORTAL，这是一种无需训练的投影器初始化方法，它既不需要配对的图像-文本数据，也不需要基于梯度的优化，仅需各模态的汇总统计数据。PORTAL在共享的主子空间上计算基于最优传输的映射，将视觉和语言特征分布的高斯近似联系起来，从而完全跳过投影器训练阶段。在没有任何配对数据的情况下，PORTAL在六种LLM主干网络、两种视觉编码器和16个基准测试上，与标准流程（基于558k图像-文本对训练）相比，性能相当。在7种（视觉编码器、LLM）设置中的3种下表现更优，并在其余4种设置中达到了平均98%的得分。

articles.title: Decomposing and Predicting Annotation Disagreement in Harmful Content Across Languages
articles.abstract: Annotator disagreement is increasingly recognized as a meaningful property of subjective tasks, rather than merely noise to be removed. Predicting which items are likely to be contested could help allocate annotation effort and route difficult cases to human review. We propose predicting disagreement from interpretable semantic properties of the text. An LLM answers a set of binary questions covering harmful-content characteristics, disagreement-related cues such as borderline severity and missing context, and language-sensitive cues such as local slurs. A classifier predicts disagreement from these answers, and we analyze which questions contribute most to the predictions. Across four datasets in English, German, and Turkish and three open-weight LLMs, our structured question features outperform direct prompting by 10.5 ROC-AUC points and the strongest text-based baselines by 5.0 points. A compact subset of eight questions performs within 1.5 ROC-AUC points of the full twenty-question set. In leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, models retain roughly 90-95% of their in-domain ROC-AUC. Across models and datasets, questions about derogation, missing context, and decision boundaries serve as the strongest predictors, suggesting that what makes harmful content contested is partly observable in the text.
articles.titleCn: 跨语言有害内容中标注分歧的分解与预测
articles.abstractCn: 标注者之间的分歧正日益被视为主观任务中一个有意义的属性，而不仅仅是需要去除的噪声。预测哪些项目可能存在争议，有助于分配标注工作并将棘手的案例转交给人工审核。我们提出根据文本的可解释语义属性来预测分歧。一个大型语言模型（LLM）回答一组涵盖有害内容特征、与分歧相关的线索（如模糊严重性和缺失上下文）以及语言敏感线索（如地方性侮辱）的二进制问题。一个分类器根据这些答案预测分歧，并分析哪些问题对预测贡献最大。在英语、德语和土耳其语的四个数据集以及三种开放权重LLM上，我们的结构化问题特征比直接提示高出10.5个ROC-AUC点，并且比最强的基于文本的基线高出5.0点。一个包含八个问题的紧凑子集的表现与完整的二十个问题集相差1.5个ROC-AUC点。在留出一个数据集进行评估的情况下，模型在其领域内的ROC-AUC保留率约为90-95%。在所有模型和数据集上，关于贬低、缺失上下文和决策边界的提问是预测分歧最强的因素，这表明有害内容为何存在争议的部分原因可以在文本中观察到。

articles.title: The Many Morals of AI: The cautionary bias of North American news narratives in global perspective
articles.abstract: The stories told about artificial intelligence (AI) play a central role in shaping public understanding, policy debates, and expectations about technological change. News media are especially influential in this process. Using a cross-regional corpus of 12,924 English-language news articles about AI published since 2022, we examine how storytelling about AI varies across media systems in four regions: North America, China, India, and the Middle East. Leveraging large language models, we extract the implicit narrative lessons conveyed by each article---commonly known as story morals---capturing value-laden interpretations that extend beyond thematic content or sentiment. We find that North American AI coverage is uniquely characterized by narratives of caution, while under-emphasizing narratives of innovation and collaboration that are more prevalent elsewhere. However, this pattern is largely explained by a broader regional negativity bias in North American news sentiment, rather than by heightened concern about AI itself. Our findings bring into view the culturally conditioned nature of AI news narratives.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能的多元道德：北美新闻叙事在全球视角下的警示性偏见
articles.abstractCn: 关于人工智能（AI）的故事在塑造公众认知、政策辩论以及人们对技术变革的期望方面发挥着核心作用。新闻媒体在这一过程中尤其具有影响力。我们利用2022年以来发表的12924篇关于AI的英文新闻文章的跨区域语料库，考察了AI的故事讲述在不同媒体体系（北美、中国、印度和中东）中的差异。借助大型语言模型，我们提取了每篇文章所传达的隐含叙事教训——通常被称为故事寓意——捕捉了超越主题内容或情感的价值负载解读。我们发现，北美地区的AI报道独特地以谨慎的叙事为特征，而较少强调在别处更普遍的创新与合作叙事。然而，这种模式主要可以用北美新闻情绪中的更广泛的区域负面偏见来解释，而不是对AI本身的高度关注所导致。我们的研究揭示了AI新闻叙事的文化条件性本质。

articles.title: CREATE: Creativity Evaluation of VLMs using the Visual Remote Associates Test
articles.abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) are used in creative tasks such as visual storytelling, design ideation, art interpretation, and advertising. Yet we lack principled ways to measure the lateral reasoning of these models compared to human potential. We introduce CREATE, a semi-automatically constructed benchmark containing 155 visual Remote Associates Test problems. These problems require a solver to find an underlying connection among three seemingly dissimilar images. We conduct a human study (N=25) to validate and ground the quality of our benchmark, and evaluate 11 VLMs. Our findings show that most VLMs underperform humans on this task. Our experiments indicate that the associative ability of VLMs depends on the cue concepts provided in the text and does not universally extend to visual puzzles.
articles.titleCn: 创建：使用视觉远程联想测试评估视觉语言模型的创造力
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）被应用于视觉叙事、设计构思、艺术解读和广告等创意任务。然而，我们缺乏能够衡量这些模型与人类潜力相比的横向推理能力的原则性方法。我们引入了CREATE，这是一个半自动构建的基准，包含155个视觉远程联想测试问题。这些问题要求解决者在三个看似不相关的图像之间找到潜在的联系。我们进行了一项人类研究（N=25）来验证和确定我们基准的质量，并评估了11个VLMs。我们的研究发现，大多数VLMs在这个任务上的表现不如人类。我们的实验表明，VLMs的联想能力取决于文本中提供的提示概念，并且并不普遍地扩展到视觉谜题。

articles.title: Empathy Is Not the Scapegoat for Declines in Factuality and Reliability
articles.abstract: Language models are increasingly expected to support users in stressful or uncertain situations, where warmth and empathy are desirable. While recent work associates warmer models with reduced reliability, we show that this conclusion is incomplete. Prior studies often train primarily on empathetic dialogue, making it difficult to separate tone effects from SFT-induced distribution shift. We revisit this issue at both the model and evaluation levels. We study prompting, SFT, and RL for inducing warm behavior, and comprehensively evaluate capability preservation using an 11-dataset benchmark suite and EMOFACT under emotional contexts. Across multiple model families, we find that warmth effects are task- and model-dependent, while task-aligned adaptive tone can improve empathy and targeted reliability, although some capability trade-offs remain. We further introduce human-validated empathy evaluators specifically developed to assess empathetic model responses. Our results suggest that models can be more supportive in social interactions while remaining reliable.
articles.titleCn: 共情不是事实性和可靠性下降的替罪羊
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型越来越被期望在用户面临压力或不确定的情况下提供支持，此时温暖和同理心是必不可少的。尽管最近的研究将更温暖的模型与降低的可靠性联系起来，我们表明这一结论并不完整。先前的研究通常主要在同理心对话上进行训练，这使得难以将语气效应与SFT（监督微调）引起的分布偏移区分开来。我们在模型和评估层面重新审视了这一问题。我们研究了提示、SFT和强化学习（RL）以诱导温暖行为，并使用一个包含11个数据集的基准套件和EMOFACT在情感环境下全面评估了能力保留。在多个模型家族中，我们发现温暖效应是任务和模型相关的，而与任务对齐的自适应语气可以提高同理心并增强针对性可靠性，尽管仍存在一些能力权衡。我们进一步引入了经过人类验证的同理心评估器，这些评估器专门用于评估模型的同理心响应。我们的结果表明，模型可以在保持可靠性的同时，在社会互动中提供更多支持。

articles.title: How Reliable Are System-One Decisions in Medicine? A Comparative Study of Jev, Jev-like Models, and LLMs
articles.abstract: Jev has attracted considerable attention for its rapid, generalizable decision-making, yet its medical reliability remains under explored. To address this gap, our study compares various types of system-one decision models across 15 medical datasets comprising 8,742 instances under a unified protocol. Beyond accuracy, we assess decision stability and the ability to recognize unreliable decisions. Our results show that Jev rivals leading models on primarily text-driven tasks but is less effective on numerically driven tasks, revealing a distinct capability boundary. Under question-format variations, Jev demonstrates strong robustness, achieving the lowest decision reversal rate and relatively small accuracy fluctuations. Among evaluated open-source alternatives, only StartLux exhibits comparable robustness. But these strengths do not extend to reliable abstention awareness: most evaluated models show limitations in both recognizing missing correct answers and using optional abstention. Moreover, we find that Jev's probability-based answer selection can be improved by changing how decisions are scored: normalizing option-wise binary scores yields higher retained accuracy than choice scoring. Taken together, our findings provide early guidance for improving and applying decision models in medicine.
articles.titleCn: 系统一决策在医学中的可靠性如何？一项关于Jev、Jev类模型和大型语言模型的比较研究
articles.abstractCn: 杰夫（Jev）因其快速且可推广的决策能力而备受关注，但其医疗可靠性仍需深入探索。为填补这一空白，我们的研究在统一的协议下，对15个包含8,742个实例的医学数据集中的不同类型系统一决策模型进行了比较。除了准确性，我们还评估了决策稳定性以及识别不可靠决策的能力。结果表明，杰夫在主要依赖文本的任务上与领先模型不相上下，但在依赖数值的任务上效果较差，揭示了其独特的能力边界。在问题格式变化下，杰夫表现出强大的鲁棒性，实现了最低的决策反转率和相对较小的准确性波动。在评估的开源替代方案中，只有StartLux表现出可比的鲁棒性。但这些优势并未延伸到可靠的弃权意识：大多数评估模型在识别缺失的正确答案和使用可选弃权方面都存在局限。此外，我们发现基于概率的答案选择可以通过改变决策评分方式来改进：对选项级的二元分数进行归一化处理，比选择评分能获得更高的保留准确性。综上所述，我们的研究结果为改进和应用医疗决策模型提供了初步指导。

articles.title: Retrieval Disagreement as a Signal: Diagnosing and Steering Multilingual Dense Embedders
articles.abstract: Multilingual dense retrievers place all languages in one shared space so that a question finds relevant documents, regardless of which language they are written in. We show that the same question, asked in different languages, retrieves substantially different documents, and this disagreement is not because of weak language understanding. Each language performs well on its own and ranks candidates consistently with the other languages; divergence appears only when languages share an index. We trace the mechanism: each language keeps its own ranking, but in the shared index, its correct answers are pushed far down, buried under non-relevant documents that are either in the query's own language or in English, depending on the model. We introduce disagreement-guided steering: for each language, we contrast the documents that other languages agree on for a question against those that language retrieves idiosyncratically, and take the difference of their representations as a language-specific direction, added to that language's queries at inference. Against baselines of language-mean removal, subspace removal, and per-language rotation, it most strongly reduces same-language crowding while remaining competitive on recall, trading off against mean removal, which better preserves ranking quality.
articles.titleCn: 检索分歧作为信号：诊断与引导多语言密集嵌入器
articles.abstractCn: 多语言密集检索器将所有语言置于一个共享空间中，使得无论文档是用哪种语言书写的，提问都能找到相关的文档。我们证明，用不同语言提出的相同问题会检索到截然不同的文档，而这种分歧并非由于语言理解能力较弱。每种语言在自身上表现良好，并能与其他语言一致地排序候选文档；分歧仅在语言共享索引时出现。我们追踪了这一机制：每种语言保持其自身的排序，但在共享索引中，其正确答案会被推得很靠后，被查询语言或英语的非相关文档埋没，具体取决于模型。我们引入了分歧引导的转向方法：对于每种语言，我们对比其他语言对某个问题的共识文档与该语言独特检索到的文档，并将它们表示的差异作为特定语言的方向，添加到该语言的推理查询中。与语言均值移除、子空间移除和单语言旋转的基线相比，该方法最强烈地减少了同语言拥挤，同时在召回率上保持竞争力，与均值移除方法进行权衡，后者更好地保留了排序质量。

articles.title: The Geometry of Language Model Logits: Generic Structure and Learned Departures
articles.abstract: Autoregressive language models produce, at every prediction step, a vocabulary-sized logit vector whose structure determines the conditional next-token distribution. We empirically identify that the ordered vocabulary-head logits follow a remarkably consistent log-linear relation \[ z_{(r)} \approx μ- α\log r. \] across prediction contexts, architectures, and scales, emerging progressively during pretraining. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic analysis of the logit geometry underlying the distributional assumptions used in the prior decoding work. While controlled order-statistic baselines spanning bounded, light-tailed, and heavier-tailed distributions can largely explain the observed log-linear geometry, they do not explain the systematic shift in the slope $α$: trained language models exhibit $α\approx 1.4$--$1.7$, sitting well above the initialization baseline ($α\approx 0.2$) . Moreover, $α$ correlates with predictive performance, suggesting that it captures learned structure beyond generic extreme-value effects.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型 logits 的几何学：通用结构与学习到的偏离
articles.abstractCn: 自回归语言模型在每个预测步骤中都会生成一个词汇大小的logit向量，其结构决定了条件下一个词的分布。我们通过实证发现，有序的词汇头logit在预测上下文、架构和规模之间遵循一种非常一致的log线性关系\[ z_{(r)} \approx μ- α\log r \]。这一关系在预训练过程中逐步显现。据我们所知，这是首次对先前解码工作中所使用的分布假设背后的logit几何结构进行的系统性分析。虽然涵盖有界、轻尾和重尾分布的控制顺序统计基线可以很大程度上解释观察到的log线性几何结构，但它们无法解释斜率α的系统变化：训练好的语言模型的α值约为1.4--1.7，远高于初始化基线（α约为0.2）。此外，α与预测性能相关，表明它捕捉了超越通用极值效应的学习到的结构。

articles.title: Imprinting: Knowledge Distillation Can Shift Student Behavior
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation trains student models on teacher-generated responses to transfer task capability, but those responses may also carry behavioral tendencies of their source. We investigate whether the source teacher can shape student behavior beyond the capability that distillation is intended to transfer. We construct harm-accepting and harm-avoiding variants of the same base teacher, use them to generate responses to ordinary reasoning and knowledge questions unrelated to safety, and distill those responses into students with different base models. Students generally acquire task capability while their downstream decisions shift toward the source teacher's safety-pragmatism disposition, a phenomenon we call imprinting. Distillation from the harm-accepting teacher reduces harm avoidance, whereas distillation from the harm-avoiding teacher increases it. Imprinting varies across teacher-student pairs and does not extend uniformly across different forms of safety behavior. Excluding a sparse set of divergence tokens reduces imprinting, whereas response rewriting preserves the source-dependent effect and can introduce additional rewriter-dependent shifts. Post-distillation preference optimization raises harm avoidance but does not eliminate the source-dependent difference. These results show that behavioral tendencies can be intentionally imprinted through the source teacher, even with ordinary task supervision.
articles.titleCn: 印记：知识蒸馏能够改变学生行为
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏通过教师生成的响应来训练学生模型以迁移任务能力，但这些响应也可能携带其来源的行为倾向。我们研究了源教师是否能在蒸馏旨在迁移的能力之外塑造学生的行为。我们构建了相同基础教师的有害接受和有害避免变体，使用它们生成对日常推理和与安全无关的知识问题的响应，并将这些响应蒸馏到具有不同基础模型的学生中。学生通常获得任务能力，而他们的下游决策则倾向于源教师的安全实用主义倾向，这种现象我们称为烙印。从有害接受教师蒸馏会减少有害避免，而从有害避免教师蒸馏会增加有害避免。烙印因教师-学生对而异，并且不会在不同形式的安全行为中均匀扩展。排除稀疏的一组发散标记会减少烙印，而响应重写则保留了源依赖效应，并可能引入额外的重写器依赖的偏移。蒸馏后的偏好优化会增加有害避免，但不会消除源依赖的差异。这些结果表明，即使通过普通的任务监督，行为倾向也可以通过源教师有意地烙印。

articles.title: The Last Mile of Coding Agents for Long-Document Tasks: An Empirical Study on Clinical Trial Protocol Digitization
articles.abstract: Clinical trial protocols serve as the source of truth for study design, but are mostly written and used as unstructured PDF documents. Digitizing protocols turns static content into structured, machine-readable data that clinical software can analyze, validate, and execute. Coding agents, which select tools, execute code, and revise their approach as they work, are increasingly applied to such long-document tasks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they turn complete documents into accurate structured outputs. We study this question using protocol digitization as a testbed. We introduce TrialPD-Bench, an expert-annotated benchmark of 150 publicly available protocol PDFs spanning four task categories. Beyond final-answer performance, our evaluation measures evidence recall from agent traces, agent behavior, and cost. Across nine proprietary and open-weight models in five coding-agent harnesses, even the strongest agents do not fully solve protocol digitization. Our analysis further shows that agents usually locate the required evidence but fail in the last mile of transcribing and structuring it.
