We further develop TrialScribe, a domain-specific harness that equips coding agents with task skills and a verification loop. TrialScribe improves a locally served open-weight model by 6.2-59.4 points across eight metrics, enabling it to match or surpass proprietary models such as GPT-5.6-Sol.
articles.titleCn: 长文档任务中编码代理的最后一公里：临床试验方案数字化实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 临床试验方案作为研究设计的权威来源，但大多以非结构化的PDF文档形式编写和使用。将方案数字化可以将静态内容转化为结构化、机器可读的数据，从而供临床软件进行分析、验证和执行。编码代理（coding agents），这些代理能够选择工具、执行代码并在工作中调整方法，越来越多地应用于此类长文档任务，但它们将完整文档转化为准确结构化输出的可靠性仍不明确。我们以方案数字化为试验平台研究此问题。我们引入了TrialPD-Bench，这是一个包含150份公开可用的方案PDF文档的专家标注基准，涵盖四个任务类别。除了最终答案的性能外，我们的评估还测量了代理轨迹（agent traces）、代理行为和成本中的证据召回率。在五个编码代理框架（coding-agent harnesses）中的九个专有和开放权重模型中，即使是强大的代理也没有完全解决方案数字化问题。我们的分析进一步表明，代理通常能定位到所需证据，但在转录和结构化这些证据的最后一步却常常失败。我们进一步开发了TrialScribe，这是一个特定领域的框架，为编码代理配备了任务技能和验证循环。TrialScribe在八个指标上提升了本地服务的开放权重模型6.2-59.4分，使其能够匹敌或超越GPT-5.6-Sol等专有模型。

articles.title: Aligning Faithfulness for Theory-Scale Autoformalization
articles.abstract: Autoformalization (AF) requires more than compilation: formal statements must preserve the meaning of their informal sources, a property known as faithfulness. An emerging frontier is the automated evaluation of this property, yet most existing methods operate at the statement level and produce whole-item verdicts, failing to reveal how individual expressions correspond or which contextual interpretations support the judgment. This omission is consequential because AF is inherently theory-scale: target statements derive their meaning from surrounding mathematical material and unstated conventions. We formulate faithfulness evaluation as a context-aware align-then-label problem: identifying phrase-level correspondences between informal and formal statements and assigning a faithfulness label to each under explicitly specified contextual interpretations and assumptions. We also introduce FaithAlign, the first theory-scale faithfulness benchmark comprising 460 items and 4,982 annotated phrase-level links, alongside FaithAlign-Gap, a companion set of 146 items with informal context and assumptions withheld. Each FaithAlign item includes the target statement pair, relevant context, formal dependencies, and, where needed, assumptions specifying one given interpretation. Across 8 models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest defect F1 at 47.8% and identifies all defects in only 4.5% of items with two or more defects. On FaithAlign-Gap, Astra identifies only 28.2% of undecidable items as such. These results show the difficulty of recovering context-dependent correspondences, establishing FaithAlign as a testbed for fine-grained, context-aware faithfulness evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 为理论规模自动形式化对齐忠实度
articles.abstractCn: 自动形式化（AF）不仅需要编译：形式化声明必须保留其非形式化来源的意义，这一特性被称为保真度。一个新兴的前沿是自动评估这一特性，然而大多数现有方法在声明级别运行，并产生整体项目的判断，未能揭示单个表达式如何对应或哪些上下文解释支持该判断。这一遗漏是重要的，因为AF本质上具有理论规模：目标声明从周围数学材料和未声明的约定中获取其意义。我们将保真度评估表述为一个上下文感知的“对齐后标记”问题：识别非形式化声明和形式化声明之间的短语级对应关系，并在明确指定的上下文解释和假设下，为每个对应关系分配一个保真度标签。我们还引入了FaithAlign，这是第一个理论规模的保真度基准，包含460个项目和4,982个注释的短语级链接，以及FaithAlign-Gap，一个包含146个项目的配套集，其中隐去了非形式化上下文和假设。每个FaithAlign项目包括目标声明对、相关上下文、形式化依赖关系，以及在需要时指定给定解释的假设。在8个模型中，GPT-6 Astra实现了最高的缺陷F1分数，达到47.8%，并且在包含两个或多个缺陷的项目中仅占4.5%的项目中就识别出所有缺陷。在FaithAlign-Gap上，Astra仅将28.2%的不可判定项目识别为不可判定。这些结果表明恢复上下文相关对应关系的难度，并确立了FaithAlign作为细粒度、上下文感知保真度评估的测试平台。

articles.title: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments
articles.abstract: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.
articles.titleCn: 法官遵循参考：验证工具调用论证中的推导差距
articles.abstractCn: 工具调用裁判评估大型语言模型代理提出的论值。我们发现，当裁判输入中不包含该值的参考信息时，即没有说明该值应该是什么的文本时，他们接受正确值的频率较低。这种情况发生在值是用户未提及的函数模式默认值、需要推断时，或者该值来源的文本被裁剪自裁判输入时。我们将这种接受率的下降称为推导差距。在我们评估的所有七个裁判中，包括系统一模型CLM和Jev，都出现了这种差距。这种差距不仅仅是裁剪效应：在无裁剪的基准测试中，正确的默认值显示出最大的差距。一项受控的源重定位测试表明，裁判遵循其输入中的参考：他们更倾向于可见的错误值，而不是来源被隐藏的正确值。我们引入了DeRef（派生参考）：一个单独的模型读取完整的交互历史，而不看到候选值，并为裁判编写参考。在三个基准测试中，DeRef提高了所有被测试裁判的整体论点AUROC。在受控测试中，它将AUROC从随机水平或以下提高到98.40至99.59之间。

articles.title: How Safe Is ChatGPT Health Advice? Evidence from Real User Conversations in Four Global South Countries
articles.abstract: People increasingly bring their health questions to ChatGPT, yet safety evaluations of LLM health advice rest almost entirely on clinician-authored vignettes, synthetic prompts, or simulated user profiles. The gap is widest for the Global South, where concerns about demographic bias and unsafe recommendations are well documented but have never been tested on real usage. We present, to our knowledge, the first demographically grounded safety evaluation of real-world health conversations with ChatGPT. From a consent-based data-donation corpus of 202,590 conversations from 1,252 users in India, Nigeria, Brazil, and Pakistan (December 2022 to February 2026), each linked to self-reported age and gender, we identify 15,555 health conversations, classify their health intent using an LLM classifier adapted from an established taxonomy, and score response safety under both a context-blind and a user-context-aware rubric. Roughly one in five health conversations receives a high-risk rating. Risk concentrates in symptom and condition queries and recurs through identifiable failure modes: unsafe medication or dosage guidance, harmful self-diagnosis, missing safety warnings, encouraging over-reliance on the model, and failure to refer users to professionals. Supplying the user's own accumulated context raises the high-risk share by 13-17 percentage points, and about one in four conversations rated safe in isolation turns out to be unsafe for the specific person asking. Safety evaluations built on synthetic cases are likely to miss these harms.
articles.titleCn: ChatGPT健康建议有多安全？来自四个全球南方国家真实用户对话的证据
articles.abstractCn: 人们越来越多地将健康问题带到ChatGPT上，但针对LLM健康建议的安全评估几乎完全依赖于临床医生撰写的案例片段、合成提示或模拟用户资料。在“全球南方”地区，关于人口统计偏差和不当建议的担忧已得到充分记录，但这些担忧从未在真实使用场景中得到测试。据我们所知，我们首次进行了基于人口统计特征的真实世界ChatGPT健康对话安全评估。从2022年12月至2026年2月期间，印度、尼日利亚、巴西和巴基斯坦1,252名用户的202,590次基于同意的数据捐赠对话中（每条对话均关联自报年龄和性别），我们识别出15,555次健康对话，使用基于既定分类体系的LLM分类器对其健康意图进行分类，并在不考虑上下文和考虑用户上下文的评分标准下评估回复安全性。大约五分之一的健康对话被评为高风险。风险集中在症状和病情查询中，并通过可识别的失效模式反复出现：不安全的药物或剂量指导、有害的自我诊断、缺失安全警告、鼓励过度依赖模型，以及未能将用户转介给专业人士。提供用户自身的累积上下文会使高风险比例提高13-17个百分点，大约四分之一的孤立情况下被评为安全的对话，对具体提问者而言却是危险的。基于合成案例的安全评估很可能遗漏这些危害。

articles.title: Readout Scaling Shapes Sparse Feature Recovery
articles.abstract: Readout scaling changes what a sparse autoencoder (SAE) learns, but the benefit of removing it depends on the data. We use readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains while preserving retained decision information. At a fixed readout condition number, changing the generating distribution reverses which training coordinates recover known factors best. In our controlled coordinate-matching study, recovery is highest when training restores the space in which the factors were generated. When factors are generated before readout scaling, RC-DS increases mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913 at condition number 100, compared with centered-logit training under the same budget. An exact wrapper reproduces RC-DS training to numerical precision, isolating training geometry rather than additional information. In neural policies, RC-DS improves mean logit reconstruction under the tested budgets. On three fixed language-model checkpoints, RC-DS has higher mean gain-free reconstruction in all 18 tested task-sparsity settings, while centered-logit SAEs reconstruct output logits better in 17. Small-label-head controls show that longer training reduces the reconstruction gap from 0.0198 to 0.0016. Together, these results show how readout scaling, the data distribution, and training shape sparse learning. RC-DS provides an information-preserving method for studying and controlling the readout's contribution. Separate label-detection and steering tests distinguish these reconstruction effects from task-specific feature usefulness.
articles.titleCn: 读数缩放形状稀疏特征恢复
articles.abstractCn: 读取缩放会改变稀疏自动编码器（SAE）的学习内容，但移除它的好处取决于数据。我们使用读取规范化的决策空间（RC-DS）坐标来移除奇异值增益，同时保留保留的决策信息。在固定的读取条件数下，改变生成分布会逆转哪些训练坐标能最好地恢复已知因子。在我们的受控坐标匹配研究中，当训练恢复因子生成空间时，恢复效果最高。当因子在读取缩放之前生成时，与相同预算下的中心对数训练相比，RC-DS在条件数为100时将平均稀疏因子恢复率从0.506提高到0.913。一个精确的包装器以数值精度重现了RC-DS训练，隔离了训练几何形状而不是额外信息。在神经策略中，RC-DS在测试预算下提高了平均对数重建。在三个固定的语言模型检查点中，RC-DS在所有18个测试的任务稀疏设置中都具有更高的平均无增益重建，而中心对数SAE在17个设置中更好地重建输出对数。小标签头控制显示，更长的训练将重建差距从0.0198减少到0.0016。综合这些结果，展示了读取缩放、数据分布和训练如何塑造稀疏学习。RC-DS提供了一种保留信息的方法，用于研究和控制读取的贡献。单独的标签检测和转向测试区分了这些重建效果与特定任务特征有用性的影响。

articles.title: Teacher-Guided Tool Learning for Small Language Models via Bidirectional KL Constraints
articles.abstract: External tools can extend the capabilities of small language models (SLMs), enabling their deployment in resource constrained environments. However, their limited capabilities make it difficult for SLMs to discover effective tool use behaviors through reinforcement learning alone, while direct teacher supervision suffers from teacher student behavioral distribution mismatch and may propagate erroneous preferences. To address these challenges, we propose Selective Teacher guided Policy Optimization (SeTPO), which coordinates student exploration with selective teacher guidance and persistent demonstration supervision. Specifically, SeTPO incorporates reverse KL derived token level teacher feedback into policy advantages on low reward trajectories, while auxiliary forward KL supervision preserves teacher demonstrated behaviors throughout training. Under an idealized bidirectional KL objective, we theoretically establish that the optimal policy achieves expected reward no lower than the teacher's while retaining a guaranteed fraction of the teacher's probability mass. Extensive experiments on BFCL v4 and API Bank demonstrate that SeTPO achieves superior overall performance over supervised fine tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation baselines across all three student scales.
articles.titleCn: 基于双向KL约束的教师引导工具学习用于小语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 外部工具可以扩展小语言模型（SLM）的能力，使其能够在资源受限的环境中部署。然而，由于SLM能力有限，仅通过强化学习难以发现有效的工具使用行为，而直接教师监督则存在教师-学生行为分布不匹配的问题，并可能传播错误偏好。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了选择性教师指导策略优化（SeTPO），该方案协调学生探索与选择性教师指导，并持续进行示范监督。具体而言，SeTPO将反向KL推导的token级教师反馈整合到低奖励轨迹的策略优势中，同时辅助正向KL监督在整个训练过程中保留教师示范行为。在理想化的双向KL目标下，我们理论上证明了最优策略能够实现不低于教师水平的预期奖励，同时保留教师概率质量的保证比例。在BFCL v4和API Bank上的大量实验表明，SeTPO在所有三个学生规模上均优于监督微调、强化学习和蒸馏基线，实现了整体性能的显著提升。

articles.title: Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit
articles.abstract: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.
articles.titleCn: 复制并非根基：训练忠实长文本RAG需依赖原创句式归因
articles.abstractCn: 在搜索引擎和助手中，长文本RAG答案可能会因声称其来源不支持的内容而误导读者。忠实度奖励，即受支持句子的比例，会训练模型减少此类声称。我们表明，这些奖励会被复制攻击所利用。从段落中复制的句子几乎注定会被支持，因此训练好的模型会学习复制而非基于事实进行写作。常见的防御措施仅是将攻击转移：KL散度或复制惩罚要么保留复制行为，要么将其交换为更短、更空洞的答案和拒绝回答。标准的强化学习算法GRPO通过赋予每句话其答案的优势，使情况变得更糟，同样强化了复制和基于事实的句子。我们提出了原创句子信用（ASC）机制，通过将GRPO的奖励和优势从答案层面转移到句子层面来解决这个问题。该奖励仅对原创句子（而非复制句子）进行信用，例如比问题本身更多，并且这些句子得到了段落的支持。优势比较每句话与为问题采样的每句话，因此没有获得信用的句子排名最后，并且不会被强化。在四个模型和两个领域内、三个保留语料库的测试中，只有ASC降低了原创句子的错误率，并在每种情况下都写出了更多受支持的句子，在保留评估器下的中位数为38%和46%，为读者提供了更基于事实的信息。它没有采用任何这些捷径，并且两个大型语言模型裁判在比较完整答案时，更倾向于基线模型而非基础模型，但认为ASC的答案与基础模型相当。我们得出结论，忠实度奖励应该奖励模型所写的内容，而不是它所复制的内容。

articles.title: Estimating Surprisal from the Speech Signal
articles.abstract: Although language is predominantly spoken, empirical tests of surprisal theory rely almost entirely on written text. In practice, surprisal is estimated using language models (LMs) trained on text and applied to transcriptions, creating a text bottleneck that limits evaluation of the theory in the spoken modality. We remove this bottleneck by estimating surprisal directly from the speech signal using a speech LM. This raises a key question: should surprisal be defined over realization-specific acoustic inputs or over abstract linguistic units? Since a single unit can have many distinct acoustic realizations, each assigned a different probability by the model, defining surprisal over abstract units is difficult. To address this, we introduce an importance sampling estimator that approximates the probability of an abstract unit by marginalizing over realizations generated by a text-to-speech model. Using pupillometry data from a listening study, we evaluate surprisal theory in this text-free setting at multiple levels of granularity. Obtaining surprisal from several speech LMs, we consistently find that surprisal estimated via importance sampling better predicts pupil dilation than realization-specific surprisal for words. We also find that surprisal values for sub-lexical units are predictive of pupil dilation. While we find that surprisal can be estimated without recourse to text, and that marginalizing over distinct realizations of words is more predictive of lexical processing effort, surprisal as a whole is not a strong predictor of change in pupil size, regardless of its source.
articles.titleCn: 从语音信号中估计意外性
articles.abstractCn: 尽管语言主要表现为口语，但surprisal理论的实证测试几乎完全依赖于书面文本。在实践中，surprisal是通过在文本上训练的语言模型（LMs）应用于语音转录来估计的，这造成了一个文本瓶颈，限制了该理论在口语模态中的评估。我们通过使用语音LM直接从语音信号中估计surprisal来移除这个瓶颈。这提出了一个关键问题：surprisal应该定义在特定实现的声学输入上，还是定义在抽象的语义词上？由于单个单位可以有多种不同的声学实现，并且每种实现都被模型赋予不同的概率，因此定义在抽象单位上的surprisal是困难的。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个重要性采样估计器，通过边缘化文本到语音模型生成的实现来近似抽象单位的概率。使用来自听力研究的瞳孔测量数据，我们在无文本的设置中，在不同的粒度级别上评估了surprisal理论。从多个语音LM中获取surprisal，我们发现通过重要性采样估计的surprisal比特定实现的surprisal更能预测单词的瞳孔扩张。我们还发现，词下单位的surprisal值可以预测瞳孔扩张。虽然我们发现surprisal可以在不依赖文本的情况下进行估计，并且对单词的不同实现的边缘化更能预测词汇处理努力，但无论其来源如何，surprisal整体上并不是瞳孔大小变化的强预测因子。

articles.title: Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
articles.abstract: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.
articles.titleCn: 从不稳定增长中获得可靠记忆：通过随机实验策展自写代理剧本
articles.abstractCn: 持久性文本记忆使语言模型代理能够在无需重新训练的情况下，通过复用过去任务中的经验教训来提升未来多步任务的表现。ACE和Dynamic Cheatsheet等系统将其视为一份行动指南：代理在每次任务后记录经验教训，并在其提示中读取这些内容。一个关键挑战在于决定哪些经验教训能够改进后续任务。当前系统将决策权交给代理本身，这导致性能不稳定：相同的流程可能编写出有助于提升表现的行动指南，也可能编写出表现下降高达69.6分的指南，甚至比没有行动指南的情况还要差。这些发现促使我们通过任务成功的实际效果来评估经验教训的价值，而不是依赖代理的判断。我们提出了随机区块策展（RBC）方法，该方法通过在练习任务上进行随机实验来衡量这种效果。它将相关的经验教训分组为足够大的区块，以便能够显著影响成功率，并在每次练习任务中随机包含或排除每个区块。随机包含使得有区块和无区块的任务具有可比性，因此它们成功率之间的差距可以估计区块的效果。RBC保留那些有助于提升表现的区块，并且由于相同的流程可能编写出有益或有害的行动指南，因此它会生成多个区块，并根据在新鲜练习片段中的表现最佳来选择完整或无区块的策展方案。在两个记忆系统、三种模型和三种基准测试中，RBC将平均成功率提升至66.9，而完整行动指南的表现为55.5，无行动指南的表现为54.1，当由代理自行选择保留的经验教训时，表现则为53.8。

articles.title: Receiver Decides Agent-to-Agent Negotiations
articles.abstract: When one language-model agent asks another for money, which of the two decides how much changes hands? We ran a round-robin tournament of 1,049 negotiations among fifteen agents. In each game a requester tries to raise money from a holder that has been told to keep a $100 endowment. Knowing which agent holds the money explains 47% of the variance in the amount transferred; knowing which agent asks explains 2%. Dropping the most extreme agents narrows the split to 22% against 4%. Changing the requester's appeal from one named person to a group changed what requesters wrote, but the amounts transferred under the two framings are statistically equivalent. The holders that lose least are the ones that turn down the opening request, and their turn-1 refusal rate ranks them by total losses (Spearman correlation = -0.73). Training moves this behaviour in both directions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on a persuasion corpus with almost no refusals raised what it gave away as a holder from 12% to 84% of the endowment. Distilling two never-losing holders into a 4B student cut its losses from 95% to 1%. Evaluations of agents that hold resources should test them in the holder role, including after persuasion fine-tuning.
articles.titleCn: 接收方决定代理间谈判
articles.abstractCn: 当一个语言模型代理向另一个代理索要金钱时，由哪一方决定交易金额？我们进行了一项包含15个代理的1049轮谈判的循环赛。在每轮游戏中，一个请求者试图从被告知要保留100美元初始资金的持有者那里筹集资金。知道哪个代理持有资金解释了47%的转移金额差异；而知道哪个代理请求则解释了2%。移除最极端的代理将差异缩小到22%对4%。将请求者的请求对象从一个人改为一个群体改变了请求者所写的内容，但在两种框架下的转移金额在统计上没有差异。损失最少的持有者是拒绝初始请求的持有者，他们的第一轮拒绝率按总损失排名（Spearman相关系数=-0.73）。训练可以使这种行为向两个方向转变。在几乎没有拒绝的劝说语料库上微调Qwen3-8B，将其作为持有者给出的金额从初始资金的12%提高到84%。将两个从不亏损的持有者蒸馏成一个4B的学生，将其损失从95%降低到1%。评估持有资源的代理时，应在持有者角色下对其进行测试，包括在劝说微调之后。

articles.title: Agaram 2.5B: The First Tamil-First Language Model Trained from Scratch with Tool Calling. A Playbook for Under-Represented Languages
articles.abstract: We trained Agaram 2.5B, a 2.5-billion-parameter Tamil-English language model, from scratch on about 50 billion tokens (58% Tamil, the rest English, math, code and parallel text) on one node of eight H100 GPUs in about six days, with a new tokenizer that, unlike our first model's, keeps line breaks. Supervised fine-tuning on 134,428 conversations, whose replies an open-weight teacher model wrote, and three short targeted rounds turned it into a chat model that answers in Tamil script, romanized Tamil (Tanglish) and English and can call tools: on 25 tool prompts whose schemas appear in training it picks the right tool 23 times and gives exactly the expected arguments 13 times. The released model translates better than Sarvam-1, a 2B Indic base model, in all six FLORES and IN22 directions (FLORES chrF 54.3 into Tamil and 55.2 into English, against 49.2 and 44.2), and nearly doubles its base model on native-Tamil IndicIFEval (19.3% from 10.0%). It is weak on knowledge: reading-comprehension and knowledge benchmarks sit near chance, and on 50 held-out everyday questions written by one native speaker, one LLM judge rated 46% of its replies usable (22-24 of 50 over three passes; 95% interval for 23 of 50, 33-60%), with nearly every failure a wrong fact. Our two further SFT experiments changed answer format but not the knowledge measures. We also describe our first model, Agaram 1.5B, whose failures shaped the choices here; how the judge's scores varied between passes on identical replies; and, item by item, what the targeted rounds trained against and where frontier-model text entered the data. The project ran on compute credits and our own funds, about USD 13,300 across both models; the weights are released (licence to be announced after legal review), with GGUF files for llama.cpp, at https://huggingface.co/murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct; code at https://github.com/Murai-Labs/Agaram2.5b
articles.titleCn: Agaram 2.5B：首个从零开始训练的泰米尔语第一语言模型，支持工具调用。代表性不足语言的首选方案。
articles.abstractCn: 我们在一台配备八块H100 GPU的节点上，使用约50亿个token（其中58%为泰米尔语，其余为英语、数学、代码和并行文本）从头开始训练了Agaram 2.5B，这是一个拥有250亿参数的泰米尔-英语语言模型，耗时约六天，并采用了一种新的分词器，与我们的首个模型不同，该分词器保留了换行符。在134,428次对话的监督微调中，这些对话的回复由一个开放权重教师模型生成，经过三次短期的针对性训练，使其成为能够以泰米尔文、罗马化泰米尔语（Tanglish）和英语回答问题的聊天模型，并可以调用工具：在25个训练中出现的工具提示中，它23次选择了正确的工具，13次提供了完全符合预期的参数。发布的模型在所有六个FLORES和IN22方向上比2B印度基础模型Sarvam-1翻译效果更好（FLORES chrF 54.3翻译成泰米尔语和55.2翻译成英语，而分别为49.2和44.2），在本土泰米尔语IndicIFEval上几乎翻倍（从10.0%提升至19.3%）。它在知识方面表现较弱：阅读理解和知识基准测试接近随机水平，在50个由一位本土说话者编写的保留日常问题中，一位LLM评委评定了其46%的回复为可用（50个问题中22-24个在三次过审中；95%置信区间为23个问题中的33-60%，几乎每个错误都是事实错误）。我们的两个进一步SFT实验改变了回答格式，但未改变知识指标。我们还描述了我们的首个模型Agaram 1.5B，其失败塑造了当前的选择；评委在相同回复上评分的变化；以及针对性训练针对的内容和前沿模型文本如何进入数据。该项目使用计算积分和自有资金运行，两个模型的总费用约为13,300美元；权重已发布（许可证将在法律审查后公布），提供用于llama.cpp的GGUF文件，可在https://huggingface.co/murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct下载；代码可在https://github.com/Murai-Labs/Agaram2.5b获取。

articles.title: Do Factuality Methods Make LLMs More Factual? Reproducibility and Fair Comparison
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to human preferences, after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps. However, standard RL alignment steps such as RLHF do not focus on factuality of LLMs, hence they may generate non-factual information, which could result in unintended consequences. In response, a number of factuality alignment approaches have been proposed in the literature which claim to improve factuality of LLMs on their own benchmarks. However, these methods have not been reproduced independently and are also not comparable since each uses a different base model, training data, evaluation set, judge, and metric. In this paper, we present the first independent reproduction of five factuality alignment methods, which span on-policy RL (PPO, GRPO, and Dr.~GRPO) and offline preference optimization (DPO and KTO), and compare them on a common benchmark with common evaluation metrics. We found that none of these methods reproduces in full, and on the common benchmark none of the methods significantly outperforms the base model. On closer inspection, the rewards optimize for format, length, or brevity rather than factuality and relevance, whereas the choice between on-policy and offline training matters little. Furthermore, the evaluation metrics and benchmarks are also part of the problem since they do not measure relevance of text to the prompt. Since there is no ground truth associated with the prompts, the reliance on LLM judges and retrieval for verification also makes the evaluation fragile. We release our code, data, and checkpoints.
articles.titleCn: 事实性方法是否使大型语言模型更具事实性？可重复性与公平比较
articles.abstractCn: 在预训练和监督微调步骤之后，大型语言模型（LLMs）与人类偏好保持一致。然而，标准的强化学习对齐步骤（如RLHF）并未关注LLMs的真实性，因此它们可能会生成非事实性信息，从而可能导致意想不到的后果。为此，文献中提出了一系列真实性对齐方法，声称能够在各自的基准上提高LLMs的真实性。然而，这些方法尚未被独立复现，且由于每个方法都使用不同的基础模型、训练数据、评估集、评判者和指标，因此它们之间也不具有可比性。在本文中，我们首次独立复现了五种真实性对齐方法，包括在线策略强化学习（PPO、GRPO和Dr.~GRPO）和离线偏好优化（DPO和KTO），并在一个共同的基准上使用共同的评估指标进行比较。我们发现，这些方法中没有任何一种能够完全复现，并且在共同基准上，这些方法也没有一种显著优于基础模型。仔细分析后，我们发现这些方法优化的奖励是针对格式、长度或简洁性，而非真实性和相关性，而在线策略与离线训练之间的选择也影响不大。此外，评估指标和基准本身也是问题的一部分，因为它们并未衡量文本与提示的相关性。由于提示没有相关的真实标准，依赖LLMs进行评判和检索验证也使得评估变得脆弱。我们发布了我们的代码、数据和检查点。

articles.title: Revisiting the Estimation of Unigram Surprisal in Computational Psycholinguistics
articles.abstract: Contextual and unigram surprisal are standard predictors of reading time in computational psycholinguistics. While contextual surprisal is typically derived from neural language models, unigram surprisal is usually obtained from independent corpus counts. Although both quantities are deterministic functionals of a single underlying distribution---capturing conditional and marginal structure respectively---this practice breaks their probabilistic link and may introduce estimation error from the mismatch. We propose three principles for estimating unigram surprisal in psycholinguistic research, including the requirement that both quantities be derived from the same language model. We operationalize this principle by introducing a Monte Carlo estimator of unigram surprisal from a language model, along with a marginalized variant that has lower variance empirically. When unigram surprisal is re-estimated under this unified framework, we find evidence that predictors change in their predictive contribution to reading time. We also confirm prior findings that frequency can be a stronger predictor of processing effort than contextual surprisal under this unified framework.
articles.titleCn: 重新审视计算心理语言学中单词意外性的估计
articles.abstractCn: 上下文意外度和单词意外度是计算心理语言学研究中的标准阅读时间预测指标。上下文意外度通常由神经语言模型导出，而单词意外度一般通过独立语料库计数获得。尽管这两个量都是基于单一潜在分布的确定性泛函——分别捕捉条件结构和边缘结构——但这种做法割裂了它们的概率联系，并可能因不匹配引入估计误差。我们提出了三种心理语言学研究中文词意外度估计的原则，其中包括要求这两个量都源自同一语言模型。我们通过引入基于语言模型的蒙特卡洛估计算法来操作化这一原则，并提出了一个边缘化变体，其实际方差更低。在统一框架下重新估计单词意外度时，我们发现预测指标的预测贡献对阅读时间的影响发生了变化。我们还证实了先前发现：在统一框架下，频率比上下文意外度更能作为处理努力的强预测指标。

articles.title: Not All Drift Is a Mechanism: Tracing Prompt Adaptation in LLMs
articles.abstract: Prompt-based adaptation offers several ways to specialize a frozen language model, ranging from natural-language prompt optimization to learned continuous prompts. These methods are usually compared through downstream performance, although similar outputs need not arise from similar internal computations. We study how discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning alter the processing of dense and mixture-of-experts language models. Our analysis shows that the location of the adaptation predicts how task information is carried to the output: optimized text primarily changes response construction, input-level prompts write their influence into content representations, and layer-wise prefixes maintain direct control through attention. In MoE models, these differences further induce distinct expert-routing patterns. At the same time, common representation-level measurements respond strongly to generic context changes and do not reliably distinguish useful adaptations from matched placebos. We argue that understanding prompt adaptation requires separating representation drift from the part of that drift that is aligned with, and causally used by, the model's task computation. This perspective provides practical guidance for selecting, evaluating, and interpreting prompt adaptation methods.
articles.titleCn: 并非所有漂移都是机制：追踪大型语言模型中的提示适应
articles.abstractCn: 基于提示的适配提供多种方式来专门化冻结的语言模型，从自然语言提示优化到学习式连续提示。这些方法通常通过下游性能进行比较，尽管相似的输出不一定源于相似的内部计算。我们研究了离散提示优化、提示调整和前缀调整如何改变密集和专家混合语言模型的处理过程。我们的分析表明，适配的位置决定了任务信息如何被传递到输出：优化的文本主要改变响应构建，输入级提示将其影响写入内容表示，而层级前缀通过注意力机制保持直接控制。在专家混合模型中，这些差异进一步诱导了不同的专家路由模式。与此同时，常见的表示级测量对通用上下文变化反应强烈，并不能可靠地区分有用的适配与匹配的安慰剂。我们认为，理解提示适配需要将表示漂移与其中与模型任务计算相一致且被其因果使用的漂移部分区分开来。这一视角为选择、评估和解释提示适配方法提供了实际指导。

articles.title: Prompt-Injection Probes Learn the Conversation, Not Just the Injection
articles.abstract: Linear probes on a model's hidden states are used as cheap monitors for indirect prompt injection: they screen the tool outputs an agent reads and send suspicious ones to a slower second check, so every false alarm has a cost. But a probe learns whatever separates its training examples. The standard evaluation of injection probes can be passed without the model: conversation position and text lengths alone reach 0.91-0.98 AUROC. When each attack is compared with the same conversation without the injection, or with harmless text formatted like an injection, standard probes flag most of these harmless cases. We add such cases to the training data as matched negatives. Across six open models, in applications seen during training and at the default threshold, changing only the training data cuts false alarms on injection-free conversations from 41-80% to 4-27%, and on harmless look-alikes from 92-98% to 3-16%. With a threshold set on normal traffic, our probe still catches a median 95% of the attacks that fooled the agent (91% without our data). In new applications, false alarms stay low, but detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set. The same data also helps a text-only filter.
articles.titleCn: 提示注入探测学习对话，而不仅仅是注入
articles.abstractCn: 模型隐藏状态上的线性探测被用作间接提示注入的廉价监控器：它们筛选代理读取的工具输出，并将可疑内容发送至更慢的第二道检查，因此每个误报都会产生成本。但探测会学习其训练样本中所有不同的特征。注入探测的标准评估可以在不使用模型的情况下通过：仅凭对话位置和文本长度即可达到0.91-0.98的AUROC。当将每次攻击与未注入的相同对话或格式化成注入的无害文本进行比较时，标准探测会标记大多数这些无害情况。我们将此类情况作为匹配负样本添加到训练数据中。在六个公开模型中，在训练期间遇到的用例和默认阈值下，仅更改训练数据可将无注入对话的误报率从41-80%降至4-27%，无害类似文本的误报率从92-98%降至3-16%。在正常流量上设置阈值时，我们的探测仍能捕获中位数95%的欺骗代理的攻击（无我们的数据时为91%）。在新用例中，误报率保持较低，但检测效果取决于模型和阈值设置。相同的数据也有助于纯文本过滤器。

articles.title: Multi-Stream Residual Computation in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models reconstruct masked tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive generation. Yet their Transformer backbones typically carry visible evidence and evolving masked predictions through a single residual stream. We equip masked diffusion models with multiple residual streams that persist through depth and adaptive routing between them, then investigate how they support these complementary roles. On the pretraining task, two streams reduce reconstruction perplexity by 5.71% on validation data and 5.13% on average across external corpora compared with standard residual connections. We observe that, without predefined roles, visible and masked positions learn distinct routing patterns. Causal interventions show that this distinction organizes read and write routing, while token-specific write strength remains important within each role. Guided by these findings, a model trained with role-conditioned routing recovers half the validation gain from adding a second stream. State interventions explain the benefit of the additional stream: it preserves early token representations for later reuse while evidence accumulates at masked positions. This mechanism recurs at a larger model scale, showing how persistent streams support context preservation alongside prediction refinement.
articles.titleCn: 扩散语言模型中的多流残差计算
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型并行重建掩码标记，为自回归生成提供了替代方案。然而，它们的Transformer骨干通常通过单一残差流传递可见证据和不断演变的掩码预测。我们为掩码扩散模型配备了多个贯穿深度的残差流，并在它们之间进行自适应路由，然后研究了它们如何支持这些互补功能。在预训练任务中，与标准残差连接相比，两条流在验证数据上降低了5.71%的重建困惑度，在外部语料库上的平均困惑度降低了5.13%。我们观察到，在没有预定义角色的情况下，可见位置和掩码位置学习到不同的路由模式。因果干预表明，这种区别组织了读和写路由，而特定标记的写强度在每个角色内部仍然重要。根据这些发现，一个使用角色条件路由训练的模型从添加第二条流中恢复了验证增益的一半。状态干预解释了额外一条流的益处：它保留了早期标记表示以供后续重用，同时掩码位置上的证据不断积累。这种机制在更大的模型规模上重复出现，展示了持久流如何在预测精炼的同时支持上下文保留。

articles.title: PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to reduce reliance on costly human evaluation, yet their scores can systematically disagree with human judgments. We ask whether responses to an explicitly imposed evaluative bias can help correct a judge's implicit scoring biases. We introduce PRISM (Probe-based Residual Inference of Scoring Misalignment), which holds the evaluated content fixed and measures score changes when attributes are emphasized or de-emphasized. A local sensitivity model motivates representing these responses as a surrogate Jacobian. Ridge regression on human labels learns a correction to the baseline score. The resulting scoring protocol is rubric-free: it uses overall scores without requesting criterion-level ratings. In the main Jev and Sol comparisons on SummEval summarization and HANNA story evaluation, PRISM and its learned-baseline variant significantly improve agreement with human rankings over uncalibrated scores while remaining competitive with rubric-based methods. A controlled SummEval comparison yields similar agreement for rubric-derived quality probes and style probes, supporting calibration without reproducing rubric criteria. The learned coefficients reveal shared and opposing correction directions across judges.
articles.titleCn: PRISM：使用反事实探针校准黑盒裁判
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作评判者，以减少对昂贵人工评估的依赖，但它们的评分可能与人类判断系统性地不一致。我们探讨了针对明确强加的评估偏见所做出的回应是否有助于纠正评判者的隐含评分偏见。我们引入了PRISM（基于探测的评分错位残差推理），该模型保持被评估内容固定，并在强调或淡化属性时测量评分变化。一个局部敏感性模型促使我们将这些回应表示为一个替代雅可比矩阵。对人类标签的岭回归学习了对基准分数的校正。由此产生的评分协议是无评分标准的：它使用总体分数，而不要求提供标准层面的评分。在SummEval摘要和HANNA故事评估的主要Jev和Sol比较中，PRISM及其学习基准变体在未经校准的评分上显著提高了与人类排序的一致性，同时保持了与基于评分标准的方法的竞争力。一项受控的SummEval比较表明，基于评分标准的质量探测和风格探测在一致性上相似，支持校准而不重复评分标准。学习到的系数揭示了不同评判者之间共享和相反的校正方向。

articles.title: Pin It on Anyone: Certified Targeted Displacement of Multi-Bit LLM Watermarks Without the Key
articles.abstract: Multi-bit watermarking embeds a message, typically an account identifier, into LLM output so that harmful text can be traced to its origin. We show an attack technique that allows to alter the watermarking message. This allows to, for example, exchange the embedded account ID to an arbitrary different one. The attacker mainly needs access to a few accounts for generating LLM output and model logits, but crucially not the secret key used to watermark. The attacker then rewrites the text, keeping its meaning, so that the watermarking message decoder recovers the watermarking message embedded by the attacker. We are, to our knowledge, the first to propose such an attack, which we call a targeted displacement. Theoretically, we present upper and lower bounds on the probability of our attack succeeding. This bound depends on the number of accounts the attacker has access to, the length of the message and some characteristics of the given text. Our attack can succeed whenever we can bound the ambiguity of the generated text well enough. Empirically, we test our attack technique against five watermarking methods and four LLMs. Attack success tracks our predicted bounds, allowing us to alter watermarking messages in almost all cases with high accuracy, given enough accounts. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Batorskq/PinIt.
articles.titleCn: 将任何人都钉在目标上：无需密钥的多比特LLM水印的认证目标位移
articles.abstractCn: 多比特水印技术将信息（通常是账户标识符）嵌入到大型语言模型（LLM）的输出中，以便追踪有害文本的来源。我们展示了一种可以修改水印信息的攻击技术。这允许例如将嵌入的账户ID替换为任意不同的ID。攻击者主要需要访问几个账户来生成LLM输出和模型逻辑值，但关键在于不需要使用用于水印的密钥。攻击者随后重写文本，保持其含义，以便水印信息解码器能够恢复攻击者嵌入的水印信息。据我们所知，我们首次提出了这种攻击，称之为定向偏移。理论上，我们提出了我们攻击成功的概率的上限和下限。该界限取决于攻击者可以访问的账户数量、信息的长度以及给定文本的一些特征。只要我们能够足够好地界定生成文本的歧义性，我们的攻击就能成功。实证上，我们使用五种水印方法和四种LLM测试了我们的攻击技术。攻击成功率符合我们的预测界限，允许我们在有足够账户的情况下，以高精度几乎在所有情况下修改水印信息。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/Batorskq/PinIt 找到。

articles.title: Lightweight but Linguistically Fair? Quantisation Robustness across Bavarian, German, and English
articles.abstract: Post-training quantisation reduces the memory cost of large language models, but it remains unclear whether compression preserves language skills of regional varieties as reliably as their standard-language counterparts. We study this question for Bavarian, Standard German, and English using BAVGROUND, a multiple-choice benchmark, where 206 source questions are aligned across all three languages. Across 14 open-weight 7B--10B instruction models, we compare BF16 with 8-bit GPTQ and two 4-bit settings, GPTQ and AWQ. Eight-bit GPTQ remains close to BF16 and largely preserves the relative behaviour of the three languages, while 4-bit quantisation was found to be much less stable. The two 4-bit methods reduce average accuracy by about 1.4--1.5 percentage points and change 11.9--16.0% of BF16 decisions, with changes concentrated on examples where the BF16 model is already uncertain. This instability does not translate into a consistent Bavarian disadvantage. Although Bavarian, a low-resource dialect, has lower baseline accuracy than German and English, the language most affected at 4 bits varies across models and quantisation methods. Calibration further shapes these cross-language effects: the relative Bavarian--German effect changes with calibration language, while changing the calibration source has little average effect on GPTQ-4 but can affect AWQ-4 much more strongly. Free-form evaluation on five models further shows that 4-bit compression can degrade generated responses even in settings where multiple-choice accuracy changes only modestly, while 8-bit GPTQ remains comparatively stable. Overall, our results show that quantisation robustness for regional language varieties depends on the model, quantisation method, calibration data, and evaluation setting, and cannot be measured by aggregate multilingual accuracy alone.
articles.titleCn: 轻量级但语言公平？跨巴伐利亚、德语和英语的量化鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 训练后量化可以降低大型语言模型的内存成本，但目前尚不清楚压缩是否像标准语言对应物一样可靠地保留地区方言的语言技能。我们使用BAVGROUND（一个多项选择题基准）研究了巴伐利亚语、标准德语和英语的这个问题，其中206个源问题在三种语言中进行了对齐。在14个开放权重7B--10B指令模型中，我们比较了BF16与8位GPTQ以及两个4位设置GPTQ和AWQ。8位GPTQ仍然接近BF16，并基本保留了三种语言的相对行为，而4位量化被发现稳定性较差。两种4位方法使平均准确率降低了约1.4--1.5个百分点，并改变了BF16决策的11.9--16.0%，变化集中在BF16模型已经不确定的示例上。这种不稳定性并没有转化为一致的巴伐利亚语劣势。尽管作为低资源方言的巴伐利亚语，其基线准确率低于德语和英语，但在4位时受影响最大的语言在模型和量化方法之间有所不同。校准进一步塑造了这些跨语言效应：相对的巴伐利亚语--德语效应会随着校准语言的变化而变化，而改变校准源对GPTQ-4的平均影响较小，但可能对AWQ-4产生更大的影响。对五个模型进行的自由形式评估进一步表明，即使在多项选择题准确率变化微小的设置中，4位压缩也会降低生成的响应，而8位GPTQ则相对稳定。总的来说，我们的结果表明，地区语言品种的量化鲁棒性取决于模型、量化方法、校准数据和评估设置，不能仅通过综合多语言准确率来衡量。

articles.title: Probing the Geometry of Color Representations in Multilingual Language Models
articles.abstract: Do multilingual language models learn a universal internal geometry for color, and is it perceptually grounded or primarily linguistic? We decompose color representations into two geometric axes: (P1) alignment to perceptual color space, and (P2) cross-lingual symmetry. Analyzing layerwise embeddings across models and multilingual datasets, we find that perceptual grounding is weak: alignment to CIE-LAB peaks in intermediate layers, then collapses toward output layers. Cross-lingual symmetry degrades with depth, suggesting later layers encode language-specific structure. Functionally, we show that geometric properties predict task performance: models achieve 96.7% accuracy on color classification at layers where P1 alignment peaks, with P1 alignment (r=0.70) significantly correlating with downstream capabilities. Our results reveal a dissociation: text-only LMs learn universal color-language geometry, not universal color-perception geometry, providing diagnostics for where perceptual structure is preserved in language models.
articles.titleCn: 探究多语言模型中颜色表示的几何结构
articles.abstractCn: 多语言语言模型是否学习到了关于颜色的通用内部几何结构，这种结构是基于感知还是主要基于语言？我们将颜色表示分解为两个几何轴：(P1) 与感知颜色空间的对齐，以及 (P2) 跨语言对称性。通过分析跨模型和多语言数据集的逐层嵌入，我们发现感知基础是薄弱的：对齐与 CIE-LAB 在中间层达到峰值，然后在输出层崩溃。跨语言对称性随着深度减弱，表明深层编码了语言特定的结构。功能上，我们证明了几何属性可以预测任务表现：模型在 P1 对齐达到峰值层时，在颜色分类任务上达到 96.7% 的准确率，且 P1 对齐 (r=0.70) 与下游能力显著相关。我们的结果表明存在一种分离现象：纯文本语言模型学习了通用的颜色-语言几何结构，而非通用的颜色-感知几何结构，为感知结构在语言模型中的保留位置提供了诊断依据。

articles.title: Jev-Guard: Fast Routing and Auditing Agent Actions over Editable Policy Trees
articles.abstract: Agent harnesses require a low-latency guardrail model together with customizable audit policies. However, deploying an auto-regressive guardrail model remains challenging: such models incur high inference latency and are often poorly aligned with customized policies. To address these problems, we present Jev-Guard, a unified model for safety classification and policy routing. We further construct a policy tree over which Jev-Guard performs routing, spanning diverse domains including content moderation, cybersecurity, privacy, and legal compliance. Specifically, Jev-Guard first navigates the policy tree to select the applicable audit policy given the caller's audit context, and then performs safety classification conditioned on the retrieved policies. On 7,033 evaluation cases, Jev-Guard achieves 93.72\% safety accuracy, a mean latency of 58ms, and 93.10\% hierarchical routing accuracy. The full routing-and-classification pipeline averages 240ms. Furthermore, we integrate Jev-Guard into the Hermes harness framework. Across agent trajectories, its separate permission gate cuts mean review time per task from 4.80s for an SFT-LLM judge to 1.33s, with no policy violations are observed for either guard.
articles.titleCn: Jev-Guard：快速在可编辑策略树上路由和审计代理行为
articles.abstractCn: 代理工具需要低延迟的防护栏模型以及可定制的审计策略。然而，部署自回归防护栏模型仍然存在挑战：此类模型会导致高推理延迟，并且通常与定制策略难以匹配。为解决这些问题，我们提出了Jev-Guard，这是一种用于安全分类和策略路由的统一模型。我们进一步构建了一个策略树，Jev-Guard在其上执行路由，涵盖内容审核、网络安全、隐私和法律合规等多个领域。具体而言，Jev-Guard首先在策略树上导航，根据调用者的审计上下文选择适用的审计策略，然后基于检索到的策略执行安全分类。在7,033个评估案例中，Jev-Guard实现了93.72%的安全准确率、58毫秒的平均延迟以及93.10%的层级路由准确率。完整的路由与分类流程平均耗时240毫秒。此外，我们将Jev-Guard集成到Hermes工具框架中。在代理轨迹中，其独立的权限门控将每项任务的审查时间从SFT-LLM裁判的4.80秒缩短至1.33秒，且两个防护栏均未发现策略违规。

articles.title: Prompt or Policy? Optimizing Physician Slate Presentations with LLM User Simulators
articles.abstract: Choosing the right physician is a key challenge for patients seeking medical care. Physician recommendation systems identify relevant doctors, but patients still find it difficult to compare their profiles to make a decision. We formulate slate presentation optimization: given a patient's medical case and a fixed, ranked list of physicians, we generate short, case-specific summaries that make doctors easier to compare, while remaining grounded in the information in their profiles. To optimize physician presentations without relying on real patient interactions, we develop an offline framework that uses persona-conditioned LLMs to simulate patient choices. We generate patient personas from attributes extracted from each medical case and evaluate presentations for factual accuracy, relevance, naturalness and simulated patient choice. We also use a second LLM judge, unseen during optimization, to assess simulator-specific overfitting. We compare automatic prompt-level optimization with GEPA, parameter-level optimization with GRPO, and their combination across two model sizes. GRPO substantially outperforms GEPA in satisfying the full set of constraints, and its gains in simulated conversion persist under the unseen judge. GEPA alone brings smaller improvements, but using its optimized prompt to initialize GRPO speeds up training and achieves the highest simulated conversion. These results show that prompt-level and parameter-level optimization play complementary roles in improving how physician recommendations are presented.
articles.titleCn: 提示词还是策略？利用大型语言模型用户模拟器优化医生名单展示
articles.abstractCn: 选择合适的医生是寻求医疗服务的患者面临的关键挑战。医生推荐系统可以识别相关医生，但患者仍然难以比较他们的资料以做出决定。我们提出了版面呈现优化：给定患者的医疗案例和一份固定的、排名靠前的医生名单，我们生成简短、针对案例的摘要，使医生更容易比较，同时仍然基于他们资料中的信息。为了在不依赖真实患者互动的情况下优化医生呈现，我们开发了一个离线框架，该框架使用角色条件大型语言模型来模拟患者选择。我们从每个医疗案例中提取属性来生成患者角色，并评估呈现的真实性、相关性、自然度和模拟患者选择。我们还使用一个在优化过程中未见过的第二个大型语言模型裁判来评估模拟器特定的过拟合。我们比较了自动提示级优化与GEPA、参数级优化与GRPO，以及它们在两种模型大小下的组合。GRPO在满足所有约束条件方面大幅优于GEPA，其在模拟转化方面的收益在未见过的裁判下仍然持续。GEPA单独带来的改进较小，但使用其优化的提示来初始化GRPO可以加速训练并实现最高的模拟转化。这些结果表明，提示级和参数级优化在改进医生推荐呈现方式方面发挥着互补作用。

articles.title: SimInter: Evidence-Grounded User Simulation with Interview-Based Profile Enrichment for Conversational Recommender Systems
articles.abstract: Conversational Recommender Systems (CRSs) require reliable user simulators for cost-effective evaluation. LLM-based simulators have made realistic simulation possible but typically condition on profiles derived from explicit ratings, demographics, and static sources capturing surface preferences while omitting implicit behavioral characteristics such as decision-making style, aspect-level preferences, and domain expertise. We propose SimInter, a pipeline that elicits these attributes via synthetic interviews between two LLM agents, grounded in the user's statistical profile and historical conversational evidence. Before profile enrichment, an audit agent explicitly flags potential fabrication and stereotyping at the turn level. We instantiate and evaluate SimInter on movie recommendation. We simulate 300 ReDial users and, on a matched subset of 100 users, compare SimInter with a statistics-only baseline: SimInter significantly increases the diversity of expressed preference aspects (filtered aspect entropy: 1.619 vs. 0.859; paired d = 0.96, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001). This gain persists when the simulator converses with two trained recommenders, KBRD and UniCRS, under two independent evaluation judges (+0.28 to +0.56 nats; all p < 0.001). Human evaluation finds 94.3% of enriched-attribute claims supported or partially supported, while human judgments agree with 95.2% of the auditor's binary filtering decisions on a stratified sample.
articles.comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 12 tables. Erfan Shahabi and Amirhossein Roshandel contributed equally
articles.titleCn: SimInter：基于访谈式资料丰富证据驱动的用户模拟对话推荐系统
articles.abstractCn: 对话式推荐系统（CRSs）需要可靠的用户模拟器以实现成本效益高的评估。基于LLM的模拟器使得逼真的模拟成为可能，但通常基于显式评分、人口统计和静态来源构建用户画像，这些来源捕捉的是表面偏好，而忽略了隐式行为特征，如决策风格、方面级偏好和领域专业知识。我们提出了SimInter，这是一个通过两个LLM代理之间的合成访谈来获取这些属性的流程，该流程基于用户的统计画像和历史对话证据。在用户画像丰富之前，审计代理会明确标记潜在的捏造和刻板印象。我们在电影推荐领域实例化和评估了SimInter。我们模拟了300个ReDial用户，并在100个匹配用户子集上，将SimInter与仅基于统计数据的基线进行了比较：SimInter显著增加了表达偏好的方面多样性（过滤后的方面熵：1.619 vs. 0.859；配对d = 0.96，Holm调整p < 0.001）。当模拟器与两个训练好的推荐器KBRD和UniCRS在两个独立的评估法官下对话时，这一增益仍然存在（+0.28至+0.56 nat；所有p < 0.001）。人类评估发现，94.3%的丰富属性声明得到了支持或部分支持，而在分层样本中，人类判断与审计代理的二进制过滤决策有95.2%的一致性。

articles.title: LegalRewardBench: Benchmarking Reward Models for Legal Preference Evaluation
articles.abstract: Reward models are central to preference alignment for legal tasks, yet existing reward model benchmarks are still primarily centered on general-domain preferences. In this work, we introduce LegalRewardBench, the first human-verified benchmark for evaluating reward models in the legal domain. The benchmark organizes legal preference evaluation into five capability levels: knowledge, understanding, analysis, decision, and writing, and preference examples are constructed through rubric-guided automatic judging combined with human verification. We evaluate three families of judges, covering both general and fine-tuned models, and generative and discriminative architectures. Experimental results show that strong general-purpose generative models are currently the most robust legal reward models, while existing fine-tuned reward models transfer less reliably to legal preference evaluation. We also conduct detailed comparisons of input organizations and training strategies.
articles.titleCn: 法律奖励基准：用于法律偏好评估的奖励模型基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 奖励模型是法律任务中偏好对齐的核心，然而现有的奖励模型基准仍然主要集中于通用领域偏好。在这项工作中，我们引入了LegalRewardBench，这是首个用于评估法律领域奖励模型的人工验证基准。该基准将法律偏好评估组织为五个能力层级：知识、理解、分析、决策和写作，偏好示例通过基于评分标准的自动评判结合人工验证构建。我们评估了三组评判者，涵盖通用和微调模型，以及生成和判别架构。实验结果表明，强大的通用生成模型是目前最稳健的法律奖励模型，而现有的微调奖励模型在法律偏好评估中的迁移能力较低。我们还进行了详细的输入组织与训练策略比较。

articles.title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
articles.abstract: Autonomous research agents must acquire and reason over evidence within a limited budget. Yet relevant sources can remain uninspected or unused, leaving a gap between retrieval coverage and the evidence that informs research. The challenge is to align fast local judgments with changing evidence needs and feed their findings back into research decisions. We introduce JevGPT, a dual-system architecture for autonomous research that couples fast evidence processing with deliberative research planning. System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates findings, while System One locates support, assesses relevance, and guides further inspection. Independent source judgments run in parallel; selected original passages inform the next research step. Experiments on fixed-corpus question answering and document ranking show that JevGPT achieves leading task performance, with faster completion and lower cost than comparably effective research agents. Evidence analysis shows broader source inspection and greater coverage of supporting documents in the research loop, highlighting efficient evidence processing as a route to more capable autonomous research.
articles.titleCn: 杰夫GPT：自主研究中的快思考与慢思考
articles.abstractCn: 自主研究代理必须在有限的预算内获取和推理证据。然而，相关来源可能仍然未被检查或未被使用，导致检索覆盖范围与指导研究的证据之间存在差距。挑战在于如何使快速局部判断与不断变化的研究需求相协调，并将它们的发现反馈到研究决策中。我们介绍了JevGPT，这是一种用于自主研究的双重系统架构，将快速证据处理与审慎的研究规划相结合。系统二设定证据目标并整合发现，而系统一负责定位支持、评估相关性并指导进一步检查。独立的来源判断并行运行；选定的原始段落为下一步研究提供信息。在固定语料库问答和文档排序实验中，JevGPT实现了领先的任务性能，其完成速度更快，成本低于同等有效的自主研究代理。证据分析显示，在研究循环中，来源检查范围更广，支持性文档覆盖面更大，突显了高效证据处理作为提升自主研究能力的途径。

articles.title: PAINT: A Framework for Multilingual Pain Representation from Medical Licensing Exams to Real-World Clinical Texts
articles.abstract: Pain is one of the most common and clinically important symptoms, reflecting disease onset, progression, and treatment response. However, pain is difficult to accurately capture and interpret from medical text, as its expression varies across languages, documentation types, and patient demographics, and is often embedded in terminology, negation, temporality, and contextual descriptions. Existing pain-related studies remain largely monolingual or limited to narrow clinical settings. In this study, we introduce PAINT, a multilingual framework for studying pain representation across medical exams and real-world clinical texts. PAINT includes nine pain-focused dataset partitions spanning English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese, with clinician annotations in all four languages. We curated a structured schema covering pain relevance, pain presence, anatomical location, pain descriptors, and demographic information. To capture multilingual pain representations, we leverage large language models (LLMs) and adopt an ensemble strategy to improve performance. Ten clinicians across four languages validate the labels: the ensemble reaches macro-F1 of 0.91-1.00 on pain relevance and pain presence and 92-100% accuracy on demographics, with inter-annotator $κ$ of 0.82-1.00. We release the WorldMedQA-Pain ensemble labels, the extraction pipeline, validation scripts, and clinician annotation sheets for publicly licensed corpora, providing a foundation for pain-centered clinical NLP and for studying pain documentation across languages and healthcare contexts.
articles.comment: Accepted at Proceedings of the 6th Workshop on Multilingual Representation Learning (MRL 2026), EMNLP 2026, Budapest
articles.titleCn: PAINT：一个从医学执照考试到真实世界临床文本的多语言疼痛表示框架
articles.abstractCn: 疼痛是最常见且具有重要临床意义的症状之一，它反映了疾病的发作、进展和治疗反应。然而，从医学文本中准确捕捉和解读疼痛信息十分困难，因为其表达方式因语言、文档类型和患者群体差异而异，并且常常嵌入在术语、否定、时间性和情境描述中。现有的疼痛相关研究大多保持单语性或局限于狭窄的临床环境。在本研究中，我们引入了PAINT，一个用于研究医疗检查和真实世界临床文本中疼痛表达的多语言框架。PAINT包含九个以疼痛为重点的数据集分区，涵盖英语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语和日语，并在四种语言中均有临床医生的标注。我们构建了一个结构化模式，涵盖疼痛相关性、疼痛存在性、解剖位置、疼痛描述和人口统计信息。为捕捉多语言疼痛表达，我们利用大型语言模型（LLMs）并采用集成策略以提升性能。来自四种语言的十位临床医生验证了标签：集成策略在疼痛相关性和疼痛存在性上达到宏观F1值0.91-1.00，在人口统计信息上达到92-100%的准确率，标注者间κ系数为0.82-1.00。我们公开发布了WorldMedQA-Pain集成标签、提取流程、验证脚本和临床医生标注表格，为以疼痛为中心的临床自然语言处理以及跨语言和医疗环境下的疼痛文档研究提供基础。

articles.title: Encrypted Skills Can Become New Security Exploits If AI Agents Know How to Decipher
articles.abstract: Third-party skills can expose LLM agents to malicious instructions hidden by encoding. We introduce Ciphered Skill Injection (CSI), which embeds such instructions in skill files for agents to decode and follow. We evaluate Caesar and layered variants across eight models and 139 injection-task pairs, separating instruction recovery from attack success. In the primary setting with shortened skills, the variants achieve attack success rates of up to 47.5% and 40.3%, respectively. Successful decoding does not guarantee attack success, and layering has model-dependent effects. The tested skill scanners rarely flag injected skills. These findings highlight the risk of promoting decoded, untrusted content into actionable instructions.
articles.titleCn: 如果人工智能代理知道如何解密，加密技能可能会成为新的安全漏洞。
articles.abstractCn: 第三方技能可能使大型语言模型代理暴露于被编码隐藏的恶意指令。我们引入了加密技能注入（CSI），将此类指令嵌入技能文件中，供代理解码并执行。我们在八个模型和139个注入任务对上评估了凯撒及其分层变体，将指令恢复与攻击成功分开评估。在技能缩短的主要设置中，这些变体分别实现了高达47.5%和40.3%的攻击成功率。成功的解码并不保证攻击成功，分层具有模型依赖性。测试的技能扫描器很少能标记出注入的技能。这些发现突出了将解码后的不可信内容推广为可执行指令的风险。

articles.title: Are We Testing Too Much? A Survey of Benchmark Compression for Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating and improving large language models (LLMs). Yet many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Benchmark compression lowers this cost by estimating full-benchmark scores and rankings from a partial evaluation. Research in this area has grown rapidly since 2024, but to our knowledge no survey has systematically organized its methods and findings. We review 119 papers to explain how methods choose what to evaluate, recover full-benchmark results, and verify their reliability. From this analysis, we develop a taxonomy covering compression within individual benchmarks, across benchmark suites, and during adaptive evaluation, together with work on redundancy and reliability. We compare their information needs, total costs, reliability checks, and limitations. Methods reduce evaluation costs by selecting representative subsets, using cheaper or reusable information, and testing adaptively, but risk poor coverage, inaccurate estimates, and sequential delays. The resulting taxonomy and practical guide help researchers choose, validate, and deploy methods for more efficient and reliable LLM evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 我们测试得太多了吗？一项关于基准压缩对大型语言模型高效评估的调研
articles.abstractCn: 基准测试对于评估和改进大型语言模型（LLM）至关重要。然而，许多广泛使用的基准测试存在冗余，导致评估成本不必要地高昂。基准测试压缩通过从部分评估中估计完整基准测试的分数和排名来降低这种成本。自2024年以来，该领域的研究发展迅速，但据我们所知，还没有调查系统地组织其方法和成果。我们回顾了119篇论文，以解释方法如何选择要评估的内容、恢复完整基准测试结果以及验证其可靠性。基于此分析，我们开发了一个分类法，涵盖单个基准测试内的压缩、跨基准测试套件的压缩以及在自适应评估期间的压缩，以及关于冗余和可靠性的研究。我们比较了它们的信息需求、总成本、可靠性检查和局限性。这些方法通过选择代表性子集、使用更便宜或可重复使用的信息以及进行自适应测试来降低评估成本，但存在覆盖范围不足、估计不准确和顺序延迟的风险。由此产生的分类法和实用指南有助于研究人员选择、验证和部署方法，以实现更高效和可靠的LLM评估。

articles.title: PACT: A Pragmatic Prompting Framework for Expressive and Voice-Preserving Speech-to-Speech Translation
articles.abstract: Speech-to-speech translation should preserve not only what is said, but also who says it and how it is said. Existing end-to-end S2ST, speech MLLM, and cascade systems can preserve content or timbre, but often struggle to realize emotion, tone, rhythm, pauses, and pragmatic attitude in the target language. We propose PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. PACT extracts source pragmatic cues, projects them into the target-language expression space, calibrates the projected representation to a realizable target subspace, and converts it into continuous prompts for a frozen speech generator. On bidirectional Spanish-English TOPI evaluation, PACT achieves the best overall performance among evaluated systems across content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation metrics.
articles.titleCn: PACT：一种用于表达性且保留语音的语音到语音翻译的实用提示框架
articles.abstractCn: 语音到语音翻译不仅要保留所说的内容，还要保留说话人和说话方式。现有的端到端S2ST、语音MLLM和级联系统可以保留内容或音色，但往往难以实现目标语言中的情感、语调、节奏、停顿和语用态度。我们提出了PACT，一个用于表达性语音保留S2ST的目标空间语用提示框架。PACT提取源语语用线索，将其投影到目标语言表达空间，校准投影表示到可实现的目标子空间，并将其转换为冻结语音生成器的连续提示。在双向西班牙语-英语TOPI评估中，PACT在内容保真度、语音保留和表达保留指标上均实现了评估系统中的最佳整体性能。

articles.title: Consider, Then Choose: Order-Invariant Decisions in System One Models
articles.abstract: System One models answer typed questions in a single forward pass and promise the same answer for the same input. For choice questions, this promise fails: the answer depends on the order of the options, increasingly so as they grow in number, and averaging over their cyclic shifts reduces this dependence without removing it. Scoring each option alone, which the order cannot affect, shows that the order changes the answer mostly when the model is unsure among its top few options, even though the listwise answer looks confident. We therefore propose $\textbf{Runoff}$, which considers, then chooses: it scores each option alone to keep a few candidates, then compares them in listings where each candidate takes every position. It needs no training and can run in two forward passes, and its answer does not depend on the option order by construction. On two open models and five datasets, it changes no answer under shuffling, against 9.3% for cyclic averaging, and with 20 options it is about as accurate and three to four times faster. Wrapped around eight System One models, it removes the order dependence of the five benchmarks, while cyclic averaging changes up to 15.4%.
articles.titleCn: 考虑，然后选择：系统一模型中的顺序不变决策
articles.abstractCn: 系统一模型在单次前向传递中回答键入式问题，并承诺对相同输入给出相同答案。但在选择题中，这一承诺会失效：答案取决于选项的顺序，随着选项数量的增加，这种依赖性会增强，而对其循环移位进行平均可以减少这种依赖性，但无法完全消除。单独对每个选项进行评分——顺序无法影响这一点——表明，当模型在它排名靠前的几个选项中不确定时，顺序会改变答案，即使整体答案看起来很自信。因此，我们提出了$\textbf{Runoff}$方法，它考虑后再选择：它单独对每个选项进行评分以保留几个候选选项，然后在列表中比较它们，其中每个候选选项都占据每个位置。它无需训练，可以在两次前向传递中运行，并且其答案在构造上不依赖于选项顺序。在两个开放模型和五个数据集上，它在随机打乱时不会改变答案，而循环平均会改变9.3%，并且当选项数量为20时，它的准确性与循环平均相当，但速度快了三到四倍。将其包装在八个系统一模型中，它可以消除五个基准测试的顺序依赖性，而循环平均会改变高达15.4%。

articles.title: TextualRL: Textual Reinforcement Learning for Context Management
articles.abstract: LLM agents can adapt to task feedback by revising the textual context that guides their behavior, without changing their model parameters. However, turning execution rewards into reusable context updates is challenging: individual trajectories offer limited comparative evidence about what to change, while task-specific fixes may overgeneralize when incorporated into a shared context. We introduce TextualRL, a gradient-free reinforcement learning framework that treats a group of rollouts from the same task under the same context, rather than an isolated trajectory, as the unit of policy critique. Groupwise Policy Critique contrasts successful and failed rollouts within a task; when outcomes are uniform, it draws on cross-task evidence to identify behaviors worth preserving or formulate repair hypotheses. Cross-Group Policy Update reviews the resulting proposals against evidence pooled across groups, including observations that yield no proposed edit, to refine their content and applicability. Reviewed proposals form a bounded textual patch, with adoption of the candidate context determined by held-out validation rewards. Together, these components establish a reward-driven policy optimization loop in which multiple attempts jointly inform reusable context updates. We evaluate TextualRL with five target agents on six benchmarks. Averaged over the six benchmarks, TextualRL improves test accuracy over the base model by 24.4 and 15.3 percentage points for GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-27B, respectively.
articles.titleCn: 文本强化学习：用于上下文管理的文本强化学习
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理可以通过修订指导其行为的文本上下文来适应任务反馈，而无需更改其模型参数。然而，将执行奖励转化为可重用的上下文更新具有挑战性：单个轨迹只能提供有限的比较证据来决定如何更改，而特定任务的修复措施在整合到共享上下文中时可能会过度泛化。我们引入了TextualRL，这是一个无梯度的强化学习框架，它将相同任务下在相同上下文中的多个轨迹（rollouts）视为策略评估的单位，而不是孤立的轨迹。分组策略评估（Groupwise Policy Critique）对比任务中成功和失败的轨迹；当结果一致时，它利用跨任务的证据来识别值得保留的行为或提出修复假设。跨组策略更新（Cross-Group Policy Update）则根据跨组的证据（包括那些未提出编辑的观察结果）来审查这些提议，以完善其内容和适用性。经过审查的提议形成一个有界的文本补丁，候选上下文的采纳由保留的验证奖励决定。这些组件共同建立了一个奖励驱动的策略优化循环，其中多次尝试共同指导可重用的上下文更新。我们使用五个目标代理在六个基准测试中评估了TextualRL。在六个基准测试上取平均值，TextualRL将GPT-5.5和Qwen3.8-27B的测试准确率分别比基础模型提高了24.4和15.3个百分点。

articles.title: SWE-MISBEHAVIOR: Benchmarking and Mitigating Boundary Violations in Software Coding Agents
articles.abstract: We present SWE-MISBEHAVIOR, the first taxonomy and evaluation framework for diagnosing boundary-violating misbehaviors in coding agents. It contains 7.4K human-in-the-loop synthesized samples spanning three layers of agent action space: (i) Code Generation, (ii) File Management, and (iii) System Interaction. Across these categories, SWE-MISBEHAVIOR covers 11 distinct misbehaviors with a fully automated evaluation protocol, including coding-action violations, Create/Read/Update/Delete (CRUD) file misbehaviors, system integrity and abuse violations, and task-goal misalignment. Experiments on state-of-the-art open-source coding agents (e.g., OpenHands, smolagents) reveal substantial misaligned behaviors, including dependency misinterpretation (up to 98.5% of cases), unintended modification of user inputs (50.5%), and silent compromise of environment integrity (53%). Motivated by these findings, we further propose CODE-KIT, a lightweight adaptive framework that combines misbehavior-aware guidelines with novel tools to help agents avoid such failures. CODE-KIT reduces misbehaviors by 52% for smolagents and 34% for OpenHands, while simultaneously improving task completion performance.
articles.comment: Codes and data are available at https://github.com/dxlong2000/SWE-Misbehavior
articles.titleCn: SWE-MISBEHAVIOR：软件编码代理边界违规行为的基准测试与缓解
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了SWE-MISBEHAVIOR，这是首个用于诊断编码代理边界违规行为的分类和评估框架。该框架包含7.4K个由人工参与合成的样本，涵盖了代理行动空间的三层：（i）代码生成，（ii）文件管理，（iii）系统交互。在这些类别中，SWE-MISBEHAVIOR涵盖了11种不同的违规行为，并配备了全自动评估协议，包括编码行为违规、创建/读取/更新/删除（CRUD）文件违规、系统完整性与滥用违规以及任务目标不匹配。在当前最先进的开源编码代理（例如OpenHands、smolagents）上的实验揭示了大量的目标不匹配行为，包括依赖错误解释（高达98.5%的情况）、用户输入的意外修改（50.5%）以及环境完整性的无声妥协（53%）。基于这些发现，我们进一步提出了CODE-KIT，这是一个轻量级的自适应框架，结合了违规行为感知指南和新型工具，帮助代理避免此类失败。CODE-KIT将smolagents的违规行为减少了52%，OpenHands减少了34%，同时提升了任务完成性能。

articles.title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery
articles.abstract: Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is driven by a meta-controller that manages parallel research agents and enforces rubric verification at each stage. This design enables the same orchestration layer to be reused across heterogeneous domains with different execution environments, agentic coding harnesses, and evaluation metrics. Our system can be used across a spectrum of autonomy: either as a co-scientist tool or to perform end-to-end scientific investigation. Within the co-scientist setting, we leveraged a development version of our system to submit a single research paper, which got accepted for publication at ALIFE 2026. We further apply The Agentic Scientist fully autonomously to open problem-solving tasks in machine learning, and demonstrate the system's capability of scientific discovery across different domains of computational research. Our ablations suggest that reliable scientific autonomy depends not only on base model capabilities, but also on the cross-agent orchestration layer.
articles.titleCn: 代理科学家：编排编码代理以实现自动化科学（共同）发现
articles.abstractCn: 现代编程代理正在从根本上重塑人类输入在计算研究中的作用：它们编写代码、启动计算机模拟实验、分析结果，并能在不断延长的时域内自主运行。尽管取得了这些进展，完全自主的研究代理仍存在思维半径有限和短视的爬山搜索动态问题。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了“代理科学家”，这是一个为人类研究人员与现代编程代理协同开展计算研究而设计的端到端分布式流程。在继承前代系统的基础上，我们的系统将研究分解为任务草拟、想法生成、规划、沙盒化实验、结果聚合、基线和消融构建、事后分析以及报告撰写等步骤。重要的是，流程中的每一步都由下一代编程代理驱动，并利用代理式自我验证。整体研究过程由一个元控制器驱动，该控制器管理并行研究代理并在每个阶段执行标准验证。这种设计使得相同的编排层可以在不同领域（具有不同的执行环境、代理式编程 harness 和评估指标）中重复使用。我们的系统可在一系列自主性范围内使用：要么作为协同科学家工具，要么用于执行端到端的科学探究。在协同科学家环境下，我们利用系统开发版提交了一篇研究论文，该论文被 ALIFE 2026 接受发表。我们进一步将“代理科学家”完全自主地应用于机器学习中的开放问题解决任务，并展示了该系统在不同计算研究领域的科学发现能力。我们的消融实验表明，可靠的科学自主性不仅取决于基础模型能力，还取决于跨代理的编排层。

articles.title: TRACESTEER: Trace Driven Activation Steering for Hallucination Mitigation in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, yet remain susceptible to hallucination. Activation steering offers a promising mitigation approach by guiding parallel token predictions through internal representations. However, existing steering methods largely overlook two characteristics of dLLMs: dynamic denoising states and temporal hallucination risks, which challenge predefined steering vectors and uniform intervention strengths. We propose TRACESTEER, a trace-driven activation steering framework that uses preceding denoising predictions as feedback to jointly adapt steering direction and strength. Specifically, Denoising Feedback Steering (DF-Steering) constructs step-specific steering vectors from preceding predictions and current hidden states. Trajectory-Guided Steering Gate (TS-Gate) regulates their strength using prediction uncertainty and the denoising timestep. With the backbone frozen, factual supervision and magnitude regularization jointly guide the learning of adaptive steering interventions, promoting factual reliability and stability throughout denoising. Experiments on two dLLMs show improved factual reliability on TruthfulQA and generalization across five downstream benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: TRACESTEER：基于追踪驱动的激活引导，用于扩散语言模型中的幻觉缓解
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）已成为自回归大型语言模型（LLMs）的一种有前景的替代方案，但仍然容易产生幻觉。激活引导提供了一种有前景的缓解方法，通过内部表示引导并行标记预测。然而，现有的引导方法很大程度上忽略了dLLM的两个特征：动态去噪状态和时序幻觉风险，这些特征挑战了预定义的引导向量和均匀的干预强度。我们提出了TRACESTEER，这是一个基于轨迹的激活引导框架，它使用先前的去噪预测作为反馈来联合调整引导方向和强度。具体来说，去噪反馈引导（DF-Steering）从先前的预测和当前的隐藏状态中构建特定步骤的引导向量。轨迹引导门控（TS-Gate）使用预测不确定性和去噪时间步长来调节它们的强度。在主干网络冻结的情况下，事实性监督和幅度正则化共同引导自适应引导干预的学习，在整个去噪过程中促进事实可靠性和稳定性。在两个dLLM上的实验表明，在TruthfulQA上提高了事实可靠性，并在五个下游基准测试中实现了泛化。

articles.title: LoOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Looped Teachers
articles.abstract: On-policy self-distillation improves a model using guidance from the model itself, but it still requires a teacher that provides more useful predictions than the student. Existing approaches obtain such guidance by giving the teacher additional context or instructions. We ask whether it can instead come from changing how the same model uses its own layers. To address this, we introduce LoOPSD, which searches over a model's layer execution order to construct a stronger teacher and distills its advantage into the student. Specifically, we keep the model weights unchanged while searching for layers to repeat, and use the resulting teacher's predictions on student-generated prefixes to guide learning. We then alternate search and distillation, rebuilding the teacher from the updated student in each round so that the student progressively absorbs the gains from alternative layer execution. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show improvements across models. On GSM8K with a 400-token thinking budget, LoOPSD raises Qwen3-1.7B accuracy from 42.30% to 79.61%; subsequent distillation rounds yield further gains beyond the first round. Together, these findings show that by searching layer execution to construct teachers, we can turn a model's additional computation into improved student capabilities, opening a new avenue for self-distillation to derive supervision from the model's own computation.
articles.titleCn: LoOPSD：基于策略的自蒸馏方法，具有循环教师
articles.abstractCn: 基于策略的自蒸馏技术通过模型自身的指导来提升模型性能，但仍然需要一位教师提供比学生更有用的预测。现有方法通过向教师提供额外的上下文或指令来获取这种指导。我们提出一个问题：这种指导是否可以来自改变模型如何使用其自身层的方式？为了解决这个问题，我们引入了LoOPSD，它搜索模型的层执行顺序，以构建一个更强的教师，并将其优势蒸馏到学生中。具体来说，我们在搜索要重复的层时保持模型权重不变，并使用由此产生的教师对学生生成的前缀的预测来指导学习。然后我们交替进行搜索和蒸馏，在每一轮中从更新的学生中重建教师，以便学生逐步吸收交替层执行带来的收益。在数学和逻辑推理任务上的实验表明，所有模型都得到了改进。在GSM8K上，使用400个token的思考预算，LoOPSD将Qwen3-1.7B的准确率从42.30%提高到79.61%；后续的蒸馏轮次在第一轮之后进一步带来了提升。这些发现表明，通过搜索层执行来构建教师，我们可以将模型的额外计算转化为改进的学生能力，为自蒸馏开辟了一条从模型自身计算中获取监督的新途径。

articles.title: Claim Framing as a Driver of LLM Sycophancy
articles.abstract: Sycophancy in Large Language Models, the tendency to align responses with user preferences over ground truth, has largely been studied using questions without a clear ground truth and with a single, plainly stated user opinion. We present a systematic study of which framings of a user's claim trigger sycophancy in factual question answering, where every answer is objectively verifiable without extra context. Evaluating 14 models on 42K questions, we express correct and incorrect user opinions through various claim framings over 8 dimensions and 21 types, and measure a broad set of opinion-driven behaviors. We find that all models are susceptible to user opinions regardless of size. Models are most influenced by how confidently an opinion is stated, whom it is attributed to, and whether it is presented as shared between the user and the model. In contrast to prior work, framings based on the user's expertise, authority over the model, or social pressure matter little in our factual setting. Larger models resist incorrect opinions better but are no better at recovering from their own errors. Our results call for sycophancy evaluations that probe how an opinion is framed, not merely whether one is present, and that measure multiple behaviors beyond a single flip rate.
articles.titleCn: 以说服性声明为驱动的LLM奉承行为
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型中的奉承倾向，即倾向于使回答与用户偏好而非事实真相保持一致，主要通过对缺乏明确事实真相且仅包含单一明确用户观点的问题进行研究。我们针对在客观可验证且无需额外上下文的事实性问题回答中，哪些用户主张的表述方式会触发奉承倾向，进行了系统性研究。通过对14个模型在42K个问题上的评估，我们通过8个维度和21种类型的不同主张表述方式，表达了正确和错误用户观点，并测量了广泛的观点驱动行为。我们发现，所有模型无论大小，均易受用户观点影响。模型最容易受到观点陈述的自信程度、观点归属对象以及是否呈现为用户与模型共同持有的影响。与以往研究不同，基于用户专业知识、对模型的权威或社会压力的主张表述方式在我们的事实性设置中影响甚微。较大的模型更能抵抗错误观点，但在纠正自身错误方面并无优势。我们的结果呼吁奉承倾向评估应探究观点是如何被表述的，而不仅仅是判断观点是否存在，并应测量单一翻转率之外的多重行为。

articles.title: Fan Out or Relay? Ownership-Aware Routing for LLM Agents Querying Siloed Tables
articles.abstract: Inside organizations, a question's data often sit with several owners, who query their own tables but never hand them over. An LLM coordinator can fan out, sending the question to every owner at once, or relay, querying owners in turn and reusing earlier rows. We show that neither is safe in advance, because data ownership decides which one is right. Across thirteen settings on PeopleJoin and BIRD with three model families, fan-out is more accurate in twelve on questions one owner can answer, yet answers at most 4.3% of those joining two owners' tables. The flip follows ownership, not query shape: on BIRD two-table joins, fan-out answers 32-44% when one owner holds both and 1-4% otherwise. Relay wins by conditioning on returned rows, and hiding them from an otherwise identical planner cuts two-owner accuracy from 23.2% to 5.1%. Since ownership is public, we propose Ownership-Aware Routing (OAR), which drafts a schema-only SQL query, counts the owners whose tables it joins, and routes the question before any private row is read. In ten settings OAR is never significantly less accurate than the best fixed protocol, and beats every fixed protocol on PeopleJoin, by up to 9.3 points on held-out organizations.
articles.titleCn: 扇出还是中继？面向所有权感知的路由，用于查询隔离表的LLM代理
articles.abstractCn: 在组织内部，一个问题通常涉及多个数据所有者，他们各自查询自己的表格但从不共享数据。大型语言模型协调器可以并行发送问题给所有所有者，或者依次查询所有者并复用先前的结果。我们证明这两种方法在事先都无法保证安全性，因为数据所有权决定了哪种方法更合适。在PeopleJoin和BIRD的十三种设置中，针对单个所有者能回答的问题，并行查询在十二种情况下更准确，但仅回答了最多4.3%涉及两个所有者表格的问题。结果与所有权相关，而非查询形状：在BIRD的两表连接中，当单个所有者持有两表时，并行查询回答率为32-44%，否则仅为1-4%。依次查询通过条件返回行获胜，而将返回行隐藏于相同规划器中，将两所有者准确性从23.2%降至5.1%。由于所有权是公开的，我们提出所有权感知路由（OAR），它先生成仅包含模式的SQL查询，统计其连接的所有者数量，并在任何私有行被读取前路由问题。在十种设置中，OAR从未显著低于最佳固定协议，并在PeopleJoin上击败了所有固定协议，在保留的所有者中最高提升9.3个百分点。

articles.title: Attacking Only Half the Data: Two-Sided Evaluation of AI-Text Detector Robustness
articles.abstract: We investigate the robustness of widely used AI text detectors under attacks applied to both human and machine text. Prior evaluations typically attack only machine text, overlooking that human text is routinely modified through grammar correction, formatting, or invisible character insertion. We introduce a two-sided protocol that applies attacks to both classes. Across two corpora and nine detectors, reported AUROC gains vanish under two-sided evaluation, with attacked human text misclassified at rates up to 100%. While simple preprocessing reverses character-level attacks, word-level synonym substitution remains effective meaning-preserving, and irreversible.
articles.titleCn: 仅攻击一半数据：AI文本检测器鲁棒性的双边评估
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了在针对人类文本和机器文本的攻击下，常用AI文本检测器的鲁棒性。之前的评估通常只攻击机器文本，忽略了人类文本会通过语法校正、格式化或插入不可见字符等方式进行常规修改。我们引入了一种双向协议，对两类文本都进行攻击。在两个语料库和九种检测器上，双向评估下报告的AUROC提升消失，受攻击的人类文本被错误分类率高达100%。虽然简单的预处理可以逆转字符级攻击，但词级同义词替换仍然有效且保持语义不变，且是不可逆的。

articles.title: SparPR: Runtime KV-Cache Recovery for Resource-Constrained LLM Inference on Consumer Hardware
articles.abstract: Running large language models (LLMs) on consumer hardware is bottlenecked by the key-value (KV) cache, which grows with every decoded token and quickly exhausts the memory and bandwidth of a single consumer GPU. We present SparPR (Sparse Partial Recomputation), a runtime KV-cache recovery mechanism that does not modify model weights and requires no offline training. SparPR couples three online decisions: Query-Aware key-block selection scores historical blocks against the current query; dynamic budget control estimates per-block copy and recompute costs to decide how many blocks to retain; and on-demand local recomputation with cost-aware fallback merges retained blocks into continuous spans and switches between sparse recomputation and full recovery according to a runtime cost comparison. Implemented on FlexGen/FlexLLMGen, SparPR is evaluated on a single consumer laptop (RTX 3070 Ti 8GB, Ryzen 9 6900HX, 16GB RAM). It cuts end-to-end latency by 31%, 52%, and 63% at 1k, 2k, and 4k prompt tokens respectively, with 1.4x-2.7x higher throughput, and completes an 8k-token workload in 44 minutes where the FlexGen baseline times out. Under a fixed cache budget, SparPR retains a Needle Accuracy that stays well above StreamingLLM and H2O at every keep ratio, and ablation studies confirm that the three mechanisms act jointly.
articles.titleCn: SparPR：在消费级硬件上对资源受限的大型语言模型推理进行运行时键值缓存恢复
articles.abstractCn: 在消费级硬件上运行大型语言模型（LLM）时，键值（KV）缓存成为瓶颈，随着每个解码token的增长而不断扩大，迅速耗尽单个消费级GPU的内存和带宽。我们提出了SparPR（稀疏部分重计算），这是一种运行时KV缓存恢复机制，无需修改模型权重，也无需离线训练。SparPR结合了三个在线决策：查询感知的键块选择，将历史块与当前查询进行对比；动态预算控制，估计每块复制和重计算成本，以决定保留多少块；按需本地重计算，根据成本感知回退合并保留块为连续跨度，并根据运行时成本比较在稀疏重计算和完全恢复之间切换。在FlexGen/FlexLLMGen上实现的SparPR，在一台消费级笔记本电脑（RTX 3070 Ti 8GB，Ryzen 9 6900HX，16GB RAM）上进行了评估。它在1k、2k和4k提示token下分别将端到端延迟降低了31%、52%和63%，吞吐量提高了1.4倍至2.7倍，并在44分钟内完成了8k-token工作负载，而FlexGen基线则超时。在固定的缓存预算下，SparPR的Needle Accuracy在每种保留比例下都保持在StreamingLLM和H2O之上，消融研究证实这三个机制共同发挥作用。

articles.title: Monitoring latent reasoning in looped language models
articles.abstract: Looped language models (LMs) reuse one block of layers several times per token generation, promising more latent computation at no additional storage cost. Despite their rising popularity, the analysis of looped LMs is still in its infancy: little is known about whether the iterative transformations actually improve their capabilities, or whether these models remain stable under prompt perturbation. We construct an inspection protocol rooted in Mechanistic Interpretability comprising five diverse lenses. We apply it to examine eight looped LMs from four families. Models differ in many aspects but the key one is whether the prompt is transmitted only within the looped state (carry loops: Ouro, LoopUS) or re-supplied at every iteration (re-read loops: Parcae, and Rec-OLMo & Huginn from the Raven family). The results of our study provide valuable insights concerning safety and efficient use of looped language models.
articles.titleCn: 监控循环语言模型中的潜在推理
articles.abstractCn: 循环语言模型（LMs）通过多次重复使用一个层块来生成每个标记，承诺在无需额外存储成本的情况下实现更多的潜在计算。尽管它们越来越受欢迎，但循环语言模型的分析仍处于起步阶段：人们对迭代转换是否确实提升了模型的能力，或者这些模型在提示扰动下是否保持稳定，知之甚少。我们构建了一个基于机制可解释性的检查协议，包含五个不同的视角。我们将其应用于分析四个家族中的八个循环语言模型。这些模型在许多方面存在差异，但关键的区别在于提示是在循环状态内部传递（传递循环：Ouro、LoopUS），还是在每次迭代时重新提供（重新读取循环：Parcae，以及Raven家族中的Rec-OLMo和Huginn）。我们的研究结果为循环语言模型的安全和高效使用提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title: Cheap, Consistent, Calibrated, but Biased? Typed Decision Models as Judges
articles.abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability for each allowed answer instead of generating text, which makes them candidates for cheaply replacing LLM judges that compare two answers. Whether they share the biases of LLM judges is untested. We run the CALM benchmark's bias tests on eight TDMs and seven LLM judges of 2024 and 2026. Every TDM is biased, in three to eight of twelve tests. Emotional tone affects them most, and rewriting the better answer in such a tone lowers the accuracy of a typical TDM from 99% to 42%. TDMs are more biased than 2026 LLM judges. All eight change verdicts when the answers swap places, which the 2026 LLM judges hardly do, and several side with an answer that most people allegedly prefer or that a famous model allegedly wrote. Yet both kinds of judge are tripped up by the same prompts. The TDMs' probabilities show that most tests mainly flip verdicts the TDM was unsure of, and that good calibration does not protect against bias. As TDMs are more consistent and 37 times cheaper than 2026 LLM judges, our results suggest they can be attractive judges if their biases are tested for the task.
articles.titleCn: 廉价、一致、校准，但存在偏见？类型化决策模型作为评判者
articles.abstractCn: 类型化决策模型（TDMs）为每个允许的答案返回概率，而不是生成文本，这使得它们成为廉价替代比较两个答案的LLM裁判的候选者。它们是否与LLM裁判共享偏见尚未得到验证。我们在2024年和2026年的八个TDM和七个LLM裁判上运行了CALM基准的偏见测试。每个TDM在十二项测试中的三到八项测试中存在偏见。情绪语气对它们影响最大，将更好的答案用这种语气重写会将典型TDM的准确率从99%降至42%。TDM比2026年的LLM裁判更具偏见。所有八个TDM在答案位置交换时都会改变裁决，而2026年的LLM裁判几乎不会这样做，并且有几个裁判倾向于大多数人声称更喜欢的答案或著名模型声称写出的答案。然而，这两种类型的裁判都会被相同的提示所困扰。TDM的概率显示，大多数测试主要翻转了TDM不确定的裁决，并且良好的校准并不能防止偏见。由于TDM比2026年的LLM裁判更一致且便宜37倍，我们的结果表明，如果测试了它们的任务偏见，它们可以成为有吸引力的裁判。

articles.title: Narrative Lookahead in LLMs: Event-Level Decodability, Predictive Advantage, and Steering
articles.abstract: Do language models carry information about narrative events before writing them, and how far ahead? We examine narrative lookahead through salient, state-changing events rather than tokens or response-level attributes. We extract 23,355 LLM-annotated events from 2,000 stories generated by four open-weight LLMs, labeling them along three nonexclusive dimensions of change: within agents, between agents, and in the story world, with human validation on a subset.
