Event segmentation and plot-independent labels enable comparisons across stories at horizons measured in events rather than in tokens. At event ends, we probe hidden states for upcoming event types and compare predictions with text-only predictors using matched prefixes. Across four models, future event types are decodable above prevalence baselines for at least four subsequent events, but probes significantly outperform both primary text-only predictors only for the next event. In exploratory steering with OLMo-3.1-32B, a probe-derived direction shifts the proportion of the target event type in both intended directions at higher strengths. Our event-level approach links the prediction of future narrative developments to interventions that reshape subsequent event composition.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型的叙事前瞻：事件级解码能力、预测优势与引导
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型在书写叙事事件之前是否携带有关这些事件的信息，以及这种携带有多远？我们通过显著的状态改变事件而非标记或响应级属性来研究叙事的预览。我们从四个开放权重语言模型生成的2000个故事中提取了23,355个LLM标注的事件，并沿三个非排他性的变化维度进行标记：主体内部、主体之间以及故事世界，并在子集上进行了人工验证。事件分割和与情节无关的标签使得跨故事在以事件为单位而非标记为单位的时间尺度上进行比较成为可能。在事件结束时，我们探测隐藏状态以预测即将到来的事件类型，并使用匹配的前缀将预测与纯文本预测器进行比较。在四个模型中，未来事件类型至少在接下来的四个事件中可解码，但探测仅在下一个事件上显著优于纯文本预测器。在OLMo-3.1-32B的探索性引导中，探测衍生方向在高强度下将目标事件类型的比例在两个预期方向上均发生偏移。我们的事件级方法将未来叙事发展的预测与重塑后续事件组成的干预措施联系起来。

articles.title: Chain of Thought Monitoring Can Fail Even When CoT Is Necessary
articles.abstract: Chain of Thought (CoT) monitoring is used by frontier labs to detect misbehaviour of AI systems. Yet, its reliability remains poorly understood. We attribute this to the lack of a successful organizing principle that leads to generalizable conclusions about monitoring reliability in different regimes. Recent work attributes monitoring failures to the CoT not being necessary for the answer, and argues that CoT becomes monitorable when it is necessary. We show that this binary necessary/not-necessary organizing principle is too coarse by demonstrating that monitoring failures persist even if the CoT is necessary for the answer. In response, we introduce a more fine-grained organizing principle based on a hierarchy of four CoT necessity levels. Building on this hierarchy, we develop a framework for measuring CoT monitorability at the three lowest levels via intervention experiments. We demonstrate monitoring failures at all three of these levels on realistic, hard prediction tasks. On a difficult medical-diagnosis task, patient sex and a clinical attribute influence the answer in at least 19% and 24% of correct responses with a necessary CoT, respectively, yet their influence is almost never articulated. These results show that even when CoT is necessary, it is not guaranteed to be monitorable.
articles.titleCn: 即使需要思维链（CoT），思维链监控也可能失败
articles.abstractCn: 思维链（CoT）监控被前沿实验室用于检测人工智能系统的异常行为。然而，其可靠性仍缺乏明确理解。我们将其归因于缺乏一个能够得出不同情境下监控可靠性普适性结论的成功组织原则。近期研究将监控失败归因于思维链并非回答所必需，并认为当思维链成为必需时，它才变得可监控。我们通过证明即使思维链对于回答是必需的，监控失败依然存在，表明这种必要/非必要二元组织原则过于粗略。为此，我们引入一个基于四层思维链必要性等级的更精细组织原则。基于该层级结构，我们开发了一个通过干预实验测量思维链在最低三个层级可监控性的框架。我们在真实的、具有挑战性的预测任务上验证了这三个层级均存在监控失败。在一个困难的医学诊断任务中，患者性别和临床特征在至少19%和24%的正确回答中通过必要的思维链影响答案，但它们的影响几乎从未被明确表达。这些结果表明，即使思维链是必需的，也并非总能保证其可监控性。

articles.title: From Agents to Edges: Paired Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
articles.abstract: Strong individual agents do not guarantee effective collaboration. Communication must align what one agent conveys with how another interprets and uses it. This dependency makes the communication edge a natural unit of optimization. We introduce Paired Automated Communication Optimization (PACO), which jointly optimizes the instructions at both ends of each edge and their shared communication convention in systems built on black-box language models. PACO keeps model weights, agent roles, and workflow topology fixed. A state-aware discounted bandit selects edges for refinement, while execution feedback guides paired revisions evaluated through staged end-to-end execution. The optimized instructions integrate into existing agent prompts without additional model calls at deployment. On a four-agent workflow evaluated across diverse multi-agent benchmarks, PACO consistently outperforms leading prompt-optimization and communication baselines. Configurations learned on HotpotQA retain their advantage in cross-dataset transfer without target-specific optimization. These results demonstrate that optimizing how agents communicate can substantially improve collaboration within an otherwise fixed system.
articles.titleCn: 从智能体到边缘：多智能体协作的配对优化
articles.abstractCn: 强大的个体智能体并不能保证有效的协作。沟通必须使一个智能体传达的内容与另一个智能体的解释和使用方式相一致。这种依赖性使得通信边缘成为自然的优化单元。我们引入了配对自动化沟通优化（Paired Automated Communication Optimization，简称PACO），它联合优化了基于黑盒语言模型构建的系统中每条边缘两端的指令及其共享的沟通惯例。PACO保持模型权重、智能体角色和工作流拓扑不变。一个状态感知的折扣 bandit 选择边缘进行优化，执行反馈则指导通过分阶段端到端执行评估的配对修订。优化后的指令在部署时无需额外的模型调用即可集成到现有的智能体提示中。在跨多个多智能体基准评估的四智能体工作流中，PACO始终优于领先的提示优化和沟通基线。在HotpotQA上学习的配置在跨数据集迁移中保持其优势，无需针对特定目标的优化。这些结果表明，优化智能体的沟通方式可以显著提高固定系统内部的协作能力。

articles.title: A Benchmark for Bangla Task-Oriented Dialogue Understanding
articles.abstract: Task-oriented dialogue understanding remains underexplored for Bangla, particularly in multilingual settings involving English and romanized Bangla (Banglish). We introduce BanglaTOD, a parallel tri-lingual benchmark comprising 209 multi-turn dialogues across nine Bangladesh-specific service domains and 64 intents. Each conversational turn is aligned across Bangla, English, and Banglish, yielding 4,689 language-specific turn records annotated with intents, token-level slots, state updates, and accumulated dialogue states. We establish context-aware baselines for joint intent classification and slot filling using mBERT, BERT-base-uncased, and BanglaBERT. Cross-language analysis reveals substantial performance differences across models and linguistic representations, while removing dialogue history reduces intent accuracy by 19.0--25.7 percentage points. BanglaTOD provides a foundation for multilingual dialogue understanding and future dialogue state tracking research in Bangladesh-specific conversational applications. The dataset is publicly available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/afri7here/BanglaTOD}{Hugging Face}.
articles.titleCn: 面向孟加拉语的任务导向对话理解基准
articles.abstractCn: 面向任务的对话理解在孟加拉语中仍处于探索阶段，尤其是在涉及英语和罗马化孟加拉语（Banglish）的多语言环境中。我们介绍了BanglaTOD，这是一个包含209个多轮对话的平行三语言基准，涵盖九个孟加拉国特定服务领域和64个意图。每轮对话都在孟加拉语、英语和Banglish之间进行对齐，产生了4,689条语言特定的轮次记录，这些记录标注了意图、词元级槽位、状态更新和累积对话状态。我们使用mBERT、BERT-base-uncased和BanglaBERT建立了上下文感知的基线，用于联合意图分类和槽位填充。跨语言分析揭示了不同模型和语言表示之间显著的性能差异，而移除对话历史则使意图准确率降低了19.0--25.7个百分点。BanglaTOD为多语言对话理解和孟加拉国特定对话应用中的未来对话状态跟踪研究提供了基础。该数据集可在 \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/afri7here/BanglaTOD}{Hugging Face} 上公开获取。

articles.title: inLoRA-MINT: Internal Representations for Auditing Training Data in Domain-adapted LLMs
articles.abstract: This work investigates the application of the Membership Inference Test (MINT) to large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA, aiming to determine whether specific samples were used during training and address concerns about data privacy, leakage, and transparency. Building on our previous LoRA-MINT framework, which relies exclusively on perplexity under a strict black-box setting, we propose an approach based on intermediate model representations, including activations and parameter-dependent signals. These representations enable a MINT classifier to distinguish training from non-training samples without requiring full access to model parameters. We evaluated the method on four LLMs (Qwen, Phi-4, DeepSeek-V3, and LLaMA 3.2-3B) fine-tuned on three datasets covering medical, mathematical, and academic reasoning tasks. Results show consistent performance across architectures and domains, achieving scores between 95% and 98%, with robustness to variations in model configurations and data distributions. The proposed approach enables efficient auditing of sensitive training data and supports data provenance and compliance with emerging privacy and AI governance regulations. Although our experiments focus on LoRA-based fine-tuning, the methodology can be extended to other LLM adaptation techniques and, more broadly, to other AI models.
articles.titleCn: inLoRA-MINT：用于审计领域适应型大语言模型训练数据的内部表示
articles.abstractCn: 本研究探讨了将成员推理测试（MINT）应用于使用LoRA微调的大型语言模型（LLMs），旨在确定在训练过程中是否使用了特定样本，并解决数据隐私、泄露和透明度方面的担忧。基于我们先前仅依赖严格黑盒设置下困惑度的LoRA-MINT框架，我们提出了一种基于中间模型表示的方法，包括激活和参数相关信号。这些表示使MINT分类器能够在无需完全访问模型参数的情况下区分训练样本和非训练样本。我们在四个使用LoRA微调的LLMs（Qwen、Phi-4、DeepSeek-V3和LLaMA 3.2-3B）上进行了评估，这些模型在涵盖医学、数学和学术推理任务的三个数据集上进行微调。结果表明，不同架构和领域间性能一致，得分在95%至98%之间，对模型配置和数据分布的变化具有鲁棒性。该方法能够高效审计敏感训练数据，并支持数据溯源和符合新兴隐私与人工智能治理法规。尽管我们的实验聚焦于基于LoRA的微调，但该方法可扩展到其他LLM适应技术和更广泛的其他人工智能模型。

articles.title: Machine--human agreement in marking undergraduate assignments is specific to model, prompt and institution
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) promise to automate one of higher education's most resource-intensive activities: assessing student writing. Existing evaluations are typically limited to a single model, a single prompt and a single institution. Using 761 undergraduate psychology assignments from three UK universities, we evaluated three frontier LLMs, individually and in ensemble, on accuracy, prompt sensitivity, error independence, generalisability and evidential basis. Agreement between human and machine marks varied widely, with no model or prompt optimal across institutions. All models compressed marks towards a common central tendency, overvaluing the weakest assignments and undervaluing the strongest. Because this error was shared, ensembling failed to remove it. Machine marks also rewarded linguistic features more strongly than human marks. Since human-machine agreement was a joint product of model, prompt and institution, we conclude that current LLMs lack evaluative capacity transferable across contexts, and that single-context validation overstates readiness for deployment.
articles.titleCn: 机器与人类在标记本科作业上的意见一致性与模型、提示和机构有关。
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）承诺自动化高等教育中最耗资源的活动之一：评估学生写作。现有的评估通常仅限于单个模型、单个提示和单个机构。我们使用来自英国三所大学的761份本科心理学作业，分别和组合地评估了三种前沿LLMs在准确性、提示敏感性、错误独立性、泛化能力和证据基础方面的表现。人类评分与机器评分之间的差异很大，没有任何模型或提示能在所有机构中表现最佳。所有模型都使评分向一个共同的中值压缩，高估了最弱的作业而低估了最强的作业。由于这种错误是共有的，组合模型未能消除它。机器评分比人类评分更强烈地奖励语言特征。由于人机协议是模型、提示和机构的共同产物，我们得出结论，当前的LLMs缺乏可在不同情境下转移的评估能力，而单一情境的验证高估了其部署的成熟度。

articles.title: LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. Specifically, we use an MLP to map the last hidden state of the target prefix into a small number of latent tokens, which are placed after the reused KV block to interact with the shared context. To guide subsequent predictions toward the target task, we train the MLP through full-prefill distillation. Experiments show that LatentRemedy consistently outperforms existing reuse baselines on conflicting tasks while maintaining TTFT close to direct reuse as cache size grows. Code and data are available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse.
articles.titleCn: 潜在修复方案：多智能体系统中非前缀KV缓存重用的高效修复
articles.abstractCn: 非前缀 KV 缓存重用在多智能体系统中是一种提升推理效率的潜力方法，因为智能体共享相同的上下文块。然而，当智能体具有冲突任务时，直接跨智能体重用非前缀 KV 缓存会严重降低模型性能，导致性能下降高达90%。现有的补救措施，包括选择性重计算和基于偏移的校准，仅能恢复这部分损失的一小部分。我们认为问题不仅在于被污染的 KV 表示，还在于智能体难以根据自身指令解释重用的上下文。为此，我们引入了 LatentRemedy，它使用少量任务条件化的潜在标记来帮助目标智能体利用重用的上下文，而无需重新计算共享块。具体来说，我们使用 MLP 将目标前缀的最后一个隐藏状态映射为少量潜在标记，这些标记被放置在重用的 KV 块之后，以与共享上下文交互。为了引导后续预测朝向目标任务，我们通过全预填充蒸馏训练 MLP。实验表明，LatentRemedy 在冲突任务上始终优于现有的重用基线，同时随着缓存大小的增长，TTFT 接近直接重用。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse 获取。

articles.title: Fish Audio Drama 3 Technical Report
articles.abstract: We introduce Fish Audio Drama 3, an open-source speech generation model that turns text into directed performances, built on a 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts backbone that activates 3B parameters per token. It clones voices from multiple references, follows natural-language direction, revises a take when the next turn gives a note, voices multi-character scenes, edits existing speech by infilling, and synthesizes long-form and streaming audio. Multi-turn revision, scene dubbing, editing by infilling, and streaming text input are new in Drama 3, all in one model. Drama 3 pairs the hybrid linear-attention backbone with a new codebook multi-token-prediction audio decoder that predicts the acoustic codebooks of each frame in dedicated layers that attend over the entire sequence. The model is trained with a three-stage pre-training recipe, instruction fine-tuning, and large-batch reinforcement learning whose only reward is a single learned model of human preference. Its inference engine decodes a single stream at 271 frames per second on one H200, against 177 for Fish Audio S2, although Drama 3 has more than seven times as many parameters. The model weights are available on GitHub (https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/drama-3), and inference is available through SGLang-Omni (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni). We highly encourage readers to visit https://fish.audio to direct their own performances.
articles.titleCn: 鱼类音频剧第三部分技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Fish Audio Drama 3，这是一个开源的语音生成模型，能够将文本转化为定向表演，其基于一个35B参数的专家混合骨干网络，每个token激活3B参数。该模型能够克隆多个参考声音，遵循自然语言指令，在下一个回合给出提示时修改录制内容，为多角色场景配音，通过填充编辑现有语音，并合成长音频和流式音频。在Drama 3中，多回合修改、场景配音、填充编辑和流式文本输入均为新增功能，全部集成在一个模型中。Drama 3将混合线性注意力骨干与一种新的码本多token预测音频解码器相结合，该解码器在专用层中预测每一帧的声学码本，这些层会关注整个序列。该模型通过三阶段预训练配方、指令微调和大批量强化学习进行训练，其唯一奖励是学习到的一个人类偏好的模型。其推理引擎在单个H200上以每秒271帧的速度解码单流，而Fish Audio S2为每秒177帧，尽管Drama 3的参数数量超过七倍。模型权重可在GitHub（https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech）和Hugging Face（https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/drama-3）上获取，推理功能可通过SGLang-Omni（https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni）使用。我们强烈鼓励读者访问https://fish.audio来指导自己的表演。

articles.title: Match the Canvas, Not Just the Answer: Predictability-Aware SFT for Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible parallel generation by resolving tokens according to the model's evolving predictability rather than a fixed left-to-right order. This flexibility, however, introduces training choices absent from standard autoregressive teacher forcing: which reference tokens are visible when a target is supervised and how much generation space is allocated. Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) typically makes these choices through random masking, independently of inference. Our analysis shows how this training-inference mismatch can misdirect supervision. Random masking can conceal prediction errors or penalize uncertainty that decoding would otherwise resolve, while the attention-visible input length can change which response formulations the model favors, even when the underlying solution is unchanged. Motivated by these findings, we propose Predictability-Aware Canvas Selection and Supervision (PACS), an SFT method. PACS uses the model's own predictability to select each example's attention-visible input length and supervises reference tokens immediately before their confidence-guided revelation. Across reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, PACS consistently achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared SFT methods, with gains of up to 12.84 percentage points over vanilla SFT on individual benchmarks. Code will be released upon publication.
articles.titleCn: 匹配画布，而不仅仅是答案：针对扩散语言模型的预测感知SFT
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）通过根据模型预测能力的动态变化来解析标记，而非固定的从左到右顺序，从而实现灵活的并行生成。然而，这种灵活性在标准自回归教师强制训练中并不存在，带来了新的训练选择：在目标受监督时哪些参考标记可见，以及分配多少生成空间。标准监督微调（SFT）通常通过随机掩码来做出这些选择，而与推理过程独立。我们的分析表明这种训练与推理的脱节可能误导监督。随机掩码可能掩盖预测错误或惩罚解码过程本应解决的模糊性，而注意力可见输入长度的变化会改变模型偏好的响应形式，即使底层解决方案保持不变。基于这些发现，我们提出了预测能力感知画布选择与监督（PACS），这是一种SFT方法。PACS利用模型自身的预测能力来选择每个示例的注意力可见输入长度，并在参考标记的置信度引导揭示前立即进行监督。在推理和代码生成基准测试中，PACS在比较的SFT方法中始终获得最高的平均准确率，在单个基准测试上相较于基础SFT提升了高达12.84个百分点。代码将在发表时公开。

articles.title: Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescription. Without a disclosure that documents are synthetic, the models abandon 80.1% of 6,488 correct answers. Notably, under one script each, the same prescription raises the flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 45.9% to 89.6% and lowers that of Qwen3-VL-8B from 77.7% to 50.9%. A model rejected the prescription while still preserving the correct answer in 915 of 3,232 conversations with the prescription (28.3%), and 40% of these flipped in later turns. System-prompt sentences that disclose the documents as synthetic lower one model's flip rate from 77.8% to 47.3%. Thus, we conclude that awareness about a forgery does not prevent a model from adopting its answer.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Sadif Ahmed and Soumya Swagata Biswas contributed equally. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VLM_Sycophancy-D0BE/
articles.titleCn: 识破伪造证据中的逆向谄媚：医疗视觉语言模型中的虚构证据
articles.abstractCn: 一个医疗视觉语言模型可以分析给定的CT扫描并正确检测出视野中的两个肾脏。继续这个对话，如果用户提供了一个方向相反的处方，医疗VLM通常谄媚地选择重新调整其诊断。在这项工作中，我们研究了在伪造证据下的退行性谄媚，即当模型在收到伪造文件的反驳时放弃正确答案。我们在19,200个多轮对话中测试了四个开源VLM，涉及400个VQA-RAD是/否问题，有和没有伪造处方。在没有披露文件是合成的声明下，模型放弃了6,488个正确答案中的80.1%。值得注意的是，在单个脚本下，同一个处方将Qwen2.5-VL-7B的翻转率从45.9%提高到89.6%，并将Qwen3-VL-8B的翻转率从77.7%降低到50.9%。在3,232个包含处方的对话中，模型在915次对话中拒绝了处方但仍然保留了正确答案（28.3%），其中40%在后续轮次中发生了翻转。披露文件为合成的系统提示句将一个模型的翻转率从77.8%降低到47.3%。因此，我们得出结论，对伪造的认识并不能阻止模型采纳其答案。

articles.title: Virtual Head Attention
articles.abstract: The design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality. GQA achieves strong quality but incurs high KV cache overhead; alternative approaches such as MLA and MFA can compress the cache, but MLA suffers from quality loss while MFA substantially increases training and prefill compute. We propose Virtual Head Attention (VHA), which simultaneously improves all three vertices through two lightweight linear operations: Q Premix applies a near-identity transformation to queries within each KV group to recover virtual head diversity from halved physical query heads, and Linear Postmix fuses inter-head features via a low-rank $I + AB^\top$ residual structure. Since VHA introduces no nonlinear operations, Premix can be folded into the query projection and Postmix into the output projection at inference time, reducing the model to a standard GQA-2 architecture that directly reuses all existing GQA inference optimizations. With only two KV heads, the group size in large models readily reaches 64, fully exploiting Tensor Core parallelism during decoding. Across four scales with 4K-context 50B-token pretraining, VHA consistently surpasses the standard GQA baseline at every scale ($+$0.05\% to $+$0.81\%), while reducing KV cache by $4\times$ vs.\ GQA-8 at dense scales and $2\times$ vs.\ GQA-4 at the MoE scale, and lowering training and prefill FLOPs by 7.9\% (1.7B, $S{=}4096$). On an industrial 30B-A3B MoE model trained on 500B tokens at 8K context, VHA outperforms both MLA and GQA-4 by $+$0.70\,/\,$+$2.60\,\% on a 12-benchmark base-model evaluation suite; in a separate matched 10B-A1B MoE comparison after long-context mid-training, VHA attains an average RULER score of 84.4 over 8K--128K versus 73.0 for GQA, while using two rather than four KV heads in the full-attention layers.
articles.comment: Published as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
articles.titleCn: 虚拟头注意力
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文大语言模型中注意力机制的设计面临着键值缓存大小、训练与预填充FLOPs以及模型质量之间的“不可能三角”。GQA在质量上表现优异但带来了较高的键值缓存开销；而MLA和MFA等替代方法可以压缩缓存，但MLA会牺牲质量，MFA则显著增加了训练和预填充的计算量。我们提出了虚拟头注意力（VHA），通过两种轻量级线性操作同时提升这三个维度：Q Premix对每个键值组内的查询应用近似恒等变换，以从减半的物理查询头中恢复虚拟头的多样性；线性Postmix通过低秩$I + AB^\top$残差结构融合头间特征。由于VHA不引入非线性操作，Premix可以在推理时折叠到查询投影中，Postmix可以折叠到输出投影中，将模型简化为标准GQA-2架构，从而直接复用所有现有的GQA推理优化。仅使用两个键值头，大型模型中的组大小即可轻松达到64，在解码过程中充分利用张量核并行性。在四个不同规模（4K上下文50B词预训练）的实验中，VHA在所有规模上都持续超越标准GQA基线（提升0.05%至0.81%），在密集规模下将键值缓存减少4倍（对比GQA-8），在MoE规模下减少2倍（对比GQA-4），并将训练和预填充FLOPs降低7.9%（1.7B，$S{=}4096$）。在一个工业级30B-A3B MoE模型（在8K上下文中使用500B词训练）上，VHA在12基准模型评估套件中分别比MLA和GQA-4提升0.70%/2.60%；在长上下文训练中进行的匹配10B-A1B MoE比较中，VHA在8K--128K范围内平均RULER得分为84.4（GQA为73.0），且在完整注意力层中使用两个而非四个键值头。

articles.title: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
articles.abstract: Large language models have evolved from single-turn chatbots into interactive agents capable of long-horizon reasoning. In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflection in agents. Specifically, Agent-Reflex comprises three stages. First, Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling, samples a capability-diverse LLM pool, mines matched success-failure pairs, and summarizes reusable reflection meta-skills. Building on this skill library, we then apply Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT) that converts each skill into supervision for self-reflection, skill recovery, and user-centric correction, strengthening complementary reflective behaviors. Finally, we propose On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO) to combine agentic reinforcement learning under noisy interactions with reflection-guided on-policy distillation to further elicit proactive reflection. Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines. Experiments on six challenging agent benchmark suites demonstrate the effectiveness of Agent-Reflex. Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents' robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training. Our code is available at https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Agent-Reflex.
articles.titleCn: Agent-Reflex：教导语言代理进行反思性行动
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型已从单轮对话机器人演变为能够进行长时程推理的交互式智能体。在实际部署中，MCP工具服务可能返回噪声反馈，用户也可能介入纠正智能体，但现有方法对反思学习和故障恢复的监督有限。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了Agent-Reflex，一个用于激励智能体主动反思的通用训练框架。具体而言，Agent-Reflex包含三个阶段。首先，环境反思技能发现（RSD）将基于工具反馈的扰动注入环境扩展中，采样能力多样化的LLM池，挖掘匹配的成功失败对，并总结可重用的反思元技能。基于此技能库，我们随后应用反思监督微调（ReSFT），将每项技能转化为自我反思、技能恢复和以用户为中心的纠正的监督，强化互补的反思行为。最后，我们提出了在线策略反思策略优化（ORPO），将噪声交互下的智能体强化学习与反思引导的在线策略蒸馏相结合，以进一步激发主动反思。基于Qwen3-8B，Agent-Reflex在五个长时程工具使用基准测试中达到58.6分，在AgentNoiseBench上达到29.1分，超越了强大的环境扩展和反思基线。在六个具有挑战性的智能体基准测试套件上的实验证明了Agent-Reflex的有效性。进一步分析表明，Agent-Reflex提高了智能体对噪声的鲁棒性，同时保持了稳定的训练动态，支持可扩展的智能体训练。我们的代码可在https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Agent-Reflex获取。

articles.title: HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have attracted increasing research attention due to their bidirectional attention and arbitrary order decoding. However, there are two issues in dLLMs inference: the decoding difficulty is dominated by the tokens on the right side of the block, and the block-wise decoding inherently suffers from boundary contextual discontinuity. To tackle these limitations, we propose HaloBlock, a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism for dLLM inference. We first leverage bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty. Then, based on the bidirectional decoding difficulty, we adaptively allocate bidirectional halo regions on both sides of each block to mitigate boundary contextual discontinuity. The difficulty-aware design of HaloBlock smooths cross-block context propagation and lowers decoding difficulty for hard tokens, yielding better generation quality and faster convergence. Evaluated on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Instruct and LLaDA-1.5 across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, HaloBlock demonstrates consistent accuracy improvements and higher inference efficiency. Source codes are publicly available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock.
articles.titleCn: HaloBlock：扩散大型语言模型的更快、更好的解码
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）因其双向注意力机制和任意顺序解码而受到越来越多的研究关注。然而，dLLMs推理中存在两个问题：解码难度主要由块右侧的token决定，而块状解码本质上会遭受边界上下文不连续性。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了HaloBlock，一种针对dLLM推理的难度感知自适应光环机制。我们首先利用双向累积熵来表征块解码难度，然后基于双向解码难度，自适应地在每个块的两侧分配双向光环区域，以缓解边界上下文不连续性。HaloBlock的难度感知设计使跨块上下文传播更加平滑，并降低难token的解码难度，从而获得更好的生成质量和更快的收敛速度。在数学推理和代码生成基准测试LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-7B-Instruct和LLaDA-1.5上评估时，HaloBlock展现出持续性的准确率提升和更高的推理效率。源代码公开可在https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock获取。

articles.title: Batch-Paced: Fixed-Budget Batch Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: As generative language models become more capable and widely used, inference demand grows, making efficient serving increasingly important. Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising path to more efficient inference through parallel token generation. Prior dLLM decoding methods, however, focus on improving inference efficiency for individual sequences. We formulate fixed-budget dLLM batch decoding and introduce Batch-Paced, a training-free method that jointly optimizes the allocation of decoding compute across requests to improve overall batch quality. Across two dLLM backbones, five benchmarks and their representative mixtures, Batch-Paced improves batch performance under matched budgets; gains generally grow with batch size and largely persist across decoding configurations. Analysis of requests' decoding trajectories suggests that these gains arise largely by raising the committed-token confidence of lower-confidence requests. We further show that Batch-Paced's batch decode time remains competitive and that adding a decoding-depth allowance during Batch-Paced decoding can shorten it further at a modest performance cost.
articles.titleCn: 批量调速：离散扩散语言模型中的固定预算批量解码
articles.abstractCn: 随着生成式语言模型的能力越来越强且应用越来越广泛，推理需求不断增长，使得高效服务变得愈发重要。离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）通过并行生成token为更高效的推理提供了有前景的途径。然而，先前的dLLM解码方法主要关注提高单个序列的推理效率。我们提出了固定预算dLLM批量解码，并引入了Batch-Paced，这是一种无需训练的方法，它联合优化了跨请求的解码计算分配，以提升整体批量质量。在两个dLLM主干网络、五个基准测试及其代表性混合数据上，Batch-Paced在匹配预算下提升了批量性能；性能提升通常随着批量大小增加而增长，并且在很大程度上在不同解码配置中保持稳定。对请求解码轨迹的分析表明，这些提升主要源于提高了低置信度请求的承诺token置信度。我们进一步证明，Batch-Paced的批量解码时间保持具有竞争力，并且在Batch-Paced解码过程中增加解码深度允许可以在适度性能损失的情况下进一步缩短解码时间。

articles.title: Text-Only vs. Image-Aware VLM Judges for Manga Translation Evaluation
articles.abstract: In manga translation, visual context outside speech-bubble text, including speaker identities, referents, and scene tone, is depicted in page images, making it natural to refer to images during translation evaluation. However, most conventional manga translation evaluations rely solely on text-only automatic metrics, leaving the impact of image input insufficiently explored. We propose a practical validation framework that employs the same vision-language model (VLM) as both a text-only judge (TOJ) and an image-aware judge (IAJ) to investigate evaluation divergences associated with image-aware evaluation procedures. We use a Japanese-English manga dataset of official translations aligned at the page and speech-bubble levels. First, adding page images to TOJ improved the primary VLM's detection of deliberately injected, visually dependent degradations. Second, we analyzed evaluation divergences between TOJ and IAJ, finding different error counts and error-category distributions. Human verification did not reveal a consistent preference between TOJ and IAJ.
articles.comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables. Accepted at WMT 2026
articles.titleCn: 文本型与图像感知型VLM裁判器在漫画翻译评估中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 在漫画翻译中，除了对话气泡内的文字外，说话者身份、指代对象和场景氛围等视觉语境信息都通过页面图像呈现，这使得在翻译评估过程中参考图像显得自然。然而，大多数传统的漫画翻译评估仅依赖纯文本的自动指标，导致图像输入的影响未能得到充分探索。我们提出了一种实用的验证框架，该框架采用相同的视觉语言模型（VLM）作为纯文本裁判（TOJ）和图像感知裁判（IAJ），以研究与图像感知评估程序相关的评估差异。我们使用了一个日语-英语漫画数据集，该数据集在页面和对话气泡级别与官方翻译对齐。首先，将页面图像添加到TOJ提升了主要VLM对故意注入的、依赖视觉的退化的检测能力。其次，我们分析了TOJ和IAJ之间的评估差异，发现错误数量和错误类别分布存在不同。人工验证并未显示出TOJ和IAJ之间具有一致的偏好。

articles.title: Evaluating the Causal Faithfulness of SHAP as a Candidate Attribution Method for SAE Features
articles.abstract: Sparse autoencoders decompose language model representations into interpretable features, but feature interpretation in this literature remains predominantly correlational. Attribution methods offer more direct estimates of feature influence, yet their faithfulness to actual causal effects has not been systematically evaluated in the SAE setting. We apply SHAP-based attribution to SAE latent features and evaluate it against direct causal intervention, using sentiment classification on SST-2 with GPT-2 Small and a 32,768-feature layer-7 SAE as a testbed. We compare SHAP to Integrated Gradients, Gradient$\times$Input, and probe-weight baselines across linear and MLP probe arms, scoring each against feature ablation and activation steering measured through the language model's own logit difference. Most faithfulness associations we measure do not survive multiple-comparison correction, and attribution methods that agree strongly with one another ($ρ= 0.42$--$0.80$) agree poorly with measured causal effects, indicating that inter-method agreement is not evidence of causal faithfulness. Two effects hold under control. First, local per-example attribution retains a directional advantage over global averaged attribution, while its apparent importance advantage is explained by feature activity rather than superior causal ranking. Second, under known-ground-truth minimal pairs, attribution recovers inserted sentiment signal well above chance (AUROC $0.792$) but fails to localize deletions (AUROC $0.520$), suggesting that these methods detect the presence of a feature's influence more reliably than its absence. We argue that importance faithfulness and directional faithfulness are separable properties requiring separate evaluation, and that attribution agreement should not substitute for causal validation.
articles.comment: 24 pages, 3 figures; to be submitted to International Journal of Secondary Computing and Applications Research
articles.titleCn: 评估SHAP作为SAE特征候选归因方法的因果忠实度
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏自动编码器将语言模型表示分解为可解释的特征，但在该文献中，特征解释仍以相关性为主。归因方法提供了更直接的估计特征影响的方法，然而它们对实际因果效应的忠实度在稀疏自动编码器（SAE）设置中尚未得到系统评估。我们应用基于SHAP的归因方法来分析SAE潜在特征，并将其与直接因果干预进行对比，使用SST-2数据集、GPT-2 Small模型和包含32,768个特征的层7SAE作为测试平台。我们比较了SHAP与集成梯度、梯度×输入和探针权重基线，在线性探针和MLP探针臂上分别进行评分，通过语言模型自身的logit差异来衡量特征消融和激活引导。我们测量的忠实度关联大多在多重比较校正后不再成立，且归因方法之间高度一致（ρ=0.42--0.80）的关联却与测量的因果效应关联度低，表明方法间的共识并非因果忠实度的证据。有两个效应得到控制。首先，局部逐例归因相较于全局平均归因仍保持方向优势，而其重要性优势可归因于特征活跃度而非更优的因果排序。其次，在已知最小对（ground-truth minimal pairs）下，归因方法能以显著高于偶然水平的准确度（AUROC 0.792）恢复插入的情感信号，但无法定位删除（AUROC 0.520），表明这些方法更可靠地检测特征影响的存在而非其缺失。我们认为重要性忠实度和方向忠实度是可分离的特性，需要分别评估，且归因共识不应替代因果验证。

articles.title: Swiss4Arg: A Parallel Dataset for Multilingual Argument Mining across Swiss National Languages
articles.abstract: We present Swiss4Arg, a multilingual dataset for argument mining based on official Swiss voting brochures, covering all four national languages: German, French, Italian, and Romansh (a Romance minority language exclusively spoken in Switzerland). The brochures contain explicitly formulated arguments systematically organized into pro and con sections, resulting in a cross-lingually aligned resource with balanced argumentative stance. We create a dataset that comprises 53 federal voting issues collected between 2019 and 2025, annotated for argument components (major claims, claims, premises, and non-argumentative units) and relations (support and attack) by three native speakers per language. Inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's alpha) reaches 0.548 for component classification and 0.623 for relation and target classification, computed jointly across all annotators on the parallel data. We release both adjudicated labels and individual annotator annotations, enabling analyses of disagreement and cross-linguistic variation, and provide baseline results using GPT-5.4 and SwissBERT. Swiss4Arg establishes a novel benchmark for multilingual argument mining, with a particular focus on cross-lingual comparability and low-resource settings such as Romansh. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://anonymous-hf.up.railway.app/a/gozw0nion72y/ (HuggingFace) and https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MultiVote-03BD/ (GitHub).
articles.titleCn: Swiss4Arg：一个用于瑞士国家语言多语言论挖掘的并行数据集
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了Swiss4Arg，一个基于瑞士官方投票手册的多语言论元挖掘数据集，涵盖了德语、法语、意大利语和罗曼什语（一种仅限于瑞士使用的罗曼语系少数民族语言）。手册中明确表述的论元被系统地组织为赞成和反对部分，从而形成了一个跨语言对齐且论元立场均衡的资源。我们创建了一个数据集，其中包含53个2019年至2025年间收集的联邦投票议题，由每种语言的三个母语者进行标注，标注内容包括论元成分（主要论点、论点、前提和非论元单元）以及关系（支持和攻击）。在平行数据上对所有标注者进行联合计算，组件分类的标注者间一致性（Krippendorff's alpha）达到0.548，关系和目标分类的标注者间一致性达到0.623。我们发布了仲裁标签和单个标注者的标注结果，以支持对分歧和跨语言变异的分析，并提供了使用GPT-5.4和SwissBERT的基线结果。Swiss4Arg为多语言论元挖掘建立了一个新的基准，特别关注跨语言可比性和低资源环境（如罗曼什语）。数据集和代码可在https://anonymous-hf.up.railway.app/a/gozw0nion72y/（HuggingFace）和https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MultiVote-03BD/（GitHub）公开获取。

articles.title: Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards
articles.abstract: Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choices and calculations. We post-train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B-it through self-play and evaluate transfer to seven unseen natural-language collaboration tasks. CoSIR achieves the highest aggregate score, while its performance in general tasks remains competitive. Behavioral analyses show increased disclosure of private evidence and fewer judged failures to use teammates' input.
articles.titleCn: 使用可验证信息奖励训练用于多智能体协作的大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 在多智能体系统中，大型语言模型（LLM）智能体之间进行有效协作需要共享相关证据、请求缺失信息，并将队友的贡献纳入决策。由于最终任务结果对单个消息的价值提供有限的反馈，训练这些行为具有挑战性。我们引入了CoSIR（基于意外性信息奖励的协作），这是一种后训练方法，它使用一个简单、可验证的环境来教授可推广到更复杂、未见任务的协作行为。我们提出了一种贝叶斯评估器，通过共享信息减少团队意外性的程度来对其进行评分，意外性定义为每个智能体根据其可用证据分配给正确选项的负对数概率之和。请求通过如果请求的信息被真实提供，则该量潜在减少的可能性进行评分。单独的奖励鼓励智能体在他们的私人选择和计算中使用接收到的信息。我们通过自我博弈对Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-3-4B-it进行后训练，并评估其在七个未见过的自然语言协作任务上的迁移能力。CoSIR实现了最高的总分，而其在一般任务中的表现仍然具有竞争力。行为分析显示，私人证据的披露增加，且被判定为未能使用队友输入的情况减少。

articles.title: Cross-Lingual Transfer of Evil Vectors Is Directionally Asymmetric
articles.abstract: Persona vectors are linear directions in the residual-stream activations of LLMs that encode behavioral traits and enable fine-grained control over model behavior. Among them, the evil persona vector is particularly relevant to understanding harmful behavior, jailbreak vulnerabilities, and the unlearning of harmful knowledge. Yet whether this vector reflects a genuinely cross-lingual concept, rather than an artifact of its extraction language, remains untested. We conduct a systematic evil-vector transfer study across two high-resource languages (English, Spanish) and two low-resource languages (Swahili, Telugu) on four open-source instruction-tuned LLMs, and find that transfer is directionally asymmetric. Evil vectors are harder to obtain reliably from low-resource languages, and the resulting vectors are largely ineffective at steering, even within their own language. In contrast, vectors extracted from high-resource languages transfer effectively to low-resource inputs while largely preserving general knowledge, as measured by MMLU. Geometric analysis further supports this pattern: evil vectors from the two high-resource languages are closely aligned, whereas low-resource vectors align only weakly with this shared direction. These results suggest that a shared cross-lingual evil direction exists and, once reliably extracted from a high-resource language, can be reused to steer behavior in low-resource languages without additional per-language data collection.
articles.comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Multilingual Representation Learning (MRL) at EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: 跨语言迁移恶意向量是方向不对称的
articles.abstractCn: 人格向量是大型语言模型残差流激活中的线性方向，它们编码行为特征并使模型行为能够实现细粒度控制。其中，邪恶人格向量尤其与理解有害行为、越狱漏洞以及有害知识的遗忘密切相关。然而，该向量是否反映了一个真正跨语言的抽象概念，而非其提取语言的产物，尚未得到验证。我们在四种开源指令微调的大型语言模型上，针对两种高资源语言（英语、西班牙语）和两种低资源语言（斯瓦希里语、泰卢固语）进行了一项系统的邪恶向量迁移研究，发现迁移具有方向上的不对称性。从低资源语言中可靠地获取邪恶向量更加困难，且所得向量在引导模型行为时效果不佳，即使在同一种语言中也是如此。相比之下，从高资源语言中提取的向量能够有效地迁移到低资源输入中，同时基本保留了通用知识，这一点通过MMLU测试得以验证。几何分析进一步支持这一模式：来自两种高资源语言的邪恶向量高度对齐，而低资源向量仅与这一共同方向呈现微弱的关联。这些结果表明，存在一个共享的跨语言邪恶方向，一旦从高资源语言中可靠提取，便无需额外收集每种语言的数据，即可用于引导低资源语言的行为。

articles.title: Prefilling-dLLM v2: Learned Chunk Routing for Long-Context Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models apply bidirectional attention over the whole context at every denoising step, so a longer context makes each step substantially more expensive. Sparsifying only at inference leaves the pretrained weights unchanged, so the model is never trained under the sparse pattern it runs with. We propose Prefilling-dLLM v2, which continues training a diffusion language model so that it routes with its native mask token. One mask is appended at the end of each chunk, and a learned role offset marks it as a routing slot. On every fourth layer, a query keeps a bidirectional local window and the top-K chunks scored from that mask; the other layers use a bidirectional sliding window. Starting from Dream-v0-Base-7B extended to 16K with YaRN, we compare Prefilling-dLLM v2 with bidirectional NSA, DSA, and SWA under the same layout, key budget, and dense initialization, using the same Fast-dLLM decoder. With the YaRN factor scaled to the evaluation length, Prefilling-dLLM v2 leads the other sparse methods on all three RULER tasks from 16K to 128K. Its mean accuracy at 128K is 7.4 points above NSA, the next sparse model, while DSA and SWA remain near zero. At the same length, decoding is 172x faster than with full dense attention.
articles.titleCn: 预填充-DLLM v2：针对长上下文扩散语言模型的分块路由学习
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型在每次去噪步骤中对整个上下文应用双向注意力，因此更长的上下文会使每一步的成本显著增加。仅在推理时进行稀疏化会保持预训练权重不变，因此模型从未在它运行时的稀疏模式下进行训练。我们提出了Prefilling-dLLM v2，它继续训练扩散语言模型，使其使用其本地的掩码标记进行路由。在每个块末尾会追加一个掩码，一个学习到的角色偏移量将其标记为路由槽位。在每第四层，一个查询保持从该掩码评分的K个最佳块的双向局部窗口；其他层使用双向滑动窗口。从使用YaRN扩展到16K的Dream-v0-Base-7B开始，我们在相同的布局、密钥预算和密集初始化下，使用相同的Fast-dLLM解码器，将Prefilling-dLLM v2与双向NSA、DSA和SWA进行比较。将YaRN因子扩展到评估长度后，Prefilling-dLLM v2在16K到128K的所有三个RULER任务上领先其他稀疏方法。在128K时，其平均准确率比下一个稀疏模型NSA高出7.4分，而DSA和SWA接近零。在相同长度下，解码速度比全密集注意力快172倍。

articles.title: Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are appealing for code generation because they can update many tokens in parallel, yet many are optimized for sequence synthesis rather than edit prediction. This setting is poorly matched to modern AI-assisted IDEs, where edit prediction must infer the next code change from recent edits, the current file, and cursor-local context. Such changes are usually sparse and preserve most source tokens, so regenerating a full code segment wastes computation. We propose Diff Diffusion, a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code editing that predicts edit paths from an original snippet to its revised form. Diff Diffusion represents denoising as structured edit operations, and combines this formulation with multi-stage training and efficient parallel decoding. By focusing computation on changed regions, Diff Diffusion supports accurate low-latency edits and multi-position parallel modification. Across public edit-completion benchmarks, edit-prediction evaluations, and online validation, Diff Diffusion matches or leads autoregressive baselines while delivering 2.78 times faster inference on public edit-completion benchmarks and a 39.0% P50 model-latency reduction in production. This work provides a new modeling perspective for AI applications that require high accuracy and low latency.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning
articles.titleCn: 差异扩散：利用扩散模型预测编辑路径以实现高效代码编辑
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）在代码生成方面具有吸引力，因为它们可以并行更新多个标记，但许多模型是为序列合成而非编辑预测而优化的。这种设置与现代AI辅助的IDE不匹配，在IDE中，编辑预测必须从最近的编辑、当前文件和光标局部上下文中推断下一个代码更改。此类更改通常是稀疏的，并保留大多数源标记，因此重新生成整个代码段会浪费计算。我们提出了Diff Diffusion，这是一个受扩散启发的LLM框架，用于代码编辑，它从原始片段预测到修订形式的编辑路径。Diff Diffusion将去噪表示为结构化编辑操作，并将这种公式与多阶段训练和高效的并行解码相结合。通过将计算集中在更改区域，Diff Diffusion支持精确的低延迟编辑和多位置并行修改。在公共编辑完成基准测试、编辑预测评估和在线验证中，Diff Diffusion与自回归基线相当或领先，同时在公共编辑完成基准测试上提供2.78倍的推理速度提升，并在生产环境中将P50模型延迟降低了39.0%。这项工作为需要高精度和低延迟的AI应用提供了一种新的建模视角。

articles.title: Checking the Checkers: A Synthesis of Verifier Noise and Robustness in RLVR
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a principal recipe for improving the reasoning of large language models (LLMs). It rests on the assumption that the checker scoring each response is itself correct. In practice, rule-based checkers reject correct answers in unexpected formats, unit tests accept incorrect programs, and LLM judges can be led to approve empty or adversarial responses. This work surveys 58 studies that measure, analyze, or mitigate such verifier errors. We ask what errors verifiers make, how they affect training, which mitigations work against which errors, and how the findings extend to self-generated, rubric- and judge-based, and verifier-free rewards. The evidence suggests that the structure of an error matters more than its rate. Random errors mostly slow learning, though under a fixed budget or KL regularization they also lower final accuracy. False positives that the policy can learn to trigger can cause plateaus or collapse, sometimes even with a low initial error rate. Whether a verifier wrongly rejects or accepts depends on what it checks and who built it, not on its family. Its errors shift as the policy improves, and most mitigations have been tested against only one kind of error. We compile the findings into comparison tables, reconcile apparent conflicts in the literature, and propose a reporting protocol to make future results comparable.
articles.comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Centric Systems, Services, and Applications (AISSA 2026)
articles.titleCn: 检查检查者：RLVR中验证器噪声和鲁棒性的综合
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的主要方法。该方法基于一个假设，即对每个响应进行评分的检查器本身是正确的。然而在实践中，基于规则的检查器会因格式意外而拒绝正确答案，单元测试会接受错误的程序，而LLM判别器可能被诱导批准空响应或对抗性响应。本研究综述了58项测量、分析或缓解此类验证器错误的研究。我们探讨了验证器会犯哪些错误、这些错误如何影响训练、哪些缓解措施对哪些错误有效，以及这些发现如何扩展到自生成奖励、评分标准和判别器奖励。证据表明，错误的结构比错误率更重要。随机错误主要会减慢学习速度，但在固定预算或KL正则化下，它们也会降低最终准确率。政策可以学习的假阳性错误会导致平台期甚至崩溃，即使初始错误率较低。验证器是否错误拒绝或接受取决于其检查内容和构建者，而非其所属类别。随着政策的改进，其错误会发生变化，且大多数缓解措施只针对了一种错误类型。我们将这些发现整理成比较表格，调和了文献中的明显矛盾，并提出了一种报告协议，以使未来结果具有可比性。

articles.title: Perturbation, Not Provenance: Why Activation Steering Does Not Make a Robust Text Watermark
articles.abstract: Linear directions in the activation space of large language models causally and universally influence model behavior. This suggests that they might serve as a basis for a robust text watermark. The idea is to steer the generation along a specific semantic direction and then recover the mark by probing the activations of the re-encoded text. We test this hypothesis by conducting a series of experiments. We vary the strength of the steering and use four different directions (formality, sentiment, complexity, and a random control) across two different model families. We also test two paraphrasing attacks: a sentence-level one and a stronger paragraph-level one. The results show that activation-steering watermarks are outperformed by a standard logit-based watermark (KGW) in terms of detection accuracy. At a matched level of fluency (within 1.15 times the original text's perplexity), KGW achieved an AUC of 0.81 against a sentence-level paraphraser, while the best steering direction only reached 0.65. A stronger paragraph-level paraphraser lowered both (0.65 for KGW and 0.59 for steering), narrowing the gap but not reversing it. On Qwen, it left the two indistinguishable but at near-chance levels for both. We further showed that the detectability provided by steering was not semantic: a random direction was just as detectable as a meaningful one. The signal was independent of which layer was probed and whether a surface feature control was used. We conclude that, in this case, semantic activation does not encode a localized, recoverable semantic mark, but rather a global, content-independent shift that can only be strongly detected when the text is degraded.
articles.titleCn: 扰动而非来源：为何激活引导无法实现鲁棒的文本水印
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的激活空间中的线性方向会因果且普遍地影响模型行为。这表明它们可能成为稳健文本水印的基础。该想法是沿着特定语义方向引导生成，然后通过探测重新编码文本的激活来恢复水印。我们通过进行一系列实验来验证这一假设。我们改变了引导的强度，并在两个不同的模型家族中使用了四个不同的方向（正式性、情感、复杂性和随机控制）。我们还测试了两种释义攻击：一种句子级别的攻击和一种更强的段落级别攻击。结果表明，在检测精度方面，激活引导水印不如基于逻辑位的标准水印（KGW）表现优异。在匹配的流畅度水平（原始文本困惑度的1.15倍以内），KGW对句子级别释义器的AUC达到0.81，而最佳引导方向仅达到0.65。更强的段落级别释义器降低了这两个数值（KGW为0.65，引导为0.59），缩小了差距但并未逆转。在Qwen上，它使两者变得无法区分，但两者的检测水平都接近随机水平。我们进一步表明，引导提供的可检测性并非语义性的：一个随机方向与一个有意义的方向一样容易被检测。信号与探测的层无关，也与是否使用表面特征控制无关。我们得出结论，在这种情况下，语义激活并没有编码一个局部可恢复的语义标记，而是一种全局的、内容无关的偏移，这种偏移只有在文本被退化时才能被强烈检测到。

articles.title: BRIDGE: Selective Boundary Repair with Dependency Graph Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: Multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a critical paradigm for tackling complex, long-horizon tasks; however, while coordination protocols continue to advance, systemic failures at the inter-agent collaboration interface remain a pervasive bottleneck. In collaborative workflows, systems frequently suffer from \emph{broken handoffs}---where critical task context is omitted, misrouted, or ignored despite each agent emitting locally plausible responses. To address this challenge, we present \method, a verifiable runtime control framework that treats handoff repair as selective intervention over explicit dependency graphs. Central to \method is an integrated fault-attribution and calibration pipeline, \dataset, which decouples execution dependencies and injects counterfactual handoff perturbations to provide empirical supervision for runtime intervention. Leveraging this diagnostic foundation, \method dynamically compiles observable interaction traces into a provenance graph to pinpoint unresolved dependencies, without accessing private agent states. It then evaluates candidate repairs through an empirical gate that weighs expected gains against disruption risks, and executes repairs only when formal local postconditions hold. Extensive evaluations across demanding benchmarks demonstrate that \method boosts task success by up to 12.3 absolute percentage points on SILO-BENCH and 11.1 on TeamBench. Across both backbones, \method maintains strict cost-effectiveness, adding as little as 2.0\% marginal token overhead. Furthermore, on 562 handoff-relevant traces from the MAST benchmark, \method achieves 69.8\% F1 in a single pass, establishing a reliable operational boundary for verifiable coordination repair.
articles.titleCn: 桥梁：基于依赖图证据的多智能体系统选择性边界修复
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体协作已成为解决复杂、长时程任务的关键范式；然而，尽管协调协议不断进步，智能体间协作接口的系统性故障仍然是一个普遍存在的瓶颈。在协作工作流中，系统经常遭受“交接中断”问题——即尽管每个智能体都发出局部合理的响应，但关键任务上下文被遗漏、误导向或被忽视。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了\method，这是一个可验证的运行时控制框架，将交接修复视为对显式依赖图的选择性干预。\method的核心是一个集成的故障归因和校准流程\dataset，它解耦执行依赖关系，并注入反事实交接扰动，为运行时干预提供实证监督。利用这一诊断基础，\method动态地将可观测的交互轨迹编译为溯源图，以定位未解决的依赖关系，而无需访问智能体的私有状态。然后，它通过一个实证门控评估候选修复方案，该门控权衡预期收益与中断风险，仅在满足正式局部后置条件时执行修复。在多个苛刻基准上的广泛评估表明，\method将SILO-BENCH上的任务成功率提升了12.3个百分点，TeamBench上提升了11.1个百分点。在两个主干网络中，\method始终保持严格的成本效益，边际token开销仅增加2.0%。此外，在MAST基准的562个与交接相关的轨迹中，\method单次通过即可实现69.8%的F1分数，为可验证协调修复建立了可靠的运行时边界。

articles.title: Where Words Begin and End
articles.abstract: Forced aligners locate each word of a known transcript in the audio, and many speech pipelines depend on them. In our own data, a widely used CTC aligner inserts a pause at nearly every word boundary, and we found almost no aligner evaluated on telephone audio. We compare nine aligner configurations against human word boundaries on read, conversational and telephone English. The Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA) is the most precise, while CTC aligners consistently start words late, because most frames inside a word go to the blank token. We then fine-tune Whisper with LoRA to predict each word's start and end as timestamp tokens, training only on boundaries placed by people: 47 hours in 87 languages. The resulting aligner is more precise than MFA on every English test condition, and than MFA's own Korean and Dutch models. With FA-Bench's protocol and code on TIMIT, its word-boundary error is 11.6 ms, against 18.2 ms for the best published system. Two choices matter most on telephone conversations: placing the timestamp slots after the word they time, and training on noisy transcripts, which also makes the aligner nearly insensitive to errors in the transcript. The released model reaches 16.0 ms on real landline calls, against 36.5 ms for MFA. The models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/force-alignment
articles.titleCn: 词语的起点与终点
articles.abstractCn: 强制对齐器能够在已知文本转录中定位音频中的每个单词，许多语音处理流程都依赖它们。在我们的数据中，一种广泛使用的CTC对齐器几乎在每个单词边界处插入停顿，我们发现几乎没有针对电话音频进行评估的对齐器。我们将九种对齐器配置与人类单词边界在朗读、对话和电话英语上进行比较。蒙特利尔强制对齐器（MFA）最为精确，而CTC对齐器始终在单词开始时出现延迟，因为单词内的多数帧都分配给了空白标记。然后我们使用LoRA微调Whisper，以预测每个单词的开始和结束时间戳标记，仅在人类放置的边界上进行训练：87种语言共47小时。最终得到的对齐器在所有英语测试条件下都比MFA更精确，并且比MFA自己的韩语和荷兰语模型更精确。使用FA-Bench的协议和代码在TIMIT数据集上，其单词边界错误为11.6毫秒，而最佳已发表系统的错误为18.2毫秒。在电话对话中，最重要的两个选择是：将时间戳槽放置在被计时单词之后，以及使用含噪声的转录文本进行训练，这也使得对齐器几乎不受转录文本中错误的影响。发布的模型在真实电话通话中达到16.0毫秒，而MFA则为36.5毫秒。这些模型可在https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/force-alignment获取。

articles.title: Full-duplex Spoken Language Modeling with Discrete Diffusion
articles.abstract: We introduce Diffuplex, a full-duplex spoken language model based on discrete diffusion that achieves an unprecedented balance between linguistic intelligence and response efficiency. With thinking mode, Diffuplex delivers 13.0 tokens per forward pass, reaching an average of 1872 tokens per second and substantially surpassing the frontier autoregressive (AR) models in decoding speed. Without thinking, Diffuplex matches the first-audio latency of existing full-duplex models while achieving markedly stronger linguistic intelligence. This capability is enabled by separating when to say from what to say at the training level, rather than compressing both into a single autoregressive timeline. During inference, Diffuplex continuously tracks the user speech through an AR interaction policy, while independently generating and refining response content through parallel diffusion. Consequently, semantic computation is no longer bounded by the perception audio frame rate, allowing intelligence and responsiveness to improve simultaneously. Taken together, these results establish a new paradigm for spoken agents that can sustain real-time dialogue while devoting parallel computation to intelligent response generation. Training code and checkpoints will be avaliable soon.
articles.titleCn: 离散扩散的全双工语音语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Diffuplex，一种基于离散扩散的全双工语音语言模型，它在语言智能和响应效率之间实现了前所未有的平衡。通过思考模式，Diffuplex每一步前向传递产生13.0个token，达到每秒1872个token的平均速度，在解码速度上显著超越了前沿自回归（AR）模型。在不使用思考模式时，Diffuplex匹配了现有全双工模型的首次音频延迟，同时实现了显著更强的语言智能。这种能力是通过在训练级别上将何时说话与说什么分离，而不是将两者压缩到单一的自回归时间线上来实现的。在推理过程中，Diffuplex通过AR交互策略持续追踪用户语音，同时通过并行扩散独立生成和细化响应内容。因此，语义计算不再受限于感知音频帧率，使得智能性和响应能力能够同时提升。总而言之，这些结果为能够实时对话并同时进行智能响应生成的语音代理建立了一种新的范式。训练代码和检查点将很快提供。

articles.title: GENDIS: Gender-Related Discourse and Stance in Multilingual YouTube Comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria
articles.abstract: Research on gender-related online content is often operationalized through harm-centered tasks that collapse non-harmful gender-related and unrelated content, while existing datasets remain concentrated in high-resource languages and Global North settings. To bridge these gaps, we introduce GENDIS, a dataset of 9,600 multilingual, human-annotated YouTube comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria (3,200 per country), annotated using a two-level framework that first identifies whether gender is referenced and then classifies gender-related content as negative, positive, or neutral. This separation provides a denominator for gender-related discourse independent of harm, enabling both prevalence estimation and characterization of its evaluative range. In the uniform random stratum, 23.8-35.0% of comments are gender-related, and among those with a resolved stance, 82% are neutral or positive. Across models, gender-reference detection is substantially easier than stance classification, especially for positive and neutral speech. Lightly supervised classifiers match frontier zero-shot large language models at substantially lower cost and outperform generic toxicity detection, while cross-country transfer remains limited. GENDIS provides a locally grounded resource for measuring when gender is invoked online and how that reference is framed.
articles.comment: 23 pages. Accepted at the Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: GENDIS：印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚多语种YouTube评论中的性别相关话语与立场
articles.abstractCn: 针对性别相关网络内容的研究通常通过以伤害为中心的任务进行操作化，这些任务将非伤害性的性别相关内容与无关内容混为一谈，而现有的数据集仍集中在资源丰富语言和全球北方地区。为了弥补这些差距，我们引入了GENDIS数据集，这是一个包含9,600条多语言人工标注的YouTube评论的数据集，来自印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚（每个国家3,200条），采用两级框架进行标注，首先识别是否提及性别，然后将性别相关内容分类为负面、正面或中性。这种区分提供了与伤害无关的性别相关话语的基数，从而能够进行流行度估计及其评价范围的特征描述。在统一随机分层中，23.8-35.0%的评论与性别相关，而在立场已明确的评论中，82%为中性或正面。在各个模型中，性别指代检测比立场分类要容易得多，尤其是对于正面和中性言论。轻度监督分类器在成本显著更低的情况下与前沿零样本大型语言模型相当，并且优于通用的毒性检测，但跨国迁移能力有限。GENDIS为测量在线何时提及性别以及如何构建这种指代提供了一个基于本地资源的数据集。

articles.title: Beyond Belief Nesting: Rethinking Higher-Order Theory of Mind in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others' mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives. Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.
articles.titleCn: 超越信念嵌套：重新思考大型语言模型中的高阶心智理论
articles.abstractCn: 心智理论（Theory of Mind，简称ToM），即推理他人心理状态的能力，是有效沟通与协调的基础。其高阶形式能够对策略互动中的嵌套视角进行推理。然而，现有的评估方法常将信念嵌套深度等同于推理阶数，导致名义上高阶的问题允许低阶的捷径。我们通过区分支持连续信念前缀的独特事件来形式化有效阶数，揭示了现有基准中普遍存在的阶数膨胀现象。我们引入了HopToM，该模型包含经过验证的全阶数问题和针对低阶替代方案的控制。在直接提示下，四款前沿大型语言模型的平均准确率从第一阶的73.5%降至第四阶的20.0%，人类参与者也面临困难。因果干预将一类反复出现的错误与浅层信念前缀的证据联系起来。我们引入了HopTrace，这是一种即插即用的推理时方法，将每次交互编码为视角记录，并确定性地解决嵌套查询。在经过验证的叙事问题上，它比强提示基线提高了22.0和38.5个百分点，同时使用的token数量比多调用方法少20-39倍。这些结果明确了高阶心智理论评估的方式，并为改进交互智能体中的视角推理提供了实用方法。

articles.title: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
articles.abstract: A recommendation request on Reddit draws several replies, each naming different titles. When an LLM recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning (RL), which replies should a generated list be rewarded against? The state-of-the-art recipe, Rank-GRPO, picks one reply per training example, so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn (85% of its variance) rather than how good the list is. We argue that RL should train on the request, not on each answer, and propose ReMaRk: it scores every list once against the union of all replies' titles and samples each request equally. This makes RL cheaper. On seven backbones and three datasets, ReMaRk reaches the validation recall of 2,000 per-reply RL steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget; trained until neither improves, it is never significantly behind Rank-GRPO and in four of seven pairs reaches Rank-GRPO's best with fewer GPU-hours. The same reward helps on ProtoQA, where about 100 people answer each question, which points to a simple rule for RL with several valid human answers: reward them jointly.
articles.titleCn: 许多正确答案，一个训练样本：为LLM推荐系统移除GRPO中的响应者噪声
articles.abstractCn: 在Reddit上，一个推荐请求会收到多个回复，每个回复都包含不同的标题。当使用强化学习（RL）对LLM推荐器在这些帖子上进行训练时，生成的列表应该与哪些回复进行奖励？最先进的方法Rank-GRPO为每个训练样本选择一个回复，因此其优势主要记录了被选中的回复（其85%的方差），而不是列表的好坏。我们认为RL应该基于请求进行训练，而不是基于每个答案，并提出了ReMaRk方法：它将每个列表与所有回复标题的并集进行一次评分，并对每个请求进行同等数量的采样。这使得RL的训练成本更低。在七个骨干网络和三个数据集上，ReMaRk在25%到53%的步骤中达到了每回复RL步骤2000的验证召回率，并在该预算下表现最佳；当训练到不再有显著改进时，它从未显著落后于Rank-GRPO，并且在七个中的四个对中用更少的GPU小时达到了Rank-GRPO的最佳表现。同样的奖励机制在ProtoQA上同样有效，因为每个问题大约有100人回答，这表明对于有多个有效人类答案的RL，有一个简单的规则：联合奖励它们。

articles.title: More Reader Data or a Better Teacher? Updating a Model of Crowd Highlights in Late 2026
articles.abstract: A model trained on readers' highlights can show a newcomer where earlier readers converged on a page, even on pages with few readers. A year of stronger language models suggests two upgrades: use them directly, or use them as teachers. We compare both with a third, more reader data, on one social highlighting platform, with the comparisons, the selection rules and a sealed set of fresh pages fixed in advance. On 215 development pages, seven language models released by October 2026 rank sentences zero-shot at an average precision of at most 0.3744 against the sentences half the readers marked most, and 0.3931 when fused with reading position, while a 3-billion-parameter model trained on reader highlights alone reaches 0.4346. Used as the teacher that breaks ties among readers' counts, the stronger fusion changes a trained model by +0.0013 [-0.0012, +0.0040], whereas going from half to all of its training pages adds +0.0242 [+0.0179, +0.0301]. A 27-billion-parameter backbone on the reader-only recipe adds +0.0225 on the development pages; on 131 fresh pages, read once and too few for a confirmatory comparison, its difference from the 3-billion model is unresolved, both score above the fusion, and in an exploratory split their lead over the previous model sits on pages from domains that their fresh training pages also cover. In this recipe, more reader data improves a trained model where a stronger tie-breaking teacher yields no material gain, and frontier models used as rankers still trail a small model trained on readers.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 4 tables, 1 figure. Ancillary files include the pre-registration with its amendments, the results write-up, the aggregate artifacts every reported number is generated from, and the prompt, scoring, target and contrast code
articles.titleCn: 更多读者数据还是更好的教师？2026年末更新群体高亮模型
articles.abstractCn: 在读者高亮数据上训练的模型能够向新用户展示早期读者在哪些页面上达成共识，即使是在阅读量较少的页面上。过去一年的语言模型发展表明，有两种升级方案：直接使用这些模型，或将其作为教师模型。我们将这两种方案与第三种方案（基于一个社交高亮平台的更多读者数据）进行比较，包括比较方法、选择规则以及预先设定的密封的新鲜页面集。在215个开发页面上，截至2026年10月发布的七种语言模型在零样本情况下对句子进行排序的平均精度最多为0.3744，与读者中一半人标记的最优句子相比；而与阅读位置信息融合时，平均精度达到0.3931。仅基于读者高亮数据训练的30亿参数模型则达到了0.4346。作为打破读者计数平局的教师模型，更强的融合方案将训练模型的精度提升了+0.0013 [-0.0012, +0.0040]，而从一半训练页面扩展到全部训练页面则提升了+0.0242 [+0.0179, +0.0301]。仅基于读者数据的270亿参数主干模型在开发页面上提升了+0.0225；在131个仅被读取一次且数量不足以进行确认比较的新鲜页面上，其与30亿参数模型的差异尚不明确，两者得分均高于融合方案，在探索性拆分中，其相较于先前模型的领先优势出现在其新鲜训练页面也涵盖的领域。在这种方案中，更多读者数据能够提升训练模型的性能，而更强的平局打破教师模型并未带来实质性增益，且作为排序器的最前沿模型仍落后于一个基于读者数据的小型模型。

articles.title: Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking
articles.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the <think> tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages. By focusing on this pivotal branching point, RPO drastically reduces training overhead and VRAM usage. Across multiple model families and scales, RPO learns difficulty-aware adaptive thinking at just ~2% of the training compute of prior adaptive-reasoning methods.
articles.titleCn: 高效学习推理或非推理：自适应思维的根标记策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过在生成答案前外化显式推理轨迹来取得优异性能，但它们面临着过度思考的挑战，即对难度不同的查询分配均匀沉重的计算量。专有模型通过不透明的路由来缓解这一问题，而开源LRMs由于高昂的训练成本和训练配方披露有限，仍然缺乏高效的自适应推理机制。为此，我们引入RPO（Root-token Policy Optimization）框架，该框架使LRMs能够自行决定何时进行推理，通过仅训练初始根标记（例如，是否调用<think>标签），利用组相对奖励和组内优势进行训练。通过聚焦于这一关键分支点，RPO大幅降低了训练开销和VRAM使用。在多个模型系列和规模下，RPO仅需先前自适应推理方法约2%的训练计算量，即可学习难度感知的自适应思考。

articles.title: Connecting the Dots: Enduring Performance Gaps in ASR Systems Between Standard and Minority English Varieties
articles.abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system evaluations have consistently revealed performance disparities along lines of race, gender, socioeconomic status, and language variety. While these disparities are well-documented, they are often (implicitly or explicitly) treated as issues that subsequent, larger, and more universal models will correct. We challenge this assumption of steady progress in reducing accent-related performance disparities, conducting a longitudinal evaluation of 16 prominent systems released between 2021-2025 across 8 datasets representing diverse English accent varieties. We find that the performance disparity between Mainstream US English (MUSE) and minority accents is stubborn, not reliably declining as a function of time. Specifically, while systems are reliably performant on MUSE, minority accents are subject to risks of large performance degradations between generations of systems, sometimes worsening by 65% absolute Word Error Rate. We argue that standard ASR benchmarks enact an implicit language policy privileging Mainstream US English varieties. As such, these performance disparities reflect systemic failures of language technology development infrastructure that disproportionately affect underrepresented speaker populations.
articles.comment: Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026. 11 pages including appendix, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/smfsamir/longitudinal-asr-eval
articles.titleCn: 连接点：标准英语与少数英语方言在ASR系统中的持久性能差距
articles.abstractCn: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统的评估始终揭示出在种族、性别、社会经济地位和语言变体等方面存在性能差异。尽管这些差异已有充分记载，但它们往往（隐含或明确地）被视为后续更大、更通用的模型将解决的问题。我们挑战了减少口音相关性能差异稳步进步的假设，对2021年至2025年间发布的16个代表性系统进行了纵向评估，这些系统覆盖了8个代表不同英语口音变体的数据集。我们发现，主流美国英语（MUSE）与少数口音之间的性能差异依然顽固，并未随时间可靠地下降。具体而言，虽然系统在MUSE上表现可靠，但少数口音在系统代际之间易出现显著的性能退化，有时绝对词错误率（Word Error Rate）会恶化65%。我们认为，标准的ASR基准在隐含的语言政策上偏袒主流美国英语变体。因此，这些性能差异反映了语言技术开发基础设施的系统性缺陷，这些缺陷对代表性不足的说话者群体产生了不成比例的影响。

articles.title: Auditing Failure Attribution: Label Predictability and Judge Behavior
articles.abstract: Failure-attribution benchmarks ask an LLM judge which step or agent caused a failure. A high score should mean the judge checked the faulty step against the run (a cross-step check). However, spurious signals (surface cues) that predict the annotation can produce a high score. In this paper, we propose four tests to separate checking from cue use. Input restriction asks whether partial input predicts the annotation. Cue following checks whether moved cues change answers. Residual accuracy scores judges where cue-only predictors fail. Aggregation asks whether the failure mix or metric changes rankings. Real observations motivate these tests: on three benchmarks, simple predictors match or beat GPT-4.1. In two Who&When Pro systems, a classifier reading one step's reasoning finds 95-100% of faulty steps, motivating input restriction. In one of them, error injection leaves no reasoning after the faulty step; judges fine-tuned on its labels beat GPT-4.1 by 41 points. Adding task-related reasoning after that step moves this cue: fine-tuned judges lose 31-99 points, but zero-shot judges lose at most 9, motivating cue following. On Aegis, blaming every agent matches GPT-4.1 on micro-F1 but trails by 19 points in exact-set accuracy, motivating aggregation. We recommend reporting these tests when developing failure-attribution benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 审计故障归因：标签可预测性与裁判行为
articles.abstractCn: 故障归因基准要求大型语言模型裁判指出是哪个步骤或代理导致了故障。高分意味着裁判将故障步骤与运行情况（跨步骤检查）进行了比对。然而，预测标注的虚假信号（表面线索）可能产生高分。在本文中，我们提出了四种测试方法，以区分检查行为与线索使用。输入限制测试询问部分输入是否预测了标注结果。线索跟随测试检查移动后的线索是否改变了答案。残差准确率分数测试判断在仅使用线索的预测器失败的地方。聚合测试询问故障混合或指标是否改变了排名。实际观察结果促使我们提出这些测试：在三个基准测试中，简单的预测器与GPT-4.1相当或优于GPT-4.1。在两个Who&When Pro系统中，一个读取单个步骤推理的分类器发现了95-100%的故障步骤，这促使我们提出输入限制测试。在其中之一中，故障注入后故障步骤之后不再有推理；在基于其标签进行微调的裁判中，得分比GPT-4.1高出41分。在该步骤之后添加与任务相关的推理会移动这个线索：微调裁判的得分损失31-99分，但零样本裁判的得分最多损失9分，这促使我们提出线索跟随测试。在Aegis上，将每个代理归咎于故障在微观F1上与GPT-4.1相当，但在精确集准确率上落后19分，这促使我们提出聚合测试。我们建议在开发故障归因基准时报告这些测试。

articles.title: Geometric Structure Predicts Per-Example Neighborhood Loss Under PCA Truncation
articles.abstract: Dimensionality reduction can preserve the average performance of text embeddings even when a substantial fraction of their dimensions is removed. Aggregate metrics, however, do not reveal whether degradation is distributed uniformly across examples. We study per-example neighborhood stability under PCA truncation across static word embeddings and modern sentence encoders. Per-item neighbor retention varies widely and is predictable from geometric properties of the representation and its alignment with the retained PCA subspace. The fraction of centered-vector energy retained by the truncated subspace is strongest for CBOW and RI, with neighborhood contrast leading on SkipGram and the modern/Matryoshka settings (GTE approximately tied), while local density is associated with retention in marginal analysis but adds little unique information once energy and contrast are controlled (R-squared increments 0.001 to 0.010). Local intrinsic dimensionality accounts for more variation than density on modern sentence encoders in pairwise comparison. On SciFact, query density predicts retrieval degradation under aggressive compression; on NFCorpus the primary 32d association does not replicate, and a direct variance-restriction test leaves that null unresolved. Average compression performance conceals systematic per-example variation that geometry makes visible.
articles.titleCn: 几何结构预测PCA截断下的每例邻域损失
articles.abstractCn: 降维可以在移除文本嵌入中相当一部分维度后，仍保留其平均性能。然而，聚合指标并不能揭示这种退化是否均匀分布在各个样本中。我们研究了在主成分分析（PCA）截断下，静态词嵌入和现代句子编码器中每个样本邻域的稳定性。每个样本的邻域保留率差异很大，并且可以根据表示的几何属性及其与保留的PCA子空间的对齐性来预测。截断子空间保留的以原点为中心的向量能量比例，在CBOW和RI中表现最强，邻域对比度在SkipGram和现代/Matryoshka设置中领先（GTE大致相当），而局部密度与边际分析中的保留相关，但在控制了能量和对比度后，它几乎不提供额外信息（R平方增量从0.001到0.010）。在成对比较中，现代句子编码器的局部内在维度比密度解释了更多的变化。在SciFact上，查询密度预测了在激进压缩下的检索退化；在NFCorpus上，主要的32维关联未能重现，而直接的方差限制检验未能解决该零假设。平均压缩性能掩盖了几何特性使其可见的系统化每个样本的变异。

articles.title: Understanding Machine Taste: Aesthetic Agreement Across Foundation Models in K-pop
articles.abstract: As foundation models enter creative industries, understanding their aesthetic preferences becomes an important step toward AI-assisted creative decision making. In this work, we investigate how foundation models evaluate creative content and characterize their ``machine taste'' using K-pop songs and music videos as a testbed. We formulate aesthetic evaluation as a pairwise ranking problem and systematically examine pairwise inter-model agreement, group-level consensus, and cross-modal preference alignment. Our results reveal stronger pairwise inter-model agreement and group-level consensus in visual evaluation than in audio evaluation, while preferences across the two modalities remain weakly aligned. We further examine how visual consensus rankings relate to real-world popularity using historical YouTube viewership data, finding positive but varying correlations across artist groups. These findings provide initial insights into machine aesthetic preferences and lay the groundwork for future AI-assisted creative decision making that considers creative content, artist identity, audience preferences, and market dynamics.
articles.titleCn: 理解机器品味：K-pop中基础模型间的审美共识
articles.abstractCn: 随着基础模型进入创意产业，理解其审美偏好成为实现AI辅助创意决策的重要一步。在本工作中，我们研究了基础模型如何评估创意内容，并以K-pop歌曲和音乐视频为测试平台，刻画其“机器品味”。我们将审美评估形式化为成对排序问题，并系统地考察了模型间的成对一致性、群体层面的共识以及跨模态的偏好对齐。结果表明，在视觉评估中模型间的成对一致性和群体层面共识强于音频评估，而两种模态下的偏好对齐仍然较弱。我们进一步利用历史YouTube观看数据，考察视觉共识排序与真实世界受欢迎程度的关系，发现不同艺术家群体之间存在正相关但差异较大。这些发现为机器审美偏好提供了初步见解，并为未来考虑创意内容、艺术家身份、观众偏好和市场动态的AI辅助创意决策奠定了基础。

articles.title: SkillScreen: High-Recall Screening of Malicious Agent Skills with Decision Models
articles.abstract: Agent skills turn natural-language instructions into actions, creating a security challenge: legitimate automation and malicious behaviour can look deceptively similar. A practical screen must catch nearly every attack while keeping the review load manageable. We present SkillScreen, a compact decision model trained to score skill maliciousness directly from SKILL$.$md in a single forward pass. On MaliciousSkillBench, SkillScreen flags 20-25% of benign skills at 99% recall on unseen attack families, substantially fewer than the word-level classifier and prompted LLM judges tested. Under the same training protocol, it also generalizes better than a fully fine-tuned encoder to unseen sources. Yet unfamiliar benign sources sharply increase false positives, showing that recognizing new attacks does not ensure reliable screening of new skill collections. Our results demonstrate the value of task-trained decision models for high-recall skill screening. Project page: https://jerroldh.github.io/SkillScreen-webpage/
articles.titleCn: 技能筛选：基于决策模型的恶意代理技能高召回率筛选
articles.abstractCn: 代理技能将自然语言指令转化为行动，这带来了一个安全挑战：合法自动化和恶意行为可能看起来非常相似。一个实用的屏幕必须在不增加审查负担的情况下捕获几乎所有攻击。我们提出了SkillScreen，一个紧凑的决策模型，它通过单次前向传递直接从SKILL$.$md中评分技能的恶意程度。在MaliciousSkillBench上，SkillScreen在未知的攻击家族中以99%的召回率标记了20-25%的良性技能，这远少于测试的词级分类器和提示LLM裁判。在相同的训练协议下，它也比完全微调的编码器更好地泛化到未知的来源。然而，不熟悉的良性来源会显著增加误报，表明识别新攻击并不能保证对新技能集合的可靠筛选。我们的结果表明，任务训练的决策模型对于高召回率的技能筛选具有重要价值。项目页面：https://jerroldh.github.io/SkillScreen-webpage/

articles.title: Pushback in a Haystack: Language Models Respond to Factual Errors Ambiguously and Ineffectively
articles.abstract: The sycophancy of language models, or their failure to push back against faulty user input, is now widely studied. However, if LMs do push back, is sycophancy solved? We show that LMs vary in how they present pushback, and thus vary in how effectively they correct user beliefs. We introduce a phrase-level, human-validated response labeling framework to uncover fine-grained insights into how LMs push against and/or affirm false inputs. We develop and apply our framework on model responses in five languages: English, German, Chinese, Hindi, and Yoruba. We find that when models do push back against users' false assertions, they tend to use indirect phrasing and mix in affirmation, with more indirectness in Hindi and Yoruba than in other languages considered. In a large-scale human study (n = 300), we find that the pushback ambiguity we identified may fail to correct and prevent users' factual misconceptions.
articles.titleCn: 干草堆中的推回：语言模型对事实性错误反应模糊且无效
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的对用户错误输入的迎合行为，或其未能进行反驳，现已得到广泛研究。然而，如果语言模型确实进行反驳，那么迎合行为是否得到解决？我们表明，语言模型在呈现反驳的方式上存在差异，因此它们在纠正用户信念方面的有效性也各不相同。我们引入了一种基于短语级别、经过人工验证的响应标注框架，以揭示语言模型如何反驳和/或确认错误输入的细微之处。我们在五种语言的模型响应上开发并应用了该框架：英语、德语、中文、印地语和约鲁巴语。我们发现，当模型对用户的错误断言进行反驳时，它们倾向于使用间接措辞，并夹杂肯定成分，在印地语和约鲁巴语中的间接性比其他所研究语言更为明显。在一项大规模人类研究（样本量n=300）中，我们发现我们识别出的反驳模糊性可能无法纠正和预防用户的现实性错误认知。

articles.title: Encoding Context into LLM Weights: What Makes It Context?
articles.abstract: Longer contexts allow large language models (LLMs) to condition their predictions on more information, but inference costs grow prohibitively with context length. An emerging alternative uses test-time updates to encode context as temporary changes to model weights. However, encoding this information into weights that already represent general knowledge obscures its role as context, so the LLM may fail to use it properly to condition subsequent inference. To restore this contextual role, we first associate each context with an identifier during encoding, thereby distinguishing the newly encoded information from pre-existing knowledge. Invoking the identifier at inference then enables the LLM to recite the encoded context. Nevertheless, successful recitation does not ensure that the LLM will use the recalled information as context. We therefore further introduce a prompting framework that explicitly guides the LLM to use this information as context. Across diverse controlled tasks and practical benchmarks, our method outperformed the baseline using only off-the-shelf LLMs, showing its advances in context encoding.
articles.titleCn: 将编码上下文融入大语言模型权重：是什么让上下文成为上下文？
articles.abstractCn: 更长的上下文允许大型语言模型（LLMs）基于更多信息进行预测，但推理成本随上下文长度增长而变得过高。一种新兴的替代方案使用测试时更新将上下文编码为模型权重的临时变化。然而，将这类信息编码到已经代表一般知识的权重中会掩盖其作为上下文的作用，因此LLM可能无法正确地使用它来对后续推理进行条件化。为了恢复这种上下文作用，我们在编码过程中首先为每个上下文关联一个标识符，从而将新编码的信息与现有知识区分开来。在推理时调用该标识符则使LLM能够回忆编码的上下文。尽管成功的回忆并不能保证LLM会将回忆的信息用作上下文，因此我们进一步引入了一种提示框架，明确引导LLM将这类信息用作上下文。在我们的方法在各种受控任务和实际基准测试中均优于仅使用现成LLM的基线方法，显示了其在上下文编码方面的进步。

articles.title: LatentRiskBench: Measuring State-Dependent Risks in Enterprise Agents
articles.abstract: Enterprise agents face safety risks that cannot be determined from individual actions alone. Existing safety benchmarks largely evaluate action-local risks, overlooking failures whose safety depends on workflow state. In such state-dependent risks, the same action may be safe in one context but violate policy in another. Hence, we introduce LatentRiskBench for evaluating such state-dependent risks in enterprise settings. It pairs risky trajectories with benign counterparts that share the same terminal action but differ in latent policy-relevant states, requiring models to reconstruct workflow context rather than rely on action-level cues. We also introduce new metrics for state-dependent risk evaluation, including a suite of residual risk (RR) measures. Experiments on the benchmark show that action-level evaluation detects only 0.09 of state-dependent violations, whereas state-level evaluation reaches 0.96. Existing guardrail methods largely overlook such risks unless they are explicitly applied to workflow states. Case studies on a commercial deployed scenario further show that the safety metrics embedded in the benchmark provide a more realistic measure of safety for enterprise agents. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/JingyueCong/LatentRiskBench.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 18 pages, 3 figures
articles.titleCn: 潜在风险基准：衡量企业代理中的状态依赖风险
articles.abstractCn: 企业代理面临的安全风险无法仅从个体行为中确定。现有的安全基准主要评估行为局部风险，忽略了那些安全性取决于工作流状态的风险。在状态依赖型风险中，同一行为在一个上下文中可能是安全的，但在另一个上下文中可能违反政策。因此，我们引入了LatentRiskBench来评估企业环境中的此类状态依赖型风险。它将高风险轨迹与良性轨迹配对，这些良性轨迹与高风险轨迹具有相同的终端行为，但在潜在的政策相关状态上有所不同，要求模型重建工作流上下文，而不是依赖行为级别的线索。我们还引入了新的状态依赖型风险评估指标，包括一套残差风险（RR）度量。在基准上的实验表明，行为级别评估仅检测到0.09的状态依赖型违规，而状态级别评估达到了0.96。现有的护栏方法在很大程度上忽略了此类风险，除非它们被明确应用于工作流状态。对商业部署场景的案例研究表明，基准中嵌入的安全指标为企业代理提供了更现实的安全度量。我们的数据集和代码可在https://github.com/JingyueCong/LatentRiskBench获取。

articles.title: RALI@iKAT 2026: Retrieval-aware User Profile Denoising via Personalized Conversational Dense Retrieval
articles.abstract: Modern conversational information access systems continuously extract user information from conversations to build user profiles for personalized retrieval. As user profiles accumulate over time, they inevitably become noisy, making effective user profile denoising a fundamental challenge. Existing personalized conversational query reformulation methods rely on the black-box reasoning capability of LLMs to expand the original query with relevant user profile phrases, producing a verbose query for retrieval. Such rewrite-then-retrieve pipelines reduce user profile denoising to the explicit selection of profile phrases in the sparse token space, separating personalization from downstream relevance modeling. Consequently, they often fail to identify user information that is truly beneficial for retrieval. To enable retrieval-aware user profile denoising, we propose Personalized Conversational Dense Retrieval (PCDR), which learns to jointly project the conversation history and user profile into a latent embedding space dedicated to retrieval. By inheriting the context denoising capability from conversational dense retrievers, PCDR requires only a handful of personalized relevance annotations for training. We evaluate PCDR on the iKAT 2026 tasks, where it serves as the core retrieval component of a conversational AI agent assisting users with complex information needs.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Presented at the SCAI Workshop at SIGIR 2026. Ranked 1st in both retrieval performance and response quality at iKAT 2026
articles.titleCn: RALI@iKAT 2026：基于个性化对话密集检索的检索感知用户画像去噪
articles.abstractCn: 现代对话式信息获取系统持续从对话中提取用户信息以构建用户画像，用于个性化检索。随着用户画像随时间积累，不可避免地会变得嘈杂，使得有效的用户画像去噪成为一项基本挑战。现有的个性化对话式查询重写方法依赖于大型语言模型的黑盒推理能力，通过添加相关的用户画像短语来扩展原始查询，生成用于检索的冗长查询。这种重写后再检索的流程将用户画像去噪简化为在稀疏的标记空间中显式选择用户画像短语，将个性化与下游的相关性建模分离。因此，它们往往无法识别对检索真正有益的用户信息。为实现检索感知的用户画像去噪，我们提出了个性化对话式密集检索（PCDR），该模型学习将对话历史和用户画像联合投影到专门用于检索的潜在嵌入空间中。通过继承对话式密集检索器的上下文去噪能力，PCDR仅需少量个性化相关性标注进行训练。我们在iKAT 2026任务上评估了PCDR，该模型作为辅助用户处理复杂信息需求的对话式AI代理的核心检索组件。

articles.title: DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter
