articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for multi-turn agents relies on sparse terminal rewards that say little about individual steps. Within-group step comparisons depend on reliable state matching and sufficiently diverse sampled outcomes, while direct step scoring may require costly external evaluators, human annotations, or task-specific heuristics. We introduce DeltaTTG to learn a reusable progress signal through a shared progress meter, using low-cost supervision from diverse policies' recorded trajectories without task-specific progress rules. Its supervision target, Token-to-Go (TTG), the number of tokens remaining to be generated until task completion, serves as an observable proxy for remaining completion effort. During actor training, changes in the frozen meter's estimates redistribute outcome-derived advantages across steps without altering the reward, preserving each trajectory's advantage sign and token-average scale. On ALFWorld, PaperSearchQA, and BFCLv3, DeltaTTG improves the average score over GRPO by 5.7 and 7.2 points with Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively, outperforms all compared RL baselines on average, and keeps actor-training GPU-hours close to GRPO. Further experiments show improved sample efficiency and out-of-domain performance, and support the meter's ability to distinguish step quality and guide test-time action selection across actor sizes. The code is available at https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG.
articles.titleCn: DeltaTTG：使用一个“一个token即一步”进度条来训练多轮智能体
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）用于多轮智能体时，依赖于稀疏的终端奖励，这些奖励对单个步骤的描述有限。组内步骤比较依赖于可靠的状态匹配和足够多样化的采样结果，而直接步骤评分可能需要昂贵的外部评估器、人工标注或特定任务的启发式方法。我们引入DeltaTTG，通过共享进度计器学习可重用的进度信号，利用多样化策略记录轨迹的低成本监督，而无需特定任务的进度规则。其监督目标Token-to-Go（TTG），即任务完成前剩余需要生成的token数量，作为剩余完成工作量的可观察代理。在演员训练期间，冻结计器的估计变化重新分配结果衍生的优势到各个步骤，而不改变奖励，保持每个轨迹的优势符号和token平均尺度。在ALFWorld、PaperSearchQA和BFCLv3上，DeltaTTG分别使用Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，平均得分比GRPO提高了5.7和7.2分，平均优于所有比较的RL基线，并使演员训练的GPU小时数接近GRPO。进一步实验显示样本效率和域外性能得到提升，并支持计器区分步骤质量和指导不同演员大小的测试时动作选择。代码可在https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG获取。

articles.title: The Image Still Has a Say: Final-Answer Repair for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
articles.abstract: Although chain-of-thought prompting has improved multimodal reasoning, it is still difficult to produce correct final answers, as the reasoning can drift away from the image. Besides, the trace is already fixed when the answer is generated, leaving no room for self-correction. Considering the image is still available at the final-answer step, we think it is reasonable to fix the answer there without rewriting the reasoning. As such, the problem becomes to correct the final answer using the image under fixed reasoning. Unlike methods that improve trace generation through training, resampling, or decoding-time grounding, we repair the final-answer readout while keeping the reasoning trace fixed. The motivation is based on our finding that a wrong option can become prematurely committed in the reasoning while the correct option still has stronger image support in middle-to-deep layers. Thus, we propose Text-to-Visual Evidence Reallocation (TVER), a training-free method for final-answer repair. Specifically, TVER selects answer-related text and question-matched image patches, and moves bounded attention from text to patches. Furthermore, the patches are chosen in a middle-to-deep layer window based on question relevance. Our method improves answers across benchmarks and backbones, with gains in both multiple-choice and open-answer evaluations.
articles.titleCn: 图像仍具话语权：多模态思维链最终答案修复
articles.abstractCn: 尽管思维链提示已经提升了多模态推理能力，但生成正确最终答案仍然十分困难，因为推理过程可能会偏离图像内容。此外，当答案生成时，推理轨迹已经固定，无法进行自我修正。考虑到在最终答案步骤中图像仍然可用，我们认为在没有重写推理的情况下，在那里固定答案是有道理的。因此，问题转化为在固定推理的情况下使用图像来修正最终答案。与通过训练、重采样或解码时定位来改进轨迹生成的方法不同，我们保持推理轨迹固定，同时修复最终答案的读取输出。我们的动机基于这样一个发现：在推理过程中，一个错误选项可能会过早地被确定，而正确选项在中到深层仍然具有更强的图像支持。因此，我们提出了文本到视觉证据重新分配（TVER）方法，这是一种无需训练的最终答案修复方法。具体而言，TVER选择与答案相关的文本和与问题匹配的图像块，并将有限的注意力从文本转移到这些块上。此外，这些块是根据问题相关性在中到深层窗口中选择的。我们的方法在多个基准和主干网络上提升了答案，并在多项选择和开放式答案评估中都取得了进步。

articles.title: Worth Their Weights? Evaluating Generative Models for Discourse Parsing
articles.abstract: Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST) parsing has historically been dominated by discriminative models based on pretrained encoder-only language models. The recent availability of high-quality generative language models has made it unclear whether RST parsing is better approached as a generative task. In this work, we investigate whether generative language models are better at parsing RST than traditional discriminative ones. We find that at matched parameter counts, discriminative parsers perform much better than generative ones, though much larger generative models sometimes outperform them. Generative models hold a particular advantage in elementary discourse unit (EDU) segmentation, and we report new state-of-the-art results on the RST-DT benchmark in end-to-end parsing as well as segmentation.
articles.titleCn: 值不值得？评估用于话语分析的生成模型
articles.abstractCn: 修辞结构理论（RST）的解析长期以来一直由基于预训练的编码器语言模型构建的判别模型主导。近年来高质量生成式语言模型的可用性使得人们不确定RST解析是否更适合作为生成任务。在这项工作中，我们研究了生成式语言模型是否比传统的判别模型更擅长解析RST。我们发现，在匹配的参数数量下，判别式解析器表现远优于生成式解析器，尽管有时参数量更大的生成式模型会胜过它们。生成式模型在基本话语单元（EDU）分割方面具有独特优势，我们在RST-DT基准测试的端到端解析和分割任务中也报告了新的最先进结果。

articles.title: Decouple to Forget: Semantic Mediation for Sensitive Unlearning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models seeks to remove specified knowledge while preserving general capability, yet current methods often treat an entire response as the unit of forgetting. This coarse granularity causes unnecessary utility loss when the forget target is only a small set of sensitive facts embedded within otherwise benign explanations. In this paper, we introduce Decouple to Forget (D2F), a targeted unlearning method inspired by semantic mediation that separates sensitive factual content from non-sensitive meaning and surface expression. For each example to be forgotten, D2F extracts a fact-level "mediator" representation from the answer, identifies which parts are sensitive, and removes only those parts while leaving the rest of the structure intact. We then generate counterfactual answers grounded in this mediator that preserve non-sensitive content but exclude sensitive facts, employing preference-based contrastive optimization to reduce the likelihood of information leakage while maintaining helpfulness and fluency. Experiments across various benchmark datasets show that D2F achieves a better balance between forgetting and retention than strong baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/JingyueCong/D2F.
articles.titleCn: 解耦遗忘：大型语言模型中的敏感知识遗忘语义中介
articles.abstractCn: 针对大型语言模型的机器卸载旨在移除特定知识的同时保留通用能力，然而当前方法通常将整个响应视为遗忘的单位。这种粗糙的粒度在遗忘目标是嵌入在良性解释中一小部分敏感事实时，会导致不必要的效用损失。在本文中，我们引入了受语义中介启发的目标卸载方法Decouple to Forget (D2F)，该方法将敏感事实内容与非敏感意义和表面表达分离。对于每个需要遗忘的示例，D2F从答案中提取事实级的“中介”表示，识别哪些部分是敏感的，仅移除这些部分，同时保留其余结构。然后，我们基于这个中介生成反事实答案，保留非敏感内容但排除敏感事实，采用基于偏好的对比优化来减少信息泄露的可能性，同时保持有用性和流畅性。跨多个基准数据集的实验表明，D2F在遗忘和保留之间取得了比强基线方法更好的平衡。我们的代码可在https://github.com/JingyueCong/D2F获取。

articles.title: DisaggKD: Efficient Knowledge Distillation through Teacher-Student Disaggregation and a Fused Loss
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) frameworks place teacher and student on the same GPUs, so per-GPU memory limits the teachers that fit. DisaggKD separates them across nodes: teacher replicas stream hidden states to the student, a KD loss over row windows and vocabulary shards equals the full-vocabulary loss in exact arithmetic without forming the full-vocabulary logits, and a prefetch ring paces producer and trainer. Closed-form memory and traffic models locate the memory limits of each layout. On the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to 9B pair, the disaggregated layout matches the LM loss of the colocated run with the same loss and is faster than that run; our fused loss also lets a colocated run train on as few nodes at faster speed, while the split is memory efficient when the student spans several nodes. On the larger pairs, colocated runs with a fused loss still run OOM where the split trains, because teacher weights and student states fill the budget.
articles.titleCn: DisaggKD：通过教师-学生分离和融合损失实现高效知识蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏（KD）框架将教师和学生置于同一GPU上，因此每GPU的内存限制决定了可适配的教师数量。DisaggKD将它们分布在多个节点上：教师副本将隐藏状态流式传输给学生，跨行窗口和词汇片段的KD损失在精确算术中等于完整词汇的损失，而无需形成完整词汇的logits，预取环则协调生产者和训练者。封闭形式的内存和流量模型定位了每种布局的内存限制。在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B到9B的对配中，分散布局与同位置运行具有相同的损失，并比该运行更快；我们的融合损失还允许同位置运行以更快的速度在更少的节点上训练，而拆分在学生跨越多个节点时内存效率更高。在更大的对配中，具有融合损失的同位置运行仍然会因为教师权重和学生状态耗尽预算而OOM，而拆分则可以训练。

articles.title: Executable Prefix Values for Locating Agent Failures
articles.abstract: Work on debugging LLM agents treats the "first mistake" marked by a human or LLM judge as ground truth for where a trajectory failed. We ask whether such labels point at causes or symptoms, and make the distinction executable: we restart the agent from reconstructed intermediate states of a failed trajectory and estimate its prefix value V(h_t), the probability of success from each step, with a certified point of no return (PNR) for a failure. On 150 SWE-bench Verified tasks with two frozen open-weight agents, we build such curves for 47 and 60 failed trajectories and probe every step labeled by four frontier judges under the Traverse rubric. We find that the labels do not mark what a controller needs. Judges of different lineages agree on the exact step in only 21/57 cases, and the newest judges flag mistakes in 8/10 and 10/10 successful runs. For 66% of the labels, the agent's success probability does not drop at the labeled step; only 7/188 answers name the decisive step. Restarting at the measured restart point raises expected success from 0.44 to 0.57 offline, and real restarts confirm the advantage, whereas restarting at a judge's label does not (-0.08 to -0.03). We release our code, curves, and labels.
articles.titleCn: 定位代理故障的可执行前缀值
articles.abstractCn: 调试大语言模型代理的工作将人类或大语言模型裁判标记的“首次错误”视为轨迹失败的真实情况。我们探讨了这些标签是指向原因还是症状，并使这一区分可执行：我们从失败轨迹的重建中间状态重新启动代理，并估计其前缀值V(h_t)，即从每一步开始成功的概率，以及一个经过认证的无返回点（PNR）用于失败。在150个SWE-bench验证任务上，使用两个冻结的开权代理，我们为47个和60个失败轨迹构建了这样的曲线，并检查了Traverse标准下四位前沿裁判标记的每一步。我们发现这些标签并未标记控制器所需的内容。不同谱系的裁判只在57个中的21个案例上对确切的步骤达成一致，而最新裁判在10次成功运行中的8次和10次中标记了错误。对于66%的标签，代理的成功概率在标记步骤并未下降；只有7/188个回答指出了决定性步骤。在测量的重启点重新启动将离线预期成功率从0.44提高到0.57，实际重启证实了这一优势，而重启在裁判的标签处则没有优势（从-0.08到-0.03）。我们发布了我们的代码、曲线和标签。

articles.title: RELAY: Selective Self-Distillation with Adaptive Hand-off for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning grades a response against many written criteria but collapses them into one reward, which discards the detail the rubric carries and gives no GRPO reward gradient when a group's responses tie. A frozen teacher that reads the rubric as privileged context provides token-level supervision, but we observe an early plateau in the gains over GRPO. RELAY uses advantages and rewards to select positive-advantage and low-scoring zero-advantage rollouts, and monitors the distillation loss to decide when to retire the teacher. Stage 1 combines selective distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO; a plateau detector then removes the teacher, and Stage 2 continues with GRPO alone. Calibrated on one model-domain pair and reused unchanged in three others, the plateau detector fires between steps 122 and 171. RELAY scores highest in-domain among the compared methods in all four settings, ahead of GRPO on RaR-Medicine by 4.62 points with Qwen3-1.7B and 6.02 with Qwen3-4B. On Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine, removing the teacher from a shared checkpoint outperforms keeping, weakening or refreshing it. Distilling selected rollouts covering about half the response tokens also outperforms distilling all rollouts at a matched average coefficient.
articles.titleCn: 继电器：基于评分标准的强化学习的自适应切换选择性自蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 基于评分标准的强化学习将回复与众多书面标准进行比对，但将其简化为单一奖励，从而忽略了评分标准所包含的细节，并且在小组回复相同的情况下不会提供GRPO奖励梯度。一个读取评分标准的冻结教师作为特权上下文提供标记级监督，但我们观察到在GRPO收益上存在早期平台期。RELAY使用优势值和奖励来选择具有正向优势且得分低的零优势回滚，并监控蒸馏损失以决定何时退役教师。第一阶段将冻结教师的选择性蒸馏与GRPO结合；平台检测器随后移除教师，第二阶段单独使用GRPO。在一个模型域对上校准并在三个其他模型域上未经更改地重复使用，平台检测器在步骤122和171之间触发。在四个设置中，RELAY在所属领域内与其他方法相比得分最高，在RaR-Medicine上，使用Qwen3-1.7B时领先GRPO 4.62分，使用Qwen3-4B时领先6.02分。在Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine上，从共享检查点中移除教师的表现优于保留、削弱或刷新教师。蒸馏覆盖约一半回复标记的选择性回滚也优于以匹配的平均系数蒸馏所有回滚。

articles.title: When Does an ASR Error Matter? Task-Role Diagnostics for Tool-Using Voice Agents
articles.abstract: In cascaded voice agents, ASR errors can have markedly different downstream consequences: a small transcription error may leave a tool call unchanged or alter its intent or arguments. Conventional word error rate (WER), however, does not capture these differences. We introduce SpeechEvalX, a paired diagnostic protocol that evaluates how task roles affected by ASR errors influence structured tool calls. Controlled edits are matched by source utterance, edit count, and operation, while task-role labels are compared with lexical severity, BERT cosine distance, Semantic-WER, and binary criticality. Across 594 source utterances, joint call accuracy falls from 82.3% with reference transcripts to 71.9-74.9% across three ASR front ends. Number and negation edits cause 21.9-25.7 percentage-point losses, versus 1.4-2.9 points for control edits. Detailed task-role labels improve source-grouped ROC-AUC from 0.73 to 0.78 over binary criticality, showing that downstream impact depends strongly on the task role affected.
articles.titleCn: ASR错误何时重要？工具使用型语音代理的任务角色诊断
articles.abstractCn: 在级联语音代理中，语音识别错误可能产生显著不同的下游后果：一个小的转录错误可能使工具调用保持不变，或改变其意图或参数。然而，传统的词错误率（WER）并未捕捉这些差异。我们引入了SpeechEvalX，这是一个成对诊断协议，用于评估受语音识别错误影响的任务角色如何影响结构化工具调用。受控编辑通过源语句、编辑次数和操作进行匹配，而任务角色标签则与词汇严重性、BERT余弦距离、语义-WER和二元关键性进行比较。在594个源语句中，联合调用准确率从参考转录本的82.3%下降到三个语音识别前端中的71.9-74.9%。数量和否定编辑导致21.9-25.7个百分点的损失，而对照编辑仅导致1.4-2.9个百分点的损失。详细的任务角色标签将源语句分组的ROC-AUC从0.73提高到0.78，超过二元关键性，表明下游影响强烈依赖于受影响的任务角色。

articles.title: StateHarness: Maintaining Evolving Project State for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Long-horizon coding requires agents to maintain an evolving view of the project they are changing: what problem is currently being solved, what has already been learned or modified, which other artifacts may be affected, and what work remains unresolved. When this information is scattered across a growing interaction history, local edits can become disconnected from their later consequences and progress can be difficult to carry forward. We introduce StateHarness, a runtime framework that maintains evolving project state without updating model parameters. The working agent records its current problem and hypothesis, important findings and decisions, discovered repository relationships, and unfinished work. Runtime support prompts record updates, searches for callers, tests, and documentation that may be affected by a change, and maintains a compact working brief for subsequent decisions. When behavioral signals accumulate, a separate diagnostic session revisits the recorded history and surfaces overlooked evidence. Across three repository-level evaluations, StateHarness improves task completion and several measures of change consistency. On RefactorBench, full-chain completion increases from 29.4% to 35.3% and cleanup-check accuracy from 87.0% to 95.4%. On five LHTB software-engineering tasks, mean reward improves from 0.427 to 0.576, exceeding LongHorizon-Harness at substantially lower recorded execution cost. On ChainSWE, bug-fix rate increases from 35.1% to 39.5% and residual debt decreases from 60 to 43 items, although pass-to-pass regressions increase. These results show that maintaining project state can improve long-horizon coding while introducing measurable execution and regression trade-offs.
articles.titleCn: 状态驱动器：为长时程编码代理维护不断发展的项目状态
articles.abstractCn: 长时程编码要求代理维持对正在修改的项目不断演变的认知：当前正在解决的问题、已学习或修改的内容、可能受影响的其它工件以及未解决的工作。当这些信息分散在日益增长交互历史中时，局部修改可能与其后续后果脱节，导致难以推进工作。我们引入StateHarness，这是一个无需更新模型参数即可维持项目状态演变的运行时框架。工作代理记录当前问题与假设、重要发现与决策、发现的库关系以及未完成的工作。运行时支持通过提示记录更新、搜索可能受变更影响的调用者、测试和文档，并维护一份紧凑的工作简报供后续决策。当行为信号累积时，独立的诊断会话将回顾记录的历史并揭示被忽略的证据。在三个库级评估中，StateHarness提升了任务完成率和多项变更一致性指标。在RefactorBench上，全链完成率从29.4%提升至35.3%，清理检查准确率从87.0%提升至95.4%。在五个LHTB软件工程任务中，平均奖励从0.427提升至0.576，显著低于LongHorizon-Harness的记录执行成本。在ChainSWE上，补丁修复率从35.1%提升至39.5%，剩余债务从60项减少至43项，尽管逐轮回归有所增加。这些结果表明，维持项目状态可以在引入可衡量的执行与回归权衡的同时，提升长时程编码能力。

articles.title: Facts Don't Speak Louder than Words: The Behavioral Essence of Long-CoT Distillation
articles.abstract: While long chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation significantly improves the reasoning abilities of language models, its underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. Current pipelines generally rely on rejection sampling to gather reasoning traces across diverse prompts, assuming that factual correctness and broad problem coverage are indispensable. Surprisingly, we find that training exclusively on flawed reasoning trajectories or a restricted prompt set yields nearly comparable performance. Driven by this counterintuitive finding, we propose the Behavioral Hypothesis: the essence of Long-CoT distillation is behavioral alignment with structured reasoning patterns, rather than factual knowledge memorization. We then validate this by demonstrating substantial reasoning gains even when models are fine-tuned exclusively on previously mastered problems-effectively isolating behavioral alignment from novel knowledge injection. Having established that reasoning patterns are the true bottleneck, we investigate how to learn them across varying levels of complexity optimally. We reveal a critical interplay: while the recent probability-based loss excels at learning simple patterns, the standard cross-entropy loss is essential for scaling to complex CoTs. We believe these insights demystify CoT distillation and provide a principled foundation for the future development of reasoning models. Code is available on https://github.com/yuyongcan/Long-CoT-Distillation.
articles.titleCn: 事实不会比言语更有力：长CoT蒸馏的行为本质
articles.abstractCn: 尽管长链式思维（CoT）蒸馏显著提升了语言模型的推理能力，但其潜在机制仍不为人知。当前流程通常依赖拒绝采样来收集不同提示下的推理轨迹，假设事实正确性和广泛的问题覆盖范围是不可或缺的。令人惊讶的是，我们发现仅基于有缺陷的推理轨迹或受限的提示集进行训练，也能获得近乎相当的性能。受这一反直觉发现的驱动，我们提出了行为假设：长-CoT蒸馏的本质在于与结构化推理模式的行为对齐，而非事实知识的记忆。随后，我们通过证明即使在仅对先前掌握的问题进行微调时，模型也能获得显著的推理提升，从而验证了这一假设——有效地将行为对齐与新颖知识注入分离。在确认推理模式是真正的瓶颈后，我们研究了如何在不同复杂度级别上最优地学习它们。我们揭示了一个关键相互作用：虽然基于概率的损失函数在学习简单模式方面表现出色，但标准的交叉熵损失对于扩展到复杂的CoT至关重要。我们相信这些见解揭示了CoT蒸馏的本质，并为未来推理模型的发展提供了原则性基础。代码可在https://github.com/yuyongcan/Long-CoT-Distillation获取。

articles.title: TDR: Tagalog Diacritic Restoration Dataset
articles.abstract: Homographs are words that share identical spelling but differ in meaning and pronunciation. In Tagalog, these distinctions are disambiguated in writing through tuldik (diacritical marks), which are rarely preserved in contemporary Tagalog text. This scarcity of diacritics limits diacritic restoration, which is useful for downstream tasks such as prosody selection for text-to-speech synthesis. To address this gap, this study introduces TDR, an annotated corpus of 40 frequent Tagalog homographs constructed from news text. It also introduces a collocation-driven retrieval method to expand the dataset and mitigate severe class imbalance among minor variants. Finally, we show that TDR supplies a capability absent from pretrained models, and that this capability can be learned by small, inexpensive models as well as by fine-tuned LLMs.
articles.titleCn: TDR：他加禄语变音恢复数据集
articles.abstractCn: 同形异义词是指拼写相同但意义和发音不同的词语。在塔加洛语中，这些区别通过变音符号（tuldik）在书写中进行区分，但这些变音符号在当代塔加洛语文本中很少被保留。变音符号的稀缺性限制了变音符号的恢复，这对于韵律选择等下游任务（如文本到语音合成）非常有用。为了弥补这一空白，本研究引入了TDR，这是一个由新闻文本构建的包含40个常见塔加洛语同形异义词的标注语料库。此外，本研究还引入了一种基于搭配驱动的检索方法来扩展数据集，并缓解少数变体之间严重的类别不平衡问题。最后，我们表明TDR提供了一种预训练模型所不具备的能力，并且这种能力既可以由小型廉价模型学习，也可以由微调的大型语言模型学习。

articles.title: Tanawpamana: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Philippine Cultural Heritage Sites
articles.abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used to identify and describe places, yet their recognition and knowledge of specific cultures remain poorly understood, particularly in underrepresented regions such as the Philippines. This study introduces the Tanawpamana Dataset, a repository of Philippine heritage site images with metadata based on the Talapamana registry of the National Commission for Culture and the Arts of the Philippines. We also introduce the Tanawpamana Benchmark, comprising 4,046 tasks designed to evaluate models' recognition and knowledge of heritage sites. Evaluating seven vision-language models, we find that they struggle more with fine-grained visual discrimination among similar heritage sites than with coarse recognition, and that their geographic knowledge is weaker when inferred from image inputs than from text.
articles.titleCn: Tanawpamana：在菲律宾文化遗产地测试视觉语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型越来越多地用于识别和描述地点，但它们对特定文化的识别和认知仍然缺乏了解，特别是在菲律宾等代表性不足的地区。本研究介绍了Tanawpamana数据集，这是一个基于菲律宾国家文化艺术委员会的Talapamana登记册的菲律宾文化遗产地图像元数据存储库。我们还介绍了Tanawpamana基准，包含4,046个任务，旨在评估模型对文化遗产地的识别和认知能力。通过评估七个视觉语言模型，我们发现它们在相似文化遗产地之间的细粒度视觉辨别方面比粗略识别更困难，并且从图像输入中推断出的地理知识比从文本中推断出的更薄弱。

articles.title: Dissociating Answerability from Extraction in LLM Question Answering over Radiology Reports
articles.abstract: Answering questions from radiology reports involves two decisions: whether the report contains an answer and which span gives it. A false answer presents an unsupported claim as fact; an over-abstention hides what the report says. Yet RadQA results are reported as a single F1 that merges both. We propose an evaluation method that separates them, reporting false-answer and over-abstention rates beside F1 and splitting F1 changes into extraction and answerability terms. We apply it to 13 LLMs on the RadQA test set, zero-shot and with three cumulative demonstration sets, the last adding an unanswerable example. Models with similar F1 differed more than twofold in false-answer rate. The unanswerable example changed when models answered, not how well they extracted: 12 of 13 models abstained more often, and three-quarters of the answers they withdrew had F1 $\geq$ 0.5. Within models, false answers showed no clear association with extraction quality, but acting on the decision itself helped: keeping an answer only when enough other models also answered lowered the zero-shot false-answer rate by 4 points without a detectable F1 change. Because the two decisions can change independently, we suggest radiology QA evaluations report them separately, not through F1 alone.
articles.titleCn: 在LLM放射报告问答中分离责任归属与信息提取
articles.abstractCn: 回答放射学报告中的问题涉及两个决策：报告是否包含答案以及哪个跨度提供了答案。错误答案将未经支持的主张呈现为事实；过度保留则隐藏了报告的内容。然而，RadQA的结果以单一的F1值报告，将两者合并。我们提出了一种将它们分离的评估方法，在F1值旁边报告错误答案率和过度保留率，并将F1的变化分解为提取和可回答性两个术语。我们将该方法应用于RadQA测试集上的13个LLM，包括零样本和三个累积演示集，其中最后一个集增加了不可回答的示例。F1值相似的模型在错误答案率上差异超过两倍。不可回答的示例改变了模型回答时的行为，而不是提取效果：13个模型中有12个更频繁地保留答案，而它们撤回的四分之三答案的F1值$\geq$ 0.5。在模型内部，错误答案与提取质量没有明显的关联，但根据决策本身采取行动有助于提高效果：仅在足够多的其他模型也回答时才保留答案，将零样本错误答案率降低了4个点，而F1值没有可察觉的变化。由于这两个决策可以独立变化，我们建议放射学问答评估应分别报告它们，而不仅仅是通过F1值。

articles.title: EdgeWise: Bringing Long-Horizon Agents to the Edge via Selective Cloud Delegation
articles.abstract: Complex and long-horizon agent tasks often rely on frontier models deployed in the cloud to achieve strong performance. However, using these models for every step of a long-horizon trajectory incurs substantial inference cost, even though not all steps may require the same level of model capability. In this paper, we find that allocating the LLM to only a small subset of key steps can achieve performance comparable to full LLM execution while significantly reducing inference cost. Motivated by this observation, we propose EdgeWise, an edge-cloud collaboration framework that deploys an SLM on the local device as the primary solver and selectively delegates critical steps to a cloud LLM when stronger model capacity is needed. To enable autonomous delegation without additional models at inference time, we introduce a step-level RL method that jointly optimizes task solving and delegation, with fine-grained credit assignment for individual delegation decisions. We also introduce an external judge-based delegation strategy and use it to systematically investigate key design choices in edge-cloud collaboration, including when to delegate, how delegation decisions should be made, what context should be shared, and how frequently the cloud LLM should be invoked. Experiments show that EdgeWise matches or outperforms pure-LLM execution while reducing inference cost up to 62% on SWE-Rebench and 34% on Terminal-Bench 2.1. We further deploy EdgeWise on a local workstation, demonstrating comparable cost savings in a practical edge-cloud setting.
articles.titleCn: EdgeWise：通过选择性云委托将长时程智能体带到边缘
articles.abstractCn: 复杂且长时程的智能体任务通常依赖于部署在云端的边界模型以实现高性能。然而，在长时程轨迹的每一步都使用这些模型会导致巨大的推理成本，尽管并非所有步骤都需要相同级别的模型能力。在本文中，我们发现将大型语言模型仅分配到一小部分关键步骤即可实现与完整模型执行相当的性能，同时显著降低推理成本。基于这一观察，我们提出了EdgeWise，一个边缘-云协作框架，该框架将小型语言模型部署在本地设备作为主要求解器，并在需要更强的模型能力时，选择性地将关键步骤委托给云端大型语言模型。为了实现无需额外模型即可进行自主委托，我们引入了一种基于步骤的强化学习方法，该方法联合优化任务求解和委托，并对单个委托决策进行细粒度的归因。我们还引入了一种基于外部裁判的委托策略，并使用它系统地研究了边缘-云协作中的关键设计选择，包括何时委托、如何做出委托决策、应共享何种上下文以及云端大型语言模型应调用的频率。实验表明，EdgeWise在SWE-Rebench上降低了高达62%的推理成本，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上降低了34%，其性能与纯大型语言模型执行相当或更优。我们进一步在本地工作站部署了EdgeWise，并在实际边缘-云环境中展示了相当的成本节约。

articles.title: Reference Wording Shapes Retrieval of Robot Task Instructions
articles.abstract: Identifying a robot task from a short instruction is sensitive to which descriptions are available for retrieval. We investigate this effect in the natural-language instructions included with the RLBench manipulation benchmark. We extract 296 fixed descriptions from 62 publicly available task files and compare five training-free lexical rankers over 80 random choices of one indexed description per task. Exact strings assigned to conflicting task labels are excluded from the primary score. Character n-gram TF-IDF achieves 61.3% mean top-1 accuracy on the resulting held-out instructions, compared with 55.6% for BM25 and 54.9% for word TF-IDF. Across gallery choices, character TF-IDF ranges from 55.2% to 66.8%; its 5th-95th percentile range is 56.9%-64.8%. Adding a second indexed description improves character TF-IDF by 7.0 percentage points on matched queries. These results quantify the influence of reference wording and representation choice on instruction-to-task retrieval under a consistent evaluation protocol.
articles.titleCn: 参考用词影响机器人任务指令的检索
articles.abstractCn: 从简短指令中识别机器人任务对可检索的描述敏感。我们在RLBench操作基准所包含的自然语言指令中研究了这种影响。我们从62个公开可用的任务文件中提取了296个固定描述，并对每个任务随机选择80个索引描述中的5个，比较了五种无训练的词汇排序器。将分配给冲突任务标签的确切字符串从主要评分中排除。字符n-gram TF-IDF在结果保留指令上实现了61.3%的平均top-1准确率，而BM25为55.6%，词TF-IDF为54.9%。在画廊选择中，字符TF-IDF的范围在55.2%到66.8%；其第5至第95百分位数范围为56.9%-64.8%。添加第二个索引描述使匹配查询上的字符TF-IDF提高了7个百分点。这些结果在一致的评估协议下量化了参考措辞和表示选择对指令到任务检索的影响。

articles.title: Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Thought templates, skill libraries, agent memories and caches turn many reasoning steps into one. We call this reasoning contraction. A contracted memory saves reasoning steps and errors until its facts change, then quietly answers wrong. Most systems trust memories by counting successes and failures. We prove that such counters are badly tuned change detectors: a symmetric counter notices a partial change only after a power of its false-alarm horizon, and an unclipped one may never notice it. On five LLMs answering multi-hop questions over edited facts, ExpeL- and ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x more stale answers than certified memories given the same information, and on code tasks with an exact verifier 35-73x more. Safety also has a price. When facts change and each memory is judged only by its own verified outcomes, one number, the certification load, sets how much reasoning any safe memory can skip, and under Zipf demand it yields a scaling law. Our recipe weighs each memory's failures by its own likelihood ratio, certifies its utility against live reasoning, and restarts the certificate when facts change, with the likelihood-ratio detector as the safety net for unannounced changes; for large edits it also invalidates the memory.
articles.titleCn: 许多步骤汇为一：推理压缩与LLM代理安全内存重用的局限性
articles.abstractCn: 思维模板、技能库、智能体记忆和缓存将许多推理步骤简化为一步。我们称之为推理收缩。收缩记忆在事实未改变前会保存推理步骤和错误，然后安静地给出错误答案。大多数系统通过统计成功和失败次数来信任记忆。我们证明这种计数器是糟糕的变化检测器：对称计数器只有在超过其误报阈值的指数倍数后才注意到部分变化，而未剪裁的计数器可能永远无法注意到。在五个大型语言模型回答编辑后事实的多跳问题时，ExpeL和ACE风格的计数器比经过验证的记忆在相同信息下多给出7.0-13.5倍的过时答案，而在有精确验证器的代码任务中多给出35-73倍。安全也有代价。当事实改变且每个记忆仅根据其验证结果被评判时，一个数字——认证负载——决定了任何安全记忆可以跳过的推理量，在Zipf需求下它产生了一个缩放规律。我们的方法通过每个记忆的失败概率比来权衡其失败，通过实时推理来认证其效用，并在事实改变时重启认证，以似然比检测器作为未宣布变化的保险；对于大范围编辑，它还会使记忆失效。
